title: Leder af Sundhedsstrategisk Sekretariat
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for den strategiske udvikling af sundhedsfremme og forebyggelse i Aalborg Kommune?

Sundhedsområdet er under hastig forandring. Nye nationale reformer og lovgivning, udviklingen af det nære sundhedsvæsen og et øget fokus på sundhedsfremme og forebyggelse stiller krav om stærk strategisk ledelse, tæt samarbejde og evnen til at omsætte ambitioner til handling.

Vi søger en erfaren og udviklingsorienteret leder til Sundhedsstrategisk Sekretariat. Du bliver leder for et stærkt sekretariat med 10 engagerede medarbejdere og får en central rolle i den samlede ledelse af sundhedsområdet. Samtidig bliver du en tæt strategisk sparringspartner for sundheds- og forebyggelseschefen.

Vi søger en leder, der kan skabe retning og følgeskab gennem tillid, involvering og tydelig ledelse, og som samtidig har modet til at træffe de svære beslutninger. Du skal kunne udfordre og bringe nye perspektiver i spil, når det styrker beslutningerne.

En central rolle i udviklingen af sundhedsområdet
Sundhedsstrategisk Sekretariat er en stabsenhed i Klima, Kultur og Sundhed, der arbejder tæt på både den administrative ledelse og det politiske niveau.

Sekretariatet understøtter udviklingen af sundhedsområdet gennem politisk betjening, strategiudvikling, implementering, analyse og opfølgning.

Som leder får du ansvar for ledelse, udvikling og kvalitetssikring af sekretariatets arbejde. Du skal kunne skifte mellem det strategiske perspektiv, ledelse af medarbejderne og selvstændigt ansvar for komplekse sager.

Dine væsentligste opgaver bliver at:

  • lede, udvikle og sætte retning for Sundhedsstrategisk Sekretariat
  • skabe rammer for høj faglighed og udvikling og dermed trivsel blandt medarbejderne
  • drive strategiske udviklingsopgaver på sundhedsområdet i tæt samarbejde med sundheds- og forebyggelseschefen og den øvrige sundhedsledergruppe
  • sikre høj kvalitet i sagsfremstillinger, beslutningsoplæg og materiale til ledelses- og politisk niveau
  • understøtte ledelsen i håndteringen af strategiske og politiske problemstillinger
  • stå i spidsen for implementeringen af den kommende folkesundhedslov samt udviklingen af en tværgående civilsamfundsstrategi
  • skabe sammenhæng mellem politiske ambitioner, strategiske prioriteringer og konkrete indsatser
  • styrke samarbejdet på tværs af kommunens forvaltninger og med blandt andre Region Nordjylland og civilsamfundet
  • bidrage aktivt til den samlede ledelse og udvikling af sundhedsområdet.

En leder med politisk tæft og strategisk udsyn
Du refererer til sundheds- og forebyggelseschefen og indgår i chefgruppen på sundhedsområdet.

Du bliver en central sparringspartner for sundheds- og forebyggelseschefen. Det kræver, at du både kan være loyal og fagligt robust. Du skal kunne understøtte beslutninger og samtidig udfordre dem konstruktivt gennem faglig indsigt, strategisk udsyn og alternative perspektiver.

Du trives i en kompleks organisation med mange interesser og perspektiver. Du kan skabe fremdrift gennem dialog, relationer og faglig troværdighed, og du har blik for både de politiske, organisatoriske og faglige dimensioner af en sag.

Som sekretariatsleder har du et særligt ansvar for kvaliteten i den politiske og administrative betjening. Du sikrer, at sager er fagligt velfunderede, tydelige og velkoordinerede, og at konsekvenser, alternativer og anbefalinger er belyst.

En leder, der skaber følgeskab
Du har erfaring med personaleledelse og motiveres af at skabe resultater gennem andre.

Du forstår, at medarbejderne i et strategisk sekretariat arbejder selvstændigt. Din opgave er således ikke at være den dygtigste specialist, men at skabe retning, prioritere de fælles indsatser og sikre, at fagligheden omsættes til konkrete resultater i rette tid.

Du skal kunne stille de rigtige spørgsmål, prioritere, skabe retning og fremdrift og sikre, at kompetencerne bringes bedst muligt i spil gennem et professionelt samarbejde i sekretariatet.

Du er nærværende, tillidsskabende og tydelig i dine forventninger. Samtidig trives du med selv at tage ansvar for komplekse opgaver, når situationen kræver det.

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har solid ledelseserfaring og erfaring med personaleledelse
  • har erfaring fra en politisk ledet organisation
  • har stærke kompetencer inden for politisk og administrativ sagsbehandling
  • har organisatorisk forståelse og kan navigere i komplekse sammenhænge
  • har stærke samarbejds- og relationskompetencer
  • har erfaring med strategisk udvikling og implementering
  • har viden om eller erfaring med sundhedsfremme, forebyggelse eller det kommunale sundhedsområde
  • kan lede specialiserede medarbejdere uden at detailstyre
  • kan skabe både ro, retning og resultater.

Vi forventer, at du har en relevant kandidatuddannelse. En samfundsvidenskabelig baggrund vil være en fordel, men vi er åbne over for forskellige uddannelsesprofiler. Det afgørende er, at du mestrer samspillet mellem ledelse, strategi, politiske processer og organisatorisk udvikling og kan omsætte det til konkrete resultater.

Hvem er vi?
Sundhedsstrategisk Sekretariat består af 10 akademiske medarbejdere med forskellige faglige profiler og er en del af Klima, Kultur og Sundhed.

Den samlede sundhedssektor omfatter:

  • Sundhedsstrategisk Sekretariat
  • Den Kommunale Tandpleje
  • Sundhedsplejen
  • Center for Sundhedsfremme
  • Center for Mental Sundhed
  • Aalborg Sundhedscenter
  • Center for Anvendt Kommunal Sundhedsforskning

Vi tilbyder
Du får en central lederrolle med stor betydning for udviklingen af sundhedsområdet i Aalborg Kommune og mulighed for at:

  • stå i spidsen for et stærkt og ambitiøst sekretariat
  • præge den strategiske udvikling af sundhedsfremme og forebyggelse
  • arbejde tæt på den administrative og politiske ledelse
  • indgå i et stærkt lederfællesskab med høj faglighed og gensidig tillid
  • skabe resultater gennem dygtige medarbejdere og stærke samarbejder.

Vi lægger vægt på et arbejdsmiljø præget af tillid, faglighed, samarbejde og udvikling.

Lyder det som dig?
Hvis du motiveres af at lede stærke fagligheder, skabe strategisk retning og levere høj kvalitet i den politiske betjening, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Yderligere oplysninger
Arbejdssted: Klima, Kultur og Sundhed, Rantzausgade 4, 9000 Aalborg

title: Repairs Coordinator
description:
Why Gallagher?

At Gallagher, we're building technology that protects what matters most. From helping farmers care for millions of animals to securing some of the world's most valuable assets, our technology is trusted in more than 160 countries.

Our Animal Management business is at the heart of what we do in agriculture, creating technology that helps farmers work smarter, improve animal welfare and get more from their farms.

Alongside a competitive salary and annual performance bonus, you'll enjoy:

  • Free onsite parking and a subsidised café

  • Life & Disability Insurance

  • A collaborative, practical and supportive team environment

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Repairs Coordinator to keep our NZ repairs operation organised, accurate and moving in the right direction.

You'll be the coordination hub between customers, Customer Services, Repair Technicians, Sales, Warehouse and Logistics - making sure repairs are processed correctly, customers are kept informed and nothing gets lost in the shuffle.

This is a practical, varied role where you'll spend your time coordinating repairs from inwards processing through to invoicing and dispatch, managing customer quotes and follow-ups, processing spare parts and stock movements, and keeping systems and records up to date.

You'll also support loan units, trade-up opportunities, reworks, stock takes and the front counter, so there's plenty of variety and no two days will look exactly the same.

You’ll be responsible for

  • Coordinating repairs in and out, including SAP processing, labelling, paperwork, invoicing and dispatch

  • Managing customer quotes, follow-ups and trade-up opportunities

  • Processing spare parts, stock movements and rework requirements

  • Keeping CRM, spreadsheets and other systems accurate and up to date

  • Coordinating loan units and supporting quarterly stock takes

  • Working closely with Repair Technicians, Customer Services, Sales and Warehouse teams

  • Providing a friendly, professional first point of contact for customers at the counter and over the phone

The Fit

You're the person who likes to keep things moving. Organised, switched-on and practical, you’re comfortable juggling customers, systems, stock and competing priorities without losing sight of the detail.

You’re naturally proactive - you spot what needs doing, follow things through and aren't afraid to pick up the phone, solve a problem or chase something up when needed. You’ll enjoy a role where there’s plenty of variety and where your work has a direct impact on the customer experience.

You'll bring:

  • Strong coordination, administration and customer service skills

  • A confident, friendly and professional communication style

  • Excellent attention to detail and a knack for keeping processes on track

  • Strong computer skills and the ability to quickly pick up systems such as SAP and CRM platforms

  • A practical, solutions-focused approach and a genuine can-do attitude

  • The ability to build great working relationships across teams and with customers

  • An interest in farming, farm technology or agricultural products would be a bonus

If you're at your best when you're making things happen, keeping people in the loop and turning a busy workload into a well-oiled machine, we'd love to hear from you.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the role may be filled before the closing date.

title: Nutritional Navigator
company: Community Health Action of Staten Island
description:
Community Health Action of Staten Island (CHASI) drives dramatic improvements in the health of New Yorkers by feeding people who are hungry, healing families broken apart by violence, and bridging the gaps between people and the compassionate health care they deserve. CHASI provides outreach, education, prevention, and direct support services for populations most affected by health disparities, including people with low or no income, low-income people with chronic illnesses, people with criminal justice involvement, people who use drugs, domestic violence survivors, people of color, and the LGBTQ community.


The Benefits Navigator provides person-centered assistance to Staten Island residents seeking Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits through CHASI's Nutrition Navigators Direct Services program. The role conducts SNAP pre-screening, supports initial and recertification applications, helps applicants understand and obtain required verification documents, monitors application progress, and follows up with clients to reduce barriers to enrollment and continued benefits. The Benefits Navigator is based at CHASI's Community Access Center and may provide services at other CHASI and community locations as scheduled.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct SNAP pre-screening using approved tools and explain potential eligibility and next steps in clear, accessible language.
  • Assist individuals and families with completing and submitting SNAP applications and recertification materials to the appropriate local social services district.
  • Review application requirements with clients and help them identify, understand, and obtain required verification documents.
  • Conduct interviews and assessments to understand each client's needs, barriers, preferred language, and support needs.
  • Track the status of applications and recertifications; provide appointment reminders, follow-up communication, and updates to clients.
  • Respond to questions regarding SNAP eligibility, application status, documentation, interviews, and recertification requirements within the scope of the role.
  • Help resolve barriers encountered during the SNAP application or recertification process and coordinate with supervisors, HRA/DSS, and community partners as appropriate.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, timely, and confidential client records, service documentation, and required data entries.
  • Prepare or contribute to internal and funder reports on screenings, applications, recertifications, follow-up activities, and outcomes.
  • Participate in community outreach, informational presentations, tabling, and other Nutrition Navigators activities as needed.
  • Maintain current knowledge of SNAP eligibility rules, application procedures, and program guidance by completing required training and professional development.
  • Provide services in a culturally responsive, trauma-informed, and respectful manner and use interpretation resources when needed.
  • Perform all functions in alignment with CHASI's Mission, Vision, and Core Values.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

The above is intended to describe the essential job functions, general supplemental functions, and essential requirements for the position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive statement of all job functions.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Etsitkö työyhteisöä, jossa asioita tehdään yhdessä, tuki on aina lähellä ja huumori on välillä laadultaan… noh, vaihtelevaa? Oma noin 40 hengen datatiimimme toimii sinulle tiiviinä kotipesänä, jonka lisäksi arkeesi kuuluu moniammatillinen yhteistyö muiden asiantuntijatiimiemme kanssa yhteisissä asiakasprojekteissa. Työskentely meillä ei ole siiloissa puurtamista tai pelkkää datan siirtämistä paikasta A paikkaan B. Jaamme aktiivisesti kokemuksia, näkemyksiä ja parhaita käytäntöjä: kokoonnumme tiimin kesken viikoittain ja pidämme melkein joka viikko yhteisiä tiedonjakosessioita. Kenenkään ei tarvitse pelätä jäävänsä yksin jumiin vaikeiden ongelmien kanssa.

Miltä arkesi voisi meillä näyttää?

Työskentelet monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa kädenjälkesi näkyy suoraan liiketoiminnan arjessa. Työpöydälläsi on modernien data-alustojen suunnittelua, dataputkien rakentamista ja datan jalostamista fiksuiksi ratkaisuiksi. Seniorina tuot teknisen osaamisen lisäksi mukanasi näkemystä: osaat sparrata asiakasta oikeissa paikoissa ja tuot rohkeasti uusia ratkaisuvaihtoehtoja pöytään. Roolin tarkempi painotus muotoutuu joustavasti omien vahvuuksiesi ja kiinnostuksen kohteidesi mukaan.

Mitä toivomme sinun tuovan mukanasi?

Osaat haastaa asiakasta rakentavasti ja puhua mutkikkaista teknisistä asioista ymmärrettävästi. Viestit sujuvasti sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Viihdyt ympäristössä, jossa pääset itse vaikuttamaan toimintatapoihin – jos sinulla on hyviä ideoita, täällä pääset viemään ne suoraan käytäntöön.

Näillä Taidoilla Loistat Tehtävässä

  • Sinulla on vankkaa, käytännönläheistä kokemusta moderneista data-alustoista ja dataputkista Azure-ympäristössä.
  • Databricks, Snowflake & Fabric: Näiden teknologioiden osaamiselle on meillä iso tilaus! Toivomme sinulta vankkaa ymmärrystä Microsoft Fabricista. Kokemus Databricksin tai Snowflaken hyödyntämisestä on roolissa suuri etu, mutta ei ehdoton edellytys.
  • Tekoäly on sinulle luonteva työpari oman koodauksen ja asiantuntijatyösi tehostamisessa.

Mitä datatiimimme tarjoaa sinulle?

  • Vapaus ja vastuu: Saat meillä vastuuta juuri niin paljon kuin haluat ottaa. Luotamme tekijöihimme sataprosenttisesti, ja toimivien malliemme puitteissa saat vapaat kädet onnistua.
  • Olemme erityisen ylpeitä siitä, että moni tiimistämme maailmalle lähtenyt on palannut meille takaisin. Asiantuntijakulttuuriimme kuuluu olennaisesti yhdessä oppiminen: jaamme aktiivisesti näkemyksiä viikoittaisissa tiimitapaamisissa, ja varmistamme aina, että sinulla on tiimin tuki vaikeidenkin ongelmien edessä.
  • Meillä on tilaa kasvaa – esimerkiksi Data Engineeristä on erinomaiset polut edetä vaikkapa Data-arkkitehdiksi! Tuemme myös lämpimästi osaamisesi laajentamista uusien teknologioiden tai ERP-ratkaisujen suuntaan.
  • Toimistojamme löytyy yhdeksältä paikkakunnalta (mm. Tampereelta, Helsingistä ja Turusta). Toimistolle tullaan tapaamaan työkavereita, ei leimaamaan kellokorttia.

Mitä seuraavaksi?

Kuulostaako tämä sinun paikaltasi? Kerro meille hieman itsestäsi ja osaamisestasi. Emme sido hakua tiukkaan aikatauluun, vaan tavoitteemme on löytää juuri sinulle sopiva hetki hypätä mukaan tiimiin.

Näin Rekrytointiprosessimme Etenee

  • Keskustelu rekrytoijan kanssa: Lyhyt ja rento juttutuokio, jossa käymme läpi taustaasi, osaamistasi ja sitä, mikä sinua työelämässä innostaa. Samalla pääset kuulemaan tarkemmin meistä ja tästä roolista.
  • Kulttuurikeskustelu: Rento keskustelu, jossa fiilistelemme yhdessä, kohtaavatko toiveemme ja tavoitteemme. Kuulet lisää käytännön arjestamme ja pääset esittämään meillekin niitä tiukkoja kysymyksiä!
  • Tekninen keskustelu: Käytännönläheinen sparrailuhetki. Keskustelemme konkreettisten esimerkkien kautta siitä, millaisten ratkaisujen parissa olet aiemmin työskennellyt ja millaista osaamista tuot mukanasi.
  • Seuraavat askeleet: Tämän jälkeen etenemme joustavasti tilanteen mukaan (suoraan sopimusasioihin tai tarvittaessa vielä yhteen jatkokeskusteluun), jotta meillä molemmilla on varmasti luottavainen ja hyvä fiilis päätöksestä.

AI osana rekrytointiprosessiamme

Hyödynnämme tekoälyä osana rekrytointiprosessiamme, mutta vain työn tukena. Tekoäly auttaa meitä esimerkiksi työpaikkailmoitusten luonnostelussa, hakemusten esikäsittelyssä sekä haastattelumuistiinpanojen kokoamisessa. Sen tarkoitus on tehdä prosessista sujuvampi ja vapauttaa aikaa siihen, mikä on meille kaikkein tärkeintä: sinun kohtaamiseesi. Tekoäly ei koskaan tee arvioita tai päätöksiä itsenäisesti, vaan kaikki arviot ja valinnat tekee aina ihminen.

Lisätietoja Fellowmindista ja avoimista mahdollisuuksistamme antaa rekrytointikumppanimme Anton Virtanen (anton@ilmiotalent.fi)

title: Senior Data Migration+ Argus Safety+ Orcale PL/SQL consultant
description:
THE POSITION:

Technical Consultant plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System data migrations. The responsibilities of an data migration consultant, as outlined, involve various aspects of data migration, data management, automation, and collaboration with clients and source application data provider teams.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

Key Responsibilities:

  • Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Lead end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects involving migration of safety data from legacy safety systems databases into target safety systems.
  • Perform source system assessment, data profiling, gap analysis, and migration impact assessments to define migration strategies and project deliverables.
  • Analyze and convert PostgreSQL databases, schemas, tables, views, indexes, sequences, functions, triggers, and stored procedures into Oracle Database/Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB) while ensuring data integrity and optimal performance.
  • Design and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, transformation rules, migration specifications, and data conversion documentation.
  • Develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts to support data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), reconciliation, validation, and migration reporting activities.
  • Perform data extraction, cleansing, standardization, transformation, and loading activities while ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Execute database schema conversion and optimize migrated database objects for Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
  • Conduct comprehensive data validation and reconciliation between source and target systems to verify successful migration of all pharmacovigilance data.
  • Support migration of safety entities including Cases, Products, Events, Licenses, Studies, Regulatory Reports, Literature, Users, Workflow Data, Attachments, and Configuration Data.
  • Develop and execute migration validation plans, reconciliation reports, exception reports, and post-migration verification activities.
  • Participate and support in migration testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Performance Testing, and Production Validation.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve migration issues related to data quality, database conversion, mapping discrepancies, application configurations, and system integrations.
  • Develop and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports and validation reports to support migration verification and operational reporting.
  • Collaborate with Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Business Analysts, Database Administrators, Validation Teams, and Oracle Support throughout migration projects.
  • Support system integrations between Oracle Argus Safety and external applications using APIs, web services, and interface technologies.
  • Ensure migrated data and system configurations comply with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA, ICH E2B(R3), GAMP 5, and organizational validation standards.
  • Prepare and maintain migration documentation including Migration Plans, Data Mapping Specifications, Validation Documents, Technical Design Documents, SOPs, and Migration Summary Reports.
  • Support Oracle Argus upgrades, cloud migrations, and database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
  • Mentor junior consultants and provide technical guidance on migration methodologies, database conversion techniques, and Oracle Argus best practices.

title: Center for Sundhed & Omsorg søger en Udviklingskonsulent med sygeplejefaglig baggrund (genopslag)
description:
Center for Sundhed & Omsorg søger en erfaren Udviklingskonsulent, der kan arbejde strategisk, samt facilitere og udvikle kerneopgaven i tæt samspil med ledelsen.

Guldborgsund kommunes kerneopgave:

"At styrke borgernes muligheder for at mestre egen tilværelse og, i samarbejde med borgeren, sikre at alle kan indgå i relevante fællesskaber."

Center for Sundhed & Omsorg er et ambitiøst og visionært center med et stærkt fokus på tværgående samarbejde og opgaveløsning, som målrettet arbejder med at skabe værdi for kommunens borgere.

Centret står overfor at skulle implementere Sundhedsreformen, hvor samarbejdet på tværs af sektorer udvikler sig markant. Samtidig skal vi forme fremtidens kommunale sygepleje og udvikle den borgernære sygepleje, som bliver en stadig vigtigere del af det nære sundhedsvæsen. Dette kalder på nye løsninger, analytisk skarphed og stærke sundhedsfaglige perspektiver. Centret arbejder derudover fortsat videre med Ældrereformen, hvor de kommunale sygeplejefaglige indsatser forventes at skulle inkluderes i løbet af 2027.

Link til information om Sundhedsreform

Link til information om Ældrereformen

VI TILBYDER

Vi tilbyder en stilling med høj kompleksitet, hvor dine erfaringer og kompetencer vil være efterspurgt og hvor dit faglige aftryk vil være tydeligt. Du indgår i et tværfagligt team med 16 kollegaer, hvor der er højt til loftet og værdifuld kollegial sparring.

Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af fremtidens kommunale sygepleje og i arbejdet med at omsætte Sundhedsreformens ambitioner til konkrete løsninger tæt på borgerne.

Der er tale om et job, hvor innovation, mening og partnerskaber er vigtige for at skabe de rette betingelser for udviklingen af det nære sundhedsvæsen. Det er samtidig en stilling, hvor du bidrager til at understøtte de politiske, strategiske og organisatoriske mål og beslutninger.

Du er en del af en helhed, hvor samarbejde, dialog og inddragelse er nøglebegreber i at få organisationen til at fungere.

HOVEDOPGAVER

  • Understøtte centrets strategiske arbejde.
  • Understøtte udviklingen af fremtidens kommunale sygepleje.
  • Udvikle og sikre fremdrift i at forbedre patientsikkerheden samt kvalitets- og forbedringsarbejde med fokus på sammenhængende borgerforløb.
  • Understøtte implementeringen af Sundhedsreformen og nye sundhedsfaglige indsatser.
  • Understøtte implementeringen af den kommunale demensstrategi.
  • Være uddannelsesansvarlig for sygeplejerskeuddannelsen i kommunalt regi og for specialuddannelsen i borgernær sygepleje.

OM DIG

  • Du har gerne erfaring med tilsvarende opgaver.
  • Du brænder for udviklingen af fremtidens kommunale sygepleje og motiveres af at omsætte nationale reformer til lokal praksis.
  • Du kan arbejde systematisk med kvalitetsudvikling, forbedringer og udvikling af nye sundhedsfaglige løsninger.
  • Du har viden om, og erfaring med, at være ansat i en politisk styret organisation.
  • Du kan facilitere processer og skabe dialoger og gode samarbejdsrelationer.
  • Du kan anvende IT-systemer og styringsredskaber.

KVALIFIKATIONER

  • Du er uddannet sygeplejerske og har en relevant master- eller kandidatuddannelse.
  • Du har erfaring med, eller interesse for, udvikling af kommunal sygepleje samt kvalitetsudvikling og implementering af nye sundhedsfaglige indsatser.
  • Du har indsigt i sygeplejefaglig praksis og erfaring med kvalitets-, udviklings- eller forbedringsarbejde.
  • Du er en god sparringspartner.
  • Du har kørekort.

Kan du se dig selv som en nøglespiller i udviklingen af fremtidens kommunale og borgernære sygepleje, er du i stand til at se helheder, navigere i komplekse opgaver og omsætte strategiske ambitioner til praksis, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

ANSÆTTELSESPROCES

Ansættelsesudvalget består af funktionslederen af Myndighed, Hjælpemiddeldepot, Udvikling & Uddannelse, funktionslederen af Hjemme- & Sygeplejen samt ledelses- og medarbejderrepræsentanter. Yderligere oplysninger om ansættelsesudvalgets medlemmer vil fremgå af indkaldelsen til samtale.

Ansøgningsfrist

Ansøgningsfristen er tirsdag den 20. oktober 2026 kl. 23.59.

Samtaler

Samtaler afholdes fredag den 23. oktober 2026.

Der vil indgå en case til samtalen.

Der indhentes referencer efter aftale.

Løn og ansættelse

Efter gældende overenskomst. Stillingen er til besættelse snarest muligt.

Det er en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt.

I forbindelse med en eventuel ansættelse vil der blive indhentet straffeattest.

Stillingen er organiseret i Team Udvikling med reference til funktionslederen af Myndighed, Hjælpemiddeldepot, Udvikling & Uddannelse. Du vil som konsulent blive en del af en medarbejdergruppe som, sammen med det øvrige center, arbejder på tværs for at lykkes med kerneopgaven:

Ansættelsessted

Rådhuset, Parkvej 37, 4800 Nykøbing F.

Yderligere information

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Funktionsleder af Myndighed, Hjælpemiddeldepot, Udvikling & Uddannelse Steffen Holtze på telefon 25180330 eller shol@guldborgsund.dk

Eller

Funktionsleder af Hjemme- & Sygeplejen Marina Wichmand Nielsen på telefon 25181304 eller mwn@guldborgsund.dk.

Du kan også læse mere på Guldborgsund Kommunes hjemmeside: . Her kan du blandt andet se information om kommunen og dens politiske og administrative organisering samt politikker med mere.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Bij TenneT zoeken we professionals die bijdragen aan een effectieve en toekomstbestendige projectorganisatie. We verwachten dat je de juiste ervaring en vaardigheden hebt om een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan ons team en onze missie. Daarom vragen we van jou:

Om in deze rol écht het verschil te maken, herken jij jezelf in de volgende competenties en ervaring:

  • Je bent vertrouwd met cloud object storage-oplossingen, zoals MinIO of Amazon S3, en hebt ervaring met moderne databases, waaronder PostgreSQL en TimescaleDB.
  • Je hebt ruime ervaring met het ontwerpen en realiseren van geavanceerde dataproducten en weet jouw kennis en expertise effectief over te dragen aan collega-engineers.
  • Een pré is ervaring met data-intensieve applicaties, zoals oplossingen voor time-series data, analytics en real-time dataverwerking.
  • Je voelt je thuis in een agile, multidisciplinair team en je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige software delivery lifecycle, van ontwerp en ontwikkeling tot beheer en optimalisatie.

Deze rol valt binnen het functieprofiel Data Engineer zodat voor jou én TenneT helder is welke verantwoordelijkheden, verwachtingen en groeimogelijkheden bij deze functie horen.

title: Contract Compliance Coordinator
description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Contract Compliance Coordinator

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Contract Compliance Coordinator at our rental facility in Rayville, LA, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. You may be asked to assist with other duties as needed.

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

  • Company events, food truck nights, and monthly team dinners

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

  • See challenges as opportunities

  • Embrace change and continuous improvement

  • Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of inventory management, accounts payable, or receivables experience

  • You’re a great listener and care about solving your customer’s problems

  • You’re energized by building, nurturing and maintaining relationships with customers throughout every step of the rental process

  • You have strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. title: Senior Production Project Manager - Retail Account Experience
description:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

For more information, visit WPP.com.

WPP PRODUCTION IS LOOKING FOR A SENIOR PRODUCTION PROJECT MANAGER / RETAIL ACCOUNT EXPERIENCE PER PROJECT

What does a Senior Production Manager do at WPP Production?

Their main role is to ensure that clients' expectations are met and exceeded by delivering high-quality products and services on time and within budget. The Senior Production Manager will oversee leading and managing multiple projects in a multidisciplinary production environment. Production and post-production workflows knowledge are necessary.

Key Responsibilities

  • Builds and interprets client briefs properly to set the correct tasks for the internal operational teams according to the activities needed such as creativity, animation, filming, audio, programming, retouching, composing.
  • Lead production projects for High-End Production, Content Production, Print and Postproduction both for digital and non-digital channels.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients. They act as the primary point of contact for clients, handling all their inquiries and ensuring that their needs are met. They work closely with clients to understand their requirements, provide guidance within the production process, and offer solutions that will enhance their experience with the company.
  • Managing multiple projects simultaneously. They oversee the entire production process from start to finish, ensuring that all projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction. They coordinate with other team members, including the production manager, creative director, and technical teams, to ensure that projects are executed efficiently.

  • Prepares projects overages in case they apply.
  • Identifying and resolving any issues that may arise during the production process. They use their problem-solving skills to find solutions quickly and effectively, ensuring that projects are completed on time and within budget.
  • Makes sure client deliverables comply with size, format, and quality to be deployed on digital and non-digital channels.
  • Overall, a Senior Production Manager plays a critical role in ensuring that clients receive high-quality products and services. They are responsible for managing the end-to-end production process, from client onboarding to project delivery, and ensure that all stakeholders are kept informed throughout the process.

Requirements

  • B.A or B.B.A in Film Production, Communication, Marketing and Advertising or Business Administration.
  • Knowledge and experience on production, postproduction, trafficking workflows including production process and deliverable format for video, digital and print materials.
  • Promote Teamwork.
  • More than 5 years of experience in a similar position
  • English proficiency

Skills

  • Production and project manager knowledge, resources, and stakeholder basic management
  • Passionate and curious about all aspects of the business, proactive self-starter, who doesn’t want to be told what to do and is resourceful in finding solutions.

#LI-Hybrid

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. title: Sr. Supply Chain Planner (Starship)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SUPPLY CHAIN PLANNER (STARSHIP)

This is a high-profile, cross functional position that plays an integral role in enabling production flow and supporting launch manifest. Working in close coordination with engineering and manufacturing departments, supply chain planners execute effective, creative, and smart supply chain strategies to achieve production goals. Some of the functions a supply chain planner will be responsible for include material requirements planning, change management and forecast modeling. Supply Chain Planners will play a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet the ambitious growth targets and greatly contribute in making us a multi-planetary species.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for managing and continuously improving both demand and supply plans associated with the Starship design group
  • Maintain accuracy and audit bill of materials in MRP systems in preparation for production at rate
  • Align demand signals and allocations, maintaining product master data and developing expertise in in-house systems and reports
  • Coordinate with engineering, production, and quality organizations to determine change cut in and reduce obsolescence of material
  • Monitor spend to ensure adherence to project-specific budgets and forecasts
  • Analyze supply chain data and report out metrics
  • Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships across disciplines and multiple levels of management
  • Guide junior staff members in some aspects of their jobs and provides strategic support whenever needed

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced degree; or bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:
    • Engineering
    • Purchasing
    • Contract negotiation
    • Material or production planning
    • Operations or supply chain management
    • Material cost control
    • Master production scheduling

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Technical knowledge of Warpdrive
  • Ability to influence
  • Proven track record of taking ownership and driving results
  • Exceptional analytical, problem solving, and organizational skills
  • Effective written, verbal and presentation communication skills
  • Detail-oriented, self-motivated and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment
  • Conducts all activities with the highest level of integrity

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to travel - up to 30% work week travel may be required, including international travel
  • Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones
  • This position is based in Hawthorne, CA and requires being onsite - remote work not considered

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 1: $85,000.00 - $110,000.00
Level 2: $100,000.00 - $135,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
location: Remote - USA; Santa Clara, California, USA
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This is a remote (USA) role, reporting to the Manager AI Platform and Data Science in the AI Platform and Data Science department. This team’s mission is high-fidelity risk identification in customer data. Our goals are to catch all threats while minimizing noise. To do this, you will develop solutions applying data analysis and threat-research, while using AI, machine learning, and data engineering to build quality, data-driven components to automate security analysis.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Translate risk identification methods into agent logic, understanding the benefits and limitations of agents, and how to ensure quality in different types of tasks, including risk analysis, explanations, and recommendations
  • Collaborate closely with threat-research to understand data and threats and their approach to developing security heuristics
  • Identify and solve data requirements for analysis, developing and collaborating with data engineering teams for pipelines, enrichments, and aggregations
  • Follow a data-driven quality approach to threat-detection: including backtesting, balancing precision vs recall, tuning, and quality control
  • Deploy and monitor your solutions in production in our CI/CD framework

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing unstructured dynamic environments as raw material to create meaningful solutions.
  • You act like an owner with a deep passion for the mission, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution to drive outcomes with integrity.
  • You possess a true growth mindset, continuously developing your skills and actively seeking feedback to become a stronger partner and impact-driven teammate.
  • You serve as a positive force, approaching complex technical challenges with contagious constructive energy that inspires your team to stay solution-focused.
  • You are relentlessly data-driven, leveraging analytics and empirical evidence over assumptions to measure what matters and guide informed decisions.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Experience building LLM-powered agents in production: tool and function calling, prompt and context engineering, multi-step orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent), and evaluation of non-deterministic output against ground truth
  • 3+ years of professional Python development, with demonstrated ability to design and maintain production-quality systems with validated inputs, data contracts, and comprehensive unit and integration tests, alongside hands-on expertise with SQL and Python data analytics libraries (e.g., pandas, Polars, NumPy)
  • Demonstrated ownership of production reliability: CI/CD, containerization, structured logging and metrics, observability and alerting, on-call participation, and incident debugging in a live distributed system, with familiarity with cloud and infrastructure-as-code in an AWS environment

title: Senior Data Scientist - Clearance Required
description:
Overview

The Data Scientist – SME will serve as the lead technical expert for optimization and advanced analytics within the portfolio. This role will own the design and implementation of prescriptive analytics solutions—especially optimization models—that set safety stock levels, recommend resupply quantities, and balance risk and cost across the supply chain. The SME will work closely with logisticians, ammunition SMEs, and data engineers to operationalize prescriptive decision support tools in Army Vantage and related environments.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Continue to improve of processes that:
    • Recommend ideal resupply quantities by installation and ammunition type.
    • Align regional inventory to demand, reduce excess shipments and storage waste, and safeguard against stock-outs.
  • Advance the Army along the analytics continuum from descriptive/diagnostic to predictive/prescriptive analytics, ensuring models are operationally actionable.
  • Work closely with logistician and ammunition SMEs to formulate, implement, and tune linear, mixed-integer, stochastic, and multi-objective optimization models that consider:
    • Forecasted demand (unit forecasts and ML-based forecasts) and available depot stock
    • Transportation costs, storage constraints, and depot capacity.
    • Additional optimization constraints, decision variables, and objectives that reflect real-world policies, doctrine, and operational constraints:
    • Readiness priorities and surge requirements.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to ensure pipelines provide clean, timely input data and to embed optimization models into the application and Vantage workflows.
  • Design and implement model performance metrics and KPIs and conduct near real-time monitoring of model impact.
  • Lead experimentation, scenario analysis, and sensitivity studies.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to journeyman data scientists, guiding best practices in modeling and optimization.
  • Support briefings to senior Army leadership and stakeholders, clearly explaining model design, trade-offs, and operational impact.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in operations research, industrial engineering, applied mathematics, statistics, computer science, or related quantitative field; masters or PhD.
  • 7+ years of experience in advanced analytics, operations research, or data science, with direct responsibility for optimization model design and deployment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in:
    • Linear and mixed-integer optimization, stochastic optimization, and/or robust optimization.
    • Modeling tools and libraries (e.g., Pyomo, Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, or similar).
    • Integrating optimization models with predictive models (e.g., ML-driven demand forecasts).
  • Proven experience translating complex mission and business objectives into formal optimization formulations and delivering production-caliber solutions.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams (data engineers, logisticians, software developers, and mission owners) in an Agile environment.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including experience briefing senior leaders and explaining trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
  • Active SECRET clearance; U.S. citizenship required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience in DoD logistics, supply chain, or munitions management; familiarity with Army ammunition systems and processes.
  • Prior work with enterprise data platforms (e.g., Army Vantage, Army Data Platform) and AWS GovCloud or similar secure cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with model lifecycle management, including validation, verification, and continuous improvement processes in operational environments.
  • PMP and/or SAFe/Agile certifications

Target salary range: $145,000-$180,000

title: Fire Sprinkler Inspector
description:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Job Overview

Jensen Hughes is seeking an experienced Fire Sprinkler Inspector with a strong background in fire sprinkler systems ensuring proper installation, maintained, and compliant with safety codes to work at the TSMC facility in Phoenix, AZ. The position requires technical depth, sound judgment, and the ability to interface effectively with clients.

Position Summary

The Fire Sprinkler Inspector is responsible for on-site inspection, verification, and documentation of fire sprinkler system installations at a large-scale manufacturing facility under construction. This role ensures that all fire sprinkler systems are installed in accordance with approved drawings, applicable codes and standards, project specifications, and company quality requirements. This role serves as a key liaison between field crews, project management, engineering, and the Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ).

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct regular inspections of fire sprinkler systems, including pipes, valves, sprinkler heads, and control panels, to ensure proper operation and compliance with local, state, and national fire codes
  • Test and evaluate system functionality, including alarms, control valves, and piping systems, and perform maintenance or recommend corrective actions as needed
  • Identify potential fire hazards and document deficiencies in detailed reports, including photographs and notes
  • Collaborate with engineers, maintenance teams, and contractors to address fire safety concerns and provide guidance on proper system maintenance
  • Educate staff on fire sprinkler system operation, maintenance, and testing procedures
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections, repairs, and system performance for compliance and safety audits

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain detailed inspection records, daily reports, and photographic documentation.
  • Support preparation of inspection reports, deficiency lists, and closeout documentation.
  • Assist with test documentation, including hydrostatic tests, flushes, and acceptance testing.

Coordination & Communication

  • Coordinate with installation crews, subcontractors, project managers, and engineers to resolve field issues
  • Interface with AHJs, third-party inspectors, and client representatives during inspections and acceptance testing
  • Communicate schedule impacts, quality concerns, and field observations clearly and professionally

Safety & Compliance

  • Enforce jobsite safety policies and ensure inspections are conducted in compliance with site safety requirements
  • Identify unsafe conditions related to fire protection work and escalate as necessary
  • Support company and site-specific quality and safety programs

Project Support

  • Assist with constructability reviews and field verification prior to inspections
  • Participate in punch list development and system turnover activities
  • Provide technical input to project teams based on field observations

Qualifications

Required

  • Experience in fire sprinkler inspection, installation, or quality control within commercial or industrial construction environments
  • Working knowledge of NFPA standards (e.g., NFPA 13, 14, 20, 24, 25)
  • Ability to read and interpret construction documents, shop drawings, and specifications
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills
  • Proficiency with basic computer applications (e.g., Microsoft Office, inspection/reporting tools)
  • Ability to work full-time on an active construction site

Preferred

  • NICET certification (any level) in Fire Protection Engineering Technology
  • Experience on large manufacturing, industrial, or mission-critical facilities
  • Prior experience interacting with AHJs and third-party inspectors
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Ability to walk active construction sites, climb ladders, access elevated work areas, and work in varying weather conditions
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds as required
  • Extended periods of standing, walking, and visual inspection

Relocation assitance provided

title: Servicemedarbejdere til rengøring i Fields shopping center - 15 timer pr. uge
description:

Forenede Service søger to servicemedarbejdere til vores kunde Fields shopping center, Arne Jacobsens Allé 12, 2300 København S.

Stillingen er på 15 timer om ugen og mødetiden er mandag til fredag fra kl. 05.00 til 08.00.

  • Du er mødestabil, kvalitetsbevidst og har øje for detaljen
  • Du giver en ekstra hånd, når der er brug for det
  • Du ønsker at være del af et team, som bidrager til fællesskabet

Vi tilbyder

  • Startløn og eventuelle tillæg jf. Serviceoverenskomsten
  • Pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring
  • Grundig oplæring samt mulighed for dansk kursus, AMU-kurser eller erhvervsuddannelse med løn
  • En arbejdsplads, der hylder forskellighed
  • Et trygt og sikkert arbejdsmiljø med faste procedurer

Vores værdier udgør fundamentet for vores kultur og er: Ansvar - Engagement - Omtanke

Det betyder, at vi tager ansvar for at sikre, at der er gjort ordentligt rent og vedligeholdt så vi leverer kvalitetsservice hos vores kunder. Vi viser engagement ved at have et professionelt udtryk, som betyder at vi fremtoner ordentligt og præsentabelt og bruger de metoder der oplæres i. Vi bruger omtanke ved at vise hensyn og respekt for de mennesker vi møder, og som vi hver dag gør en forskel for.

Du søger ved at klikke på den blå knap "Ansøg". Du bedes uploade CV og ansøgning.

Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Dragan Avramovic på mail drav@forenede.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Forenede Service A/S er en mangfoldig virksomhed, der beskæftiger ca. 3.000 medarbejdere, som repræsenterer +80 forskellige nationaliteter. Vores medarbejdere servicerer flere hundredtusinder personer, når de dagligt leverer services inden for rengøring, kantine og ejendomsdrift til offentlige og erhvervsvirksomheder i Danmark.

title: Site Reliability Engineer III (DBA)
description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Site Reliability Engineer III (DBA) to join our team!

About the Role:

Individuals fulfilling this role will be responsible for ensuring the stability, scalability, and reliability of our production database systems, primarily Vitess (distributed MySQL) and Cassandra, alongside the rest of our production services and infrastructure. This role carries the same on-call, incident response, and service ownership expectations as other SRE IIIs, with database systems serving as the area of deepest technical ownership.

Because our SRE Database Engineering function is new, this role will also help establish its operational foundation by designing database architecture and developing the runbooks, escalation guidance, procedures, and training materials that our Level 1 and Level 2 SRE Database Engineers will use as they onboard. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with production database systems, Linux, automation, distributed systems, Kubernetes, observability, and incident response, with a proactive approach to reliability and operational excellence.

What You'll Do:

  • Database Architecture & Administration:
    • Design, deploy, and own highly available database architecture for Vitess (distributed MySQL) and Cassandra
    • Establish and document operational procedures, runbooks, and escalation guidance for Level 1 and Level 2 SRE Database Engineers
    • Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, schema design, and capacity planning
    • Own database backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery strategies
    • Perform and validate disaster recovery testing and database recovery procedures
    • Drive database security, access control, patching, hardening, and compliance practices
    • Partner with the DBA and Data Infrastructure teams on resharding, capacity planning, replication, and architecture decisions for sharded MySQL environments
  • Service Reliability & Operations:
    • Support the availability and durability of critical services across production environments
    • Monitor service health using SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring, logging, and alerting platforms
    • Partner with service owners to define and improve SLIs, SLOs, error budget policies, and alerting
    • Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews
    • Serve as an escalation point for complex database production incidents
    • Follow established ITIL/OSS processes including incident, change, problem, and capacity management
    • Take ownership of operational issues and drive projects from problem discovery through resolution
  • Automation & Tooling:
    • Develop automation for common operational and database administration tasks to reduce manual intervention and operational toil
    • Contribute to monitoring, logging, and alerting frameworks including Prometheus, Grafana, Catchpoint, and ELK
    • Help integrate operational runbooks and incident response workflows with FireHydrant
    • Work with CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and infrastructure as code tools including Terraform, Ansible, and Jenkins
    • Develop scripts using Bash, Python, Go, or similar technologies to improve reliability and operational efficiency
    • Operate and troubleshoot containerized production environments using Kubernetes and Docker
    • Work within Kubernetes and Vitess environments using technologies such as kubectl, mysqlsh, and Vitess keyspaces
  • Project Management:
    • Lead Production Readiness Reviews (PRRs) for functionality being handed off from engineering partner teams
    • Support the operational readiness of new database-backed services before they enter production
    • Build training plans, onboarding materials, and technical documentation for new Level 1 and Level 2 SRE Database Engineers
    • Partner with Engineering, Product, Operations, and DBA/Data Infrastructure teams on reliability initiatives
    • Assist with capacity planning, disaster recovery exercises, database migrations, and infrastructure projects
    • Work with vendors and service providers to troubleshoot service issues and track SLA performance
    • Identify opportunities for automation and process efficiency
  • Incident response
    • Respond to and resolve production database, infrastructure, and service incidents
    • Troubleshoot and escalate database, Linux, networking, application, and infrastructure issues as needed
    • Participate in the on-call rotation and serve as an escalation point for database-related incidents
    • Lead or contribute to root cause analysis and post-incident reviews
    • Identify recurring issues and develop long-term corrective actions to improve reliability
  • What we value:
    • A proactive mindset with a can-do attitude
    • Someone who can work independently, take ownership, and drive complex technical problems through resolution
    • Someone who steps up, supports teammates, mentors others, and shares knowledge freely
    • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn new technologies
    • Curiosity, reliability, and a desire to improve the reliability and scalability of production systems

Required Qualifications:

  • 6–8 years of experience in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, infrastructure operations, database engineering, or similar roles, with meaningful experience supporting production database systems.
  • Deep hands-on experience with MySQL and distributed or sharded database systems.
  • Experience with Vitess in a production environment strongly preferred.
  • Experience administering and supporting NoSQL databases such as Cassandra.
  • Experience designing high-availability database architecture, replication topology, backup strategies, and disaster recovery processes.
  • Strong SQL skills, including query performance analysis, indexing, schema design, and troubleshooting.
  • Solid Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience with security-focused operations including patching, system hardening, access controls, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Strong understanding of service reliability concepts including monitoring, alerting, incident response, root cause analysis, SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets.
  • Experience working with containers and orchestration platforms including Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Comfortable operating in Kubernetes and Vitess environments using tools such as kubectl, mysqlsh, and Vitess keyspaces.
  • Experience with infrastructure and configuration management technologies including Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, and HashiCorp products such as Vault and Nomad.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Experience establishing operational procedures, runbooks, documentation, and escalation processes.
  • Experience mentoring, training, or helping onboard engineers into complex technical environments.
  • Experience in SaaS, cloud services, service provider, or large-scale distributed systems environments preferred.
  • Experience with AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar cloud platforms preferred.
  • Familiarity with ITIL/OSS practices and SLA/SLO management preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Backblaze Perks:

  • Healthcare for family, including dental and vision
  • Competitive compensation and 401K
  • RSU grants for full-time employees
  • ESPP program
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Maternity & paternity leave
  • MacBook Pro to use for work, plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation
  • Childcare bonus (human children only)
  • Fertility treatment and support
  • Learning & development program
  • Commuter benefits
  • Culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Who we are:

Glydways is reimagining what public transit can be. We believe that mobility is the gateway to opportunity—connecting people to housing, education, employment, commerce, and care. By making transportation more accessible, affordable, and sustainable, we empower communities to thrive and unlock economic and social prosperity.

Our mission is to revolutionize transit with a solution that delivers high capacity, exceptional user experiences, unmatched affordability, and minimal environmental impact.

The Glydways system is a groundbreaking network of carbon-neutral, interconnected transit pathways powered by standardized autonomous vehicles on dedicated roadways. Operating 24/7 with on-demand access, it offers personalized and efficient mobility—without the burden of heavy upfront infrastructure costs or ongoing taxpayer subsidies.

With Glydways, we’re building more than a transportation system; we’re creating a future where everyone, everywhere, has the freedom to move.

Meet the team:

The Embedded Software team is where the vehicle comes to life. We write and load the firmware that turns raw hardware—sensor kits, custom boards, and main compute—into a reliable, safety-critical machine. Because our software touches nearly every subsystem, we collaborate with engineers from across the company and get hands-on with the newest hardware in the building.

About the Role:

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will own critical firmware domains, lead complex cross-functional projects, and help shape our embedded platform and engineering best practices. This is firmware that carries real passengers - on a Glydways vehicle, reliability is a safety requirement, not just a performance goal, and the code you ship is part of the safety case.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Design, prototype, build, and test production vehicle firmware for safety-critical systems.
  • Develop and optimize applications in RTOS environments, tuning for reliability, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and power on resource-constrained platforms.
  • Own and evolve the communication architecture between MCUs, sensors, and main compute, across both standard and custom protocols (SPI, UART, I2C, CAN, TCP/UDP, and more).
  • Lead bring-up and debugging for new boards and SoCs—bootloaders, drivers, and low-level diagnostics—partnering with electrical engineers and software developers to take new sensor and compute platforms from prototype to production.
  • Define and build automated testing frameworks and harnesses at the unit, integration, and system levels alongside test and platform engineers.
  • Mentor other embedded engineers, give thorough code reviews, and help set engineering standards, tools, and best practices across the team.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Core technical skills

  • Expert-level C and/or C++ for embedded systems; additional languages and tooling are a plus.
  • Strong command of communication protocols, from low level (SPI, UART, I2C, CAN) to higher level (TCP/UDP).
  • Experience developing on RTOS environments (e.g., PX5 or other POSIX/pthreads-based real-time OSes such as embedded Linux with pthreads, QNX, VxWorks, or RTEMS).
  • Experience with MCU bootloaders, device drivers, and new board or SoC bring-up.
  • Experience deploying firmware to multi-device systems or vehicles in a power-safe, fault-tolerant way.
  • Demonstrated speed and size optimization for resource-constrained platforms.

Process and quality

  • Experience with safety-critical systems and processes (e.g., ISO 26262 or similar standards) is highly valued.
  • Solid understanding of the embedded software development life cycle—version control, code review, CI, and automated testing.

Nice to have

  • Experience in automotive and/or transit domains.
  • Experience with automotive-grade safety MCUs — ideally the NXP S32K3 family, or comparable lockstep/ASIL-rated parts (e.g., Infineon AURIX, TI TMS570).
  • Familiarity with kernel internals and low-level OS concepts.
  • Experience with deterministic timing and networking, such as NTP, PTP, or time-sensitive networking (TSN).
  • Experience with CAN tooling and DBC-based workflows.
  • Comfort with electronics test equipment and hardware debugging (multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, etc.).
  • Scripting experience (e.g., Python) for test automation and tooling.

Typical experience

  • Typically 7+ years developing embedded software for production systems, including substantial work on safety-critical or highly reliable platforms (automotive, aerospace, medical, industrial, robotics, etc.).

*If you’re excited about this work but don’t check every box, we’d still love to hear from you. We know the best candidates don’t always match every line of a job description.

title: Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
Jenni Kayne is a California-based lifestyle brand that aims to empower an elevated approach to everyday living. Whether it's our edited style ethos or coveted interiors sensibility, we work hard to create a world that's inviting and intentional. From our stores across the country to our operations and corporate teams, we believe in the power of a workplace built on diversity and inclusion—where the varied voices and viewpoints of our community pave the way.

About the Role

The Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) is a strategic partner to the CFO and executive leadership team, leading FP&A and translating company priorities into financial frameworks that drive growth and profitability across retail, e-commerce, and wholesale channels. This leader builds and develops a high-performing team, embeds financial discipline across the organization, and serves as a trusted advisor to the Board and executive leadership.

Role and Responsibilities

As the Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis, your primary responsibilities include the following:

Business Strategy

  • Partner with the CFO and executive leadership team to shape and evolve the company's long-range strategic and financial plans.
  • Translate company-wide strategic priorities into financial frameworks, business cases, and investment analyses that inform executive and Board decision-making.
  • Lead evaluation of new business opportunities, including new channels, markets, product categories, and store growth, providing rigorous financial modeling and risk assessment.
  • Lead capital allocation frameworks that prioritize investment across stores, technology, marketing, and product.
  • Act as a trusted strategic advisor to department heads across merchandising, retail, e-commerce, marketing, and supply chain, ensuring financial discipline is embedded in decision-making.

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Own the annual budgeting process and rolling forecasts (monthly, quarterly, and long-range), ensuring alignment with company strategy and growth targets.
  • Build and maintain financial models covering revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, headcount, and capital investment across all business channels.
  • Deliver monthly and quarterly business reviews, providing variance analysis, KPI tracking, and clear narratives on business performance versus plan.
  • Lead scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to help leadership navigate uncertainty and make informed, data-driven decisions.
  • Oversee cash flow forecasting, working capital management, and capital expenditure planning.
  • Partner with Accounting to ensure alignment between forecasts, actuals, and month-end close, maintaining data integrity across systems.

Retail & Omnichannel Economics

  • Own store-level P&L and four-wall profitability analysis, including new store pro formas, payback and ROI tracking, and post-opening performance reviews against underwriting.
  • Partner with Real Estate and Retail leadership on lease evaluation, renewals, relocations, and closures.
  • Analyze omnichannel economics, including the halo effect of stores on e-commerce, cross-channel customer behavior, and fulfillment and return costs by channel.

Merchandise & Inventory Finance

  • Partner with Merchandising and Planning on open-to-buy, inventory investment, and receipt flow to balance growth, margin, and working capital.
  • Lead analysis of pricing, promotional, and markdown strategy and their impact on full-price sell-through and gross margin.
  • Monitor inventory health metrics, including weeks of supply, aged inventory, and turn, and flag risks early.

Marketing & Customer Economics

  • Partner with Marketing to evaluate return on paid media and brand investment, including CAC, LTV, contribution margin by channel, and incrementality testing.
  • Build customer cohort and retention analyses to inform acquisition spend and clienteling investment.

Reporting, Systems & Methodology

  • Develop and continuously improve reporting infrastructure and dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into business performance.
  • Own the planning and reporting technology stack (e.g., NetSuite, Shopify, BI tools), including integration and data governance across systems.
  • Establish and document standard KPI definitions and calculation methodologies to ensure consistent, trusted reporting across the organization.
  • Evaluate and responsibly adopt automation and AI tools to improve forecasting accuracy and team efficiency.

Leadership & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing FP&A team, establishing best practices, processes, and career development paths.
  • Serve as a key liaison between Finance and functional business leaders, fostering a culture of financial accountability throughout the organization.
  • Present financial results and strategic recommendations clearly and persuasively to executive leadership and the Board, including preparation of Board materials.
  • Support relationships with investors and lenders, including covenant compliance and reporting.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, strategic finance, or corporate finance, including 5+ years leading teams.
  • Background in retail, apparel, luxury, or omnichannel direct-to-consumer brands strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience owning budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning at a growth-stage or scaling company.
  • Expert financial modeling skills, with deep understanding of store economics, inventory, and margin drivers.
  • Proficiency with ERP and BI systems (NetSuite experience a plus).
  • Exceptional communicator who can turn complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA and/or CPA preferred.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • A trusted, well-documented planning and forecasting process with consistent KPI definitions across the organization.
  • A clear store investment and capital allocation framework adopted by leadership.
  • Improved forecast accuracy and visibility into channel, inventory, and customer economics.
  • A strong, engaged FP&A team with defined roles and development paths.

Additional Notes:
This job description is not all inclusive. In addition, Kayne LLC dba Jenni Kayne reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Kayne LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

The annual base salary for this position is $175,000–$225,000. The base salary is determined by experience, education, skills, and location

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
description:
Primary Function of Position

We are seeking an experienced pricing analyst to serve as the senior analytical resource for pricing across Intuitive's full portfolio, spanning capital systems, instruments and accessories, service, and digital offerings, working at the intersection of Sales, Sales Operations, and Finance.

Pricing analytics is where the team's strategic position is built: quantifying how price, portfolio mix, and acquisition structure move margin, adoption, and customer economics. This role produces forward-looking analysis that shapes pricing structure before it is requested, rather than responding to individual quote requests.

The Senior Analyst supports business units bringing pricing proposals to the price council and other governing bodies, supplying the proposal analytics and presentation materials those decisions rest on while the business units own the recommendations themselves. Working across Sales, Sales Operations, Contracts, Financial Planning, and Product Marketing, this role converts transaction, utilization, and contract data into insight that senior commercial and finance leaders act on.

This position reports to the Director of Pricing and Customer Finance and is based in Atlanta, GA or Sunnyvale, CA.

Roles and Responsibilities

Portfolio Pricing Analytics

  • Lead proactive pricing analytics across the full portfolio, including capital systems, instruments and accessories, service, and digital offerings, surfacing margin and price-realization opportunities ahead of the annual pricing cycle rather than in response to individual deal requests.
  • Perform deep portfolio analytics covering price/mix, attach rates, and product utilization by market and customer segment to inform portfolio-level pricing decisions.
  • Identify and interpret trends in contract portfolios, capital pipeline, and procedure production datasets to uncover opportunities for accelerating da Vinci and Ion adoption.
  • Develop and recommend pricing structures that respond to growing global competition.

Pricing Science

  • Apply pricing science methods, including hypothesis design, elasticity testing, and willingness-to-pay analysis, across product lines, acquisition methods, and customer segments.
  • Use the scientific method to test pricing hypotheses and translate results into structural pricing recommendations.
  • Synthesize predictive analysis on customer lifetime margin.
  • Model comparative economics across acquisition methods, including lease versus purchase, to equip commercial teams with defensible customer-facing analysis.

Price Council and Pricing Governance

  • Provide the proposal analytics that support business units through the price council process, quantifying revenue, margin, and competitive impact for proposals those business units own.
  • Build the supporting analysis and presentation materials that carry pricing proposals to price council and other governing bodies.
  • Pressure-test analytical assumptions ahead of submission, surfacing sensitivities and trade-offs for the business unit's consideration.
  • Maintain the analytical standards and templates used in council submissions, and track approved decisions through to realized impact.

Analytical Infrastructure

  • Build and maintain the models, dashboards, and data foundation that make recurring analysis repeatable and self-service for stakeholders.
  • Establish deep understanding of the company's products, services, and pricing philosophies.
