title: Advisor, Reclamation & Ecology
description:
Classification: Grid 30, BCGEU Membership

Office Location: All BCER Locations

Salary: $91,036.23 – $103,922.02 – Permanent Full-Time, based on a 35-hour work week.
An additional 10.75% Job Family Market Multiplier will be added to the posted salary.
An additional 3% Location Allowance will be added to posted salary for employees based in Fort St John, Dawson Creek, Prince George, and Terrace.
An additional 13% Location Allowance will be added to posted salary for employees based in Fort Nelson.

About the Job:
The Advisor, Reclamation & Ecology (Advisor) provides technical expertise and coordination in planning and monitoring of the restoration of sites under the Orphan Site Reclamation Fund (OSRF), serving to mitigate financial and environmental risks associated with orphaned sites in British Columbia, returning ecological productivity from previous disturbances.

The Advisor supports and oversees both technical and relationship-based aspects of the collaborative partnerships with First Nations communities related to orphan site treatment and closure. This includes providing input on capacity building and technical training opportunities to support long-term success.

The Advisor is responsible for developing the technical plans and prescriptions for reclamation programs on orphan sites that restore terrestrial and aquatic habitat that is suitable for the land use. Working closely with the orphan restoration team and other BCER employees, the Advisor helps to implement the annual workplan through collaboration and expert input. The Advisor is expected to provide direction and expertise while building relationships with key partners, including landowners, First Nations, and industry.

Organization Chart:
Commissioner, Chief Executive Officer
Executive Vice President, Resource Management & Stewardship
Vice President, Environmental & Subsurface Resource Management
Executive Director, Orphans & Restoration
Director, Orphan Restoration
Manager, Restoration & Lands
Advisor, Reclamation & Ecology

Provide subject matter expertise and decision-support in the planning and delivery of orphan reclamation programs, understanding all facets of technical project delivery that decides the scope of multi-million-dollar project operations.

Provide guidance on budget, schedule, and technical components of closure activities, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and cost efficiency.

Collaborate with project managers and coordinators in the development and oversight of efficient, large-scale closure and reclamation programs, setting evaluation criteria and ensuring contractor’s meet professional standards.

Supervises external contractors in the delivery of work to ensure adherence to standards, as well as summer students to guide in their development.

Provide recommendations and implement actions on processes and procedures essential to the BCER’s role for the management of reclamation practices at orphan sites with a focus on restoring aquatic and terrestrial habitat values.

Provide expert analysis of orphan site conditions and develop recommendations to address questions and complaints, including recommendations for field- and office-based reviews and assessments.

Foster and maintain working relationships with various agencies and partners, including government, non-profit research organizations, and First Nations communities.

Maintain up to date knowledge of current research, ecological restoration practices, and relevant technologies to support innovation and knowledge sharing within the team, including pilot programs that inform industry practices.

Ensure the inventory of orphan sites is sufficiently reviewed to identify scope of work requirements as they become ready for program delivery.

Analyse future supply needs and challenges related to seed and planting feedstock, as well as resourcing requirements for project delivery.

Utilize a variety of environmental data, research, or monitoring to inform the reclamation treatment of orphan sites.

Provide expert information in response to external inquiries through engagement with industry, professionals, First Nations, members of the public, government agencies, and research organizations and academia.

Supervise Orphans & Restoration staff and ensure delivery of support for key aspects of the branch’s goals and outcomes.

Perform other related duties, as assigned.

Education:
A degree from a recognized post-secondary institution in a related field such as Engineering, Environmental Science, Biology, or Forestry, and at least five years of related experience.

An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Incumbent must be a qualified environmental professional, registered as a member in good standing with an organization operating under an act of the British Columbia legislature.

Experience:
Demonstrated experience in the evaluation, development, and technical execution of upstream oil and gas reclamation programs.

Demonstrated experience in stakeholder relations and building relationships.

Demonstrated experience with project management principles and tools.

Demonstrated experience leading or participating in, facilitations and conflict resolution with affected stakeholders.

Demonstrated experience working with and interpreting applicable environmental regulations, legislation and policy related to the energy sector and First Nations interests.

Demonstrated experience applying knowledge of current economic, socio-political and public affairs issues facing the oil and gas industry.

Demonstrated experience developing procedural manuals and supporting documentation.

Demonstrated experience applying technical knowledge related to cumulative effects, restoration and reclamation of industrial disturbances, First Nations environmental concerns in BC context is preferred.

Demonstrated experience with report writing and maintaining information databases.

Demonstrated experience using financial theory and principles for project budgeting and cost estimations.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements:
May be required to drive on low-grade roads, and work in challenging field conditions (which may include isolated areas, carrying equipment, and walking long distances over uneven terrain).

Key Competencies:
Building Strategic Alliances
The ability to incorporate knowledge and skills to engage in internal and external stakeholder analysis and to negotiate agreements and alliances based on a full understanding of power and politics.

Conflict Management
The ability to effectively identify, address, and work to resolve conflicts within the organization or externally. It involves managing risks, fostering positive working relationships, and promoting a collaborative and productive work environment.

Empowering Others
The ability to encourage and recognize others, support their professional development, and manage work assignments through effective delegation with the appropriate level of autonomy. It involves sharing responsibility to foster commitment and ownership, enabling individuals and groups to participate and contribute at high levels, be creative and innovative, take sound risks, and demonstrate individual leadership.

Flexibility and Adaptability
The ability and willingness to adjust to diverse situations and work effectively with a variety of individuals or groups. It involves understanding and appreciating different and opposing perspectives, adapting one’s approach as situations change, and accepting changes within one’s work. It also encompasses reacting positively to change and cooperating readily with revised methods and priorities in a changing work environment.

title: Operational Solution & Digital Specialist (Underwriting & Automation)
description:
• Develop the future of insurance operations through automation and digital innovation

  • Use your underwriting expertise to design smarter customer journeys and rules-engine decision pathways

  • Flexible hybrid working, attractive salary, annual bonus and insurance benefits

Partners Life is one of New Zealand's largest life and health insurance companies. As part of the Daiichi Life Group, a leading global insurance provider, we are writing our next chapter of growth and opportunity.

We're committed to challenging traditional ways of working, improving customer outcomes, and creating innovative solutions that make insurance easier, faster and more accessible for New Zealanders.

To help us achieve this, we're looking for an experienced Operational Solution & Digital Specialist to join our Service Enablement team within Operations.

About the opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a strong background in underwriting, insurance operations, business rules, or digital process design who wants to influence how insurance is delivered in the future.

Working at the intersection of Operations, Technology and Service Design, you'll identify opportunities to improve customer and adviser experiences by designing smarter digital journeys, decision pathways, workflows and automation solutions within key systems including rules engines.

You'll translate operational knowledge, customer needs and business strategy into practical digital solutions that improve straight-through processing, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and create better outcomes for customers.

Whether you're an experienced Underwriter looking to move into a broader transformation role, or you've already worked across operational design, digital solutions or automation initiatives, this role offers the chance to make a meaningful impact on how we work.

What you'll be doing

As our Operational Solution & Digital Specialist, you will:

  • Identify and shape opportunities to improve customer outcomes, operational performance and efficiency through technology-enabled solutions.

  • Design and continuously improve digital journeys, workflows, business rules, question sets, decision pathways, referrals and exception handling processes.

  • Partner closely with Underwriting, Claims, Customer Solutions, Operations and Technology teams to translate business requirements into effective operational solutions.

  • Support the design, testing, implementation and optimisation of new digital capabilities and workflow enhancements.

  • Drive initiatives that increase straight-through processing (STP), straight-through acceptance (STA), automation and service consistency.

  • Monitor solution performance and use operational insights to identify opportunities for ongoing improvement.

  • Contribute to business acceptance testing, implementation readiness and successful adoption of new solutions.

  • Ensure solutions incorporate appropriate controls, compliance obligations, auditability and risk management requirements.

About you

We're looking for someone who combines strong insurance knowledge with a passion for solving problems and improving customer outcomes.

You'll likely bring:

  • Experience in underwriting, claims, insurance operations, business analysis, process improvement or digital solution design within insurance or financial services.

  • Strong understanding of underwriting decision-making, referral frameworks, business rules, risk assessment and customer journeys.

  • Experience designing or improving workflows, automation solutions, digital forms, rules engines or operational processes.

  • Ability to translate complex operational requirements into clear business solutions and functional requirements.

  • Experience working with operational, technology and delivery teams through solution design, testing and implementation.

  • Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation and relationship-building skills.

  • A curious and analytical mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.

  • Understanding of operational risk, compliance and governance requirements within regulated environments.

You'll stand out if you have:

  • Life insurance underwriting experience.

  • Experience working with underwriting or claims rules engines.

  • Exposure to workflow automation, BPM platforms or digital transformation initiatives.

  • Experience improving STP, automation and operational efficiency outcomes.

What we offer

At Partners Life, we believe our people are our greatest asset and are proud to invest in their growth, wellbeing and success. As part of our team, you’ll have access to a range of benefits, with eligibility varying by benefit and employment type:

  • Comprehensive training and ongoing support

  • Genuine learning and development opportunities

  • Participation in our discretionary bonus scheme after 12 months’ service (permanent employees only)

  • Life insurance and income protection cover at our cost, plus discounted medical insurance (permanent employees only)

  • Birthday leave (where eligible)

  • Long service leave (permanent employees only)

  • Parental leave salary top-up, reduced hours options and secondary parental leave (permanent employees only)

  • Flexible hybrid working arrangements (where eligible)

  • A modern office with stunning views in the heart of Takapuna

Apply now

If you're an experienced insurance professional who enjoys solving operational challenges, improving customer journeys and shaping the future of digital insurance services, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply online with your CV and optional cover letter outlining your experience and interest in the role.

To be eligible for this position, you must have the legal right to work in New Zealand.

We are not engaging recruitment agencies for this role.

title: Mission Engineer II - Saratoga
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable. As a Mission Engineer II, you'll work directly alongside public safety agencies to turn real operational challenges into working technical solutions.

You'll spend time with the people doing the work, understand how the agency operates, identify problems worth solving, and use Axon tools, AI, automation, data, and the broader Axon ecosystem to build against them.

Building is the core of the role, but customer needs come first. Because you're embedded with the agency, you'll also become a go-to technical resource who understands their Axon environment and helps them navigate critical needs when they arise. You may help quarterback an upcoming deployment, coordinate a complex technical issue, or connect the right Axon teams around an agency priority.

You won't replace Support, Deployment, Product, or other teams. You'll bring technical continuity, help connect the dots, and use what you learn to identify the next opportunity to build something better. Mission Engineers don't measure success by activity. They measure it by what gets built, what gets used, and what changes because of it.

What You’ll Do

Location: On Site with travel
Reports To: Manager or Senior Manager of Mission Engineering

Discover the Mission

  • Embed with assigned agencies to understand their mission, people, workflows, systems, and priorities.
  • Develop broad knowledge of the Axon ecosystem and deeper expertise in the products deployed at your agency.
  • Work with frontline users, technical teams, and agency leadership to uncover operational friction.
  • Translate customer problems into clear technical requirements and measurable success criteria.
  • Identify opportunities for AI, automation, data, and Axon capabilities to improve how the agency operates.
  • Understand what the customer needs—not simply what they initially ask for.

Build With the Platform

  • Build applications, dashboards, workflows, automations, and using Axon products and other approved Axon tools.
  • Apply foundational software engineering concepts including APIs, data structures, scripting, testing, debugging, and version control.
  • Use AI and AI-assisted development tools responsibly within Axon's approved development and security environment.
  • Configure and extend capabilities across Axon's technology ecosystem.
  • Understand when you can solve the problem yourself and when deeper Product or Engineering partnership is required.
  • Build with Axon—not around it.

Transform Builds Into Outcomes

  • Move solutions from discovery into real customer use.
  • Test and iterate alongside the people who will actually use what you build.
  • Drive adoption and measure results against agreed success criteria.
  • Continue improving solutions until they create sustained operational value.
  • Document successful solutions so they can be maintained, improved, and reused.

Be the Agency's Go-To Technical Resource

  • Maintain a consistent onsite presence and deep understanding of the agency's Axon environment.
  • Lean into critical customer needs when your technical context or involvement can materially improve the outcome.
  • Help quarterback technical alignment around important deployments without replacing the teams responsible for deployment execution.
  • Serve as a liaison when complex technical issues require coordination beyond standard Support.
  • Help customers navigate capabilities across products such as Records, Fusus, AI Era, and the broader Axon ecosystem.
  • Connect the right resources across Product, Engineering, Support, Deployment, Training, Mission Operations, Mission Success, and Sales.
  • Continuously ask: What are we learning, what could work better, and what could we build so this is easier next time?
  • Return to the highest-value build opportunities once immediate customer needs are addressed.

Learn in the Field. Improve Axon.

  • Capture recurring customer needs, workflow patterns, and technical friction.
  • Share successful builds and lessons across Mission Engineering.
  • Bring platform limitations and customer insights back to Product and Engineering.
  • Identify solutions that could be reused by other MEs and agencies.

What You Bring

Required

  • Typically 3–5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, software engineering, systems, technical consulting, implementation engineering, or another hands-on technical role.
  • Foundational software engineering capability and demonstrated experience building technical solutions.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, scripting/ programming, data, testing, debugging, and modern development practices.
  • Understanding of AI concepts and practical applications.
  • Strong technical curiosity and ability to rapidly learn emerging platforms and tools.
  • Ability to solve ambiguous problems rather than simply execute predefined tasks.
  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Customer-facing mindset and curiosity about how organizations actually operate.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain CJIS compliance and satisfy applicable agency background requirements.
  • Ability to maintain the onsite presence required by the engagement.

Preferred

  • Experience with Python, JavaScript, SQL, REST APIs, cloud platforms, or modern frameworks.
  • Experience with AI platforms, workflow automation, low-code development, or data.
  • Experience in public safety, defense, military, intelligence, government, or other mission-critical environments.

What Success Looks Like

You can take a meaningful customer problem through:

Discover → Build → Transform

Given Axon's approved toolkit, and a problem worth solving, you can turn it into a working solution and demonstrate whether it created value. And when the agency needs you elsewhere, you lean in without losing the engineering mindset—help solve the immediate need, identify what can be improved, and return to building.

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
  • Discretionary paid time off
  • Paid parental leave for all
  • Medical, Dental, Vision plans
  • Fitness Programs
  • Emotional & Mental Wellness support
  • Learning & Development programs


Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit .

$96,000—$153,600 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

title: Sourcing Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
Amca is building America’s new industrial base. Since the 1990s, our ability to build new aviation and military systems and maintain the ones we already have has eroded. Today, the gap between what the nation needs to produce and what it is capable of producing is the largest it has been in generations.

To help close that gap, Amca rapidly develops and manufactures new critical components and subsystems required to build and sustain the planes, military vehicles, and core infrastructure America needs. Today, we operate seven factories nationwide, including our advanced prototyping and testing headquarters in El Segundo, and deliver avionics, hydraulic, and electrical components for platforms such as the F-35, F-16, F/A-18, 737MAX, 787, A320neo, A321, Mk-48, and M1 Abrams.

Sourcing Intern

El Segundo, CA · Intern · On-Site

Sourcing interns help Amca buy the parts and materials that go into every build, and make sure the factory floor is planned and stocked when builds need them. You'll follow hardware from purchase order to completion, help find and vet the suppliers behind our products, and get out to the occasional supplier shop to see how things are made.

You'll learn procurement, build planning, and supplier development by doing real work with real ownership, alongside a team that will teach you how it all fits together. No prior purchasing experience is required, and we appreciate strong operators.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Procurement

  • Support the full procurement cycle — source, quote, negotiate, and issue POs for hardware, raw materials, fabricated parts, and consumables
  • Help manage open orders end-to-end: track deliveries, update lead times, and expedite parts that are at risk of impacting the build schedule
  • Help resolve PO discrepancies with receiving, suppliers, and engineering — own the issue through to closure
  • Maintain accurate ERP/MRP data: open POs, lead times, pricing, vendor records, and part statuses
  • Identify cost and lead time improvement opportunities across the supply base

Build Planning & Part Tracking

  • Work from BOMs, work orders, and engineering requirements to plan material needs for active and upcoming builds
  • Track parts through the full lifecycle — from PO issuance through receiving, inspection, kitting, and build completion
  • Maintain visibility into build status and material readiness; surface shortages and schedule risks early
  • Coordinate with engineering, production, and receiving to keep part flow aligned with build priorities
  • Support traveler and documentation accuracy to ensure traceability through the build

Supplier Development

  • Help identify and onboard new suppliers across machining, injection molding, PCBAs, electronics, testing, assembly, and other processes as needed
  • Help conduct supplier vetting — evaluate capabilities, quality systems, capacity, and certifications
  • Join occasional supplier visits to assess shops firsthand and build relationships
  • Maintain and grow a reliable, high-performance vendor base that can scale with our manufacturing operations

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Are currently enrolled in a bachelor's or graduate program in supply chain management, industrial or mechanical engineering, business, or a related field
  • Are organized and can keep track of a long, constantly shifting list of orders and priorities
  • Are curious about how things get made, and comfortable learning to read a BOM or engineering drawing
  • Strong organizational skills — able to manage a large and constantly shifting queue of open orders and build priorities

title: Senior Systems Development Engineer
description:
Sphere Entertainment Co. is a leader in immersive experiences, technology and media. The Company includes Sphere, an experiential medium powered by advanced technologies. The first Sphere opened in Las Vegas, with a second venue planned for Abu Dhabi. In addition, the Company includes MSG Networks, which operates two regional sports and entertainment networks, MSG Network and MSG Sportsnet, as well as a direct-to-consumer and authenticated streaming product, MSG+, delivering a wide range of live sports content and other programming. More information is available at www.sphereentertainmentco.com.

Who are we hiring?

Sphere is seeking a Senior Systems Development Engineer to design, build, automate, and operate the infrastructure that powers our media production workflows. This role brings deep expertise in production technology spanning cloud infrastructure, render farms, virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), storage systems, networking, and video and audio transport.

As a senior individual contributor, you will own complex infrastructure initiatives from requirements and architecture through deployment and ongoing operation. You will partner with artists, pipeline developers, production teams, and engineering peers to solve ambiguous technical problems, improve reliability and performance, and deliver systems that meet demanding production schedules.

What do you need to succeed?

  • Own infrastructure delivery: Lead the design, implementation, and operation of interconnected production systems. Make technical tradeoffs, resolve dependencies, and deliver projects with minimal oversight.
  • Build cloud and hybrid platforms: Engineer secure compute, connectivity, identity, and container services across cloud and on-premises environments, balancing capacity, availability, and cost.
  • Scale render infrastructure: Develop and operate CPU and GPU render farms, including job scheduling, worker provisioning, software environments, licensing, and capacity management.
  • Enable remote production: Build and optimize GPU-enabled VDI and remote workstations, managing images, application delivery, access, session performance, and the artist experience.
  • Engineer storage and data movement: Deliver high-throughput shared and object storage, media transfer, caching, tiering, backup, and recovery for large production datasets.
  • Integrate networks and media transport: Design and troubleshoot production networking and video and audio transport, addressing bandwidth, latency, synchronization, multicast, redundancy, and signal integrity.
  • Develop software and automation: Write maintainable tools, services, and integrations. Use infrastructure as code, automated testing, code review, and deployment pipelines to make changes repeatable and safe.
  • Improve operational reliability: Establish monitoring, alerting, performance baselines, and recovery procedures. Lead complex incident investigations and implement durable fixes across system boundaries.
  • Guide technical decisions: Translate production needs into designs and delivery plans, evaluate technologies, and coordinate with security teams and vendors. Mentor engineers and maintain clear documentation and runbooks.
  • Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site.

What do you need to succeed?

  • 8+ years of experience in systems development, infrastructure engineering, or a related discipline, including substantial hands-on experience supporting media production, post-production, visual effects, animation, or broadcast workflows.
  • A track record of independently leading complex infrastructure projects from design through production, coordinating across teams, and owning reliability, performance, and ongoing improvements.
  • Deep understanding of media workflows from ingest through editorial, rendering, review, and delivery, including the effects of media formats, resolution, throughput, latency, and production deadlines on infrastructure design.
  • Strong experience building and operating cloud infrastructure on one or more major platforms, such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure, and connecting cloud services to on-premises production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with CPU and GPU render farms, job schedulers, resource allocation, application dependencies, and license services; ability to diagnose failed jobs and performance bottlenecks.
  • Experience engineering GPU-enabled VDI or remote workstation environments, including virtualization, image management, remote display protocols, and interactive video and audio performance.
  • Strong knowledge of shared file and object storage, protocols such as NFS and SMB, high-volume data transfer, storage performance tuning, data protection, and recovery.
  • Strong networking skills covering TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, DNS, multicast, and hybrid connectivity, with practical experience integrating and troubleshooting video and audio transport and synchronization.
  • Proficiency developing production tools and automation in Python or a comparable language, with experience in version control, automated testing, infrastructure as code, configuration management, and continuous delivery.
  • Strong Linux engineering skills and experience supporting Windows production environments, including identity and access management, system security, monitoring, and troubleshooting across compute, storage, and network layers.
  • Clear communication, sound technical judgment, and the ability to mentor engineers, explain tradeoffs to production stakeholders, and prioritize effectively when requirements are incomplete.
  • Preferred qualifications
  • Experience building or operating AI/ML infrastructure, including GPU compute, model training or inference, data pipelines, and workload scheduling.
  • Experience applying AI/ML tools to media workflows or engineering operations, with attention to resource efficiency, content security, and reliable integration.
  • Experience supporting immersive media, very high-resolution content, real-time rendering, or production environments spanning multiple facilities.

title: Reproduction and Breeding Intern: Canada
description:
Role Overview

Do you have a passion for cattle and a knack for problem-solving? ABS Global, a Genus Company, is offering the ultimate Reproduction and Breeding Internship, where you'll be an arm’s length away from the fascinating world of cattle reproduction—literally! As part of our expert team, you’ll help farmers ensure their herds are thriving, while learning the ropes of cutting-edge bovine technology. If you’re self-motivated, love learning and adapting to new challenges on the go, this summer internship is your chance to make a real impact in the dairy industry. Ready to roll up your sleeves and travel? Apply now and start shaping the future of animal genetics!

We have multiple positions. Possible locations include Ontario (Canada), Wisconsin, Minnesota, New York, Vermont, Michigan, Southeast Pennsylvania, and Northeast Ohio. This job posting is for the role located in Ontario Canada.

This position works 40 hours/week. Your manager will help determine your daily hours.

The hourly compensation for this position is $20.00 CAD. The compensation provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. Genus considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

This job posting closes for applications on November 30th

You Will

  • Gain an understanding of ABS proven technical solutions through hands-on involvement and training with clients, staff, and local ABS management.
  • Understand the general farm operation and handling cattle including reproductive skills and safety procedures.
  • Learn to measure and report progress and results of technical service initiatives.
  • Acquire knowledge in seeking new ways to deliver value to customers in co-operation with the technical service team and new business development.
  • Exposure to real industry seminars, producer meetings and in-house meetings and publications.
  • Develop proficient skills in PCDart, DC305, and/or BoviSynch software.
  • Opportunity to assist a GMS evaluator coding cows.
  • Opportunity to assist Repro Tech with customers, develop on-farm procedures to help facilitate implementation of RMS in each customer's operation, cooperate with other farm advisors (Vet, Nutritionist, etc.) to integrate RMS into total farm management plan.
  • Opportunity to assist Sales Reps on their route with deliveries, service, sales call and with ABS udder care products.
  • Ensure ABS Global is a healthy and safe environment to work in by observing both the company safety rules and the policies/guidelines.
  • Uphold the Genus core values, mission, and vision.
  • Position may require work responsibilities outside of normal business hours.
  • Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements

Basic Qualifications: (required)

  • Experience in cattle handling and farm operations.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Valid driver’s license.
  • Able to work at least 12 weeks during the summer.
  • Authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certified in Artificial Insemination or hands-on experience with breeding.
  • Passion for the dairy industry and pursuing Agribusiness, Animal Science, Dairy or related field.
  • Proficiency in PCDart, DC305, and/or BoviSynch software.
  • Bilingual in Spanish.

Business Overview

Genus is an agricultural biotechnology pioneer. We are a global FTSE 250 company, headquartered in the UK, and listed on the London Stock Exchange. Genus PLC has a presence in over 70 countries and a global workforce of over 3,000 employees and growing. We are a worldwide leader in porcine and bovine animal genetics, partnering with farmers to transform how we nourish the world – a mission that is important to a sustainable future.

Our vision is clear: Pioneering animal genetic improvement to sustainably nourish the world.

Our Values

Collaborate as One Team

Create Value for Customers

Innovate with Purpose

Never stop improving

ABS Global is a Genus company and is the world-leading provider of bovine genetics, reproductive services, technologies and udder care products. Marketing in more than 70 countries around the globe, ABS has been at the forefront of animal genetics and technology since its founding in 1941. We are uniquely positioned as a global player with a dedicated research and development function and an international distribution network. We breed and distribute the genes of the world’s best bulls, scientifically selecting livestock whose offspring is designed to increase the profitability of our customers who are some of the world’s biggest farmers and food producers. IntelliGen Technologies is the technology within ABS that develops sexed bovine genetics that helps customers maximize their profitability and reach their end goals in a fast and efficient manner.

Benefits Overview

Internships at Genus are not eligible for benefits. However, we offer paid internships with competitive compensation. Permanent roles at Genus come with a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, long and short-term disability, 401K, tuition reimbursement, paid holidays, and ETO (employee time off). Interns who excel in their roles are often considered for permanent positions after their internship.

  • Relocation stipend and Housing recommendations available if needed!
  • Two all-expenses paid trips to company headquarters (Madison, WI area) for North American Internship program engagement.
  • Business Equipment for this role includes Work Truck (to be kept clean by intern).

For more information on our student program, please visit- https://earlycareer.genusplc.com/

Equal Employment Opportunities

Genus is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with anti-discrimination law, it is the purpose of this policy to effectuate these principles and mandates. Genus prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Genus conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Genus plc will never ask you to provide fees or payment for computers, software, or other equipment or supplies during the recruitment and/or onboarding process. If you have any questions about your individual application, please contact the Genus Talent Acquisition team at recruiting@genusplc.com.

description:
The Global Product Manager is a critical role within the Evident Test & Measurement Global Product Management & Marketing (PMM) organization. Reporting to the Director, Global Product Management for the assigned product line, this role is responsible for sustaining and growing the market share of their assigned products or product lines, encompassing connected devices, software, and digital workflow solutions strategies, while maintaining a long-term vision to meet market needs.

The Global Product Manager will monitor and report on the development of assigned Product and/or Product Line P&L against targets and key product market share development globally, as well as within regions and targeted market segments. In this effort, this role will ensure close coordination with the Director, Global Product Management, as well as with the Director, Global Product Marketing and their regional team members.

The Global Product Manager will benefit from enhanced market intelligence data (VoC, VoS, win/loss root cause analysis, industry trends, market share, market opportunity in targeted segments, competitor activities/trends) that is regularly collected and reported to the Global PMM leadership team. It is critical that the Global Product Manager utilizes this enhanced market intelligence data to focus our efforts toward Innovation that Matters. The Product Management team must continually refine our development strategies and priorities to create products and solutions based upon what actually matters to our customers.

The Global Product Manager is responsible for the development and maintenance of their assigned Product and/or Product Line Strategies and Product Road Maps (PRM). This activity will be coordinated with the Director, Global Product Management. Together, they will designate Global Working Groups comprised of team members from Global Product Marketing, Sales, Application Engineering, and R&D to validate and refine Product Line Strategies and Product Road Maps (PRM).

The Global Product Manager will have management responsibilities for direct reports. Lead and oversee team performance to ensure efficiency and alignment with organizational objectives.

The Global Product Manager is responsible for regular collaboration and coordination with R&D to ensure that PRM projects are well executed, and for execution of Product Launch / NPI activities with Winning Go-To-Market strategies and unparalleled Unique Customer Value Propositions. Launch / NPI activities must be well-coordinated with Product Marketing, Global Marketing Communications, Application Engineering and Sales.

Job Duties

Product Roadmap Development and Management:

    • Development and maintenance of a detailed Product Road Map (PRM) for the assigned product and/or product line(s). Provide clear specifications for development projects as well as clear prioritization of features/functions to direct product development, production, and launch.
    • Provide updated Product Road Map documentation on a quarterly basis, taking into account actual project status and impacts.
    • Collaborate with R&D leaders and Program Management Office to ensure that PRM plans are regularly updated in OnePlan tool. This activity is critical to allow for development prioritization, planning, budgeting, and overall project execution.
    • Under the direction of the Director, Global Product Management, participate proactively in building relationships with strategic key accounts and opinion leaders who will influence broader market acceptance (such as OEM & Asset Owner who define the to-be testing standards) to drive growth in the long-run, fuel product development efforts and ensure relevance of strategic plans.

Long-term Product Planning:

    • Market Opportunity Identification: Working with Product Marketing & Sales to conduct market analysis to identify opportunities and key market and customer segments, and to gather information on customers and competitors.
    • Anticipate market trends and plan the lifecycle of assigned products, including launch, maturity, and sunsetting.
    • Close collaboration with Supply Chain and Manufacturing to coordinate the product sunsetting process, ensuring proper part availability for service to EOL, and minimizing extra inventory to be scrapped after sales and service activities end.

Development of Winning Go-to-Market Strategies and Launch Materials (NPI Packages):

    • Lead the New Product Introduction (NPI) process start-to-finish, working with stakeholders to meet launch deadlines. Collaborate with Product Marketing to develop requirements for global & regional marketing campaigns to ensure successful market introduction and sustainment.
    • Value Proposition and Message Definition: Collaborate with Product Marketing to define the value proposition for new products and support the development of key messages for marketing campaigns.
    • Creating content of all detailed documents for product launches, including technical data sheets, user manuals, competitive analysis, and sales support materials.
    • Align with Marketing Communications on web and collateral plans for launch.

Product P&L Monitoring:

  • P&L monitoring and reporting of the assigned product(s) and/or product line(s), including all strategic planning through to market launch and product life cycle, as well as third-party strategic partnerships.
  • Coordinating with different teams to ensure optimal product vitality and performance, while maintaining a long-term vision to meet market needs.
  • Focus on ensuring that correct market pricing is implemented for all key products in each region to maximize sales volume and revenue. Collaborate with Product Marketing on validation of pricing, and with Sales Management team to ensure execution.
  • Monitor key product cost on a monthly basis (or as needed) to ensure that changes are detected and impact to profitability are understood. Collaborate with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, and other stakeholders to address issues, and to drive initiatives to improve profitability.
  • Focus on Service offerings that are related to assigned product lines. Set expectations for product support periods, spares pricing, service contract offerings, etc. Support implementation within regional service organizations
  • Lead the development of new business models within and adjacent to assigned core product lines. Focus on opportunities for the development of recurring revenue business models, including SaaS / PaaS / HaaS. Close collaboration with Product Marketing team and Digital Services team is expected to drive a wholistic approach to this effort across the TNM business.
  • Act as the key approver for all assigned product pricing. Work with stakeholders at the global and regional level to ensure efficient pricing implementation processes are in place.

Talent Development:

  • Work with Product Specialists within the Product Management team as assigned on a product or project basis.
  • As a Product Manager, will manage direct reports and provide mentorship to more junior team members as they participate in project work (R&D, NPI, etc.)
  • Suggest opportunities for market exposure (VoC, VoS, Exhibitions, etc.)
  • Delegate project work as appropriate and in coordination with Director, Global Product Management and VP PMM

Reporting:

  • Provide timely and complete roll-up of activities, KPIs, Problem Solving Process documents, and PDCA Action Plan improvement initiatives.
  • Responsible to monitor, optimize and achieve product performance within business objectives. Responsible for monthly monitoring and analysis of actual achievement vs KPIs to identify requirements for improvement. Drive global solutions to achieve business goals.

Job Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Science, or related field.

Experience:

  • 5+ Years Product Management and/or Product Marketing Experience.
  • Experience in Test and Measurement/Non-Destructive Testing is considered an advantage.
  • 2+ years management experience.

Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of inspection modalities related to assigned business line.
  • Strong knowledge of the science & technology related to assigned business line.
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills, interpersonal skills in a multi-cultural environment, and an ability to effectively interact at a senior executive level.
  • Proficiency in data analysis for strategy development, reporting, and presentation.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 tools
  • Deep understanding of the Product Portfolio within the assigned product lines, competitive products, relative market position of Evident at the global and regional level.

  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including English language, strong interpersonal skills and an ability to effectively interact at a senior executive level.
  • Significant experience with NPI activities and driving marketing campaigns.

Other Considerations (travel/hours availability, etc.):

title: Senior Consultant – Change Management (Digital & Technology Adoption)
description:
Senior Consultant – Change Management (Digital & Technology Adoption)

The Opportunity

Join BearingPoint Ireland’s Change Management team and help organisations turn ambitious transformation strategies into changes that work for their people. As a Senior Consultant in Change Management, you will work with clients on complex, high-impact programmes that reshape services, operating models, technology and ways of working.

You will combine recognised change management expertise with strong consulting experience and sound judgement. You will lead defined workstreams or projects, engage senior stakeholders, guide client teams through change and translate programme objectives into practical actions that build readiness, adoption and lasting value.

What You Will Do

  • Lead change management workstreams from initial assessment and strategy through design, implementation, adoption and transition to business as usual, shaping the approach to the scale, complexity and risk profile of each project.
  • Design and deliver the learning and enablement approach for technology adoption: training needs analysis, curriculum and materials, and delivery through instructor-led, virtual and self-serve channels, supported by champion and key user networks that sustain adoption after go-live.
  • Define and track adoption measures - usage, proficiency, sentiment and business benefit and use the evidence to identify readiness risks and target support where it is needed.
  • Work alongside client leaders, programme teams, technology specialists and BearingPoint colleagues to integrate change activity with the wider transformation plan.
  • Facilitate engaging workshops, interviews and decision-making sessions with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Turn complex findings into clear, practical and high-quality client deliverables, recommendations and executive communications.
  • Manage day-to-day delivery for a defined workstream, including priorities, resources, dependencies, quality and progress reporting.
  • Coach consultants and analysts, creating an inclusive environment in which team members can contribute, learn and succeed.
  • Contribute to proposals, client conversations, thought leadership and the continued development of BearingPoint’s Change Management capability.

The Experience You Will Bring

You will typically bring 5 to 10 years' relevant professional experience, including hands on delivery in consulting, advisory or transformation environments and the ability to bring structure, momentum and practical focus to complex change programmes. You should be able to demonstrate:

  • Designing and delivering people-centred change in complex organisational, operational or technology enabled programmes, applying structured methods across impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, learning, adoption and benefits realisation.
  • Working credibly with senior leaders and diverse stakeholder groups to facilitate discussion, test assumptions and support informed decisions.
  • Leading defined workstreams or small multidisciplinary teams, with responsibility for delivery planning, quality, reporting and day-to-day issue resolution.
  • Producing clear, high-quality deliverables that translate complex analysis into practical recommendations for business and technical audiences.
  • Contributing to a consulting environment, including proposals, client conversations and collaborative delivery of measurable outcomes.

Relevant Transformation Experience

We are particularly interested in candidates who have supported clients to adopt new ways of working, embed technology-enabled change and realise measurable value from transformation. Relevant experience may include one or more of the following:

  • Supporting organisational and workforce change, including operating model change, role and process redesign, workforce transition, behavioural change and adoption of new ways of working.
  • Hands on experience leading and driving the adoption of enterprise platforms and digital workplace tools, with a focus on user adoption, business readiness and benefits realisation, such as:
  • Microsoft 365, Copilot, Cowork and other AI-enabled workplace tools.
  • Case management, customer relationship management, service management and workflow platforms, including Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow or comparable solutions.
  • ERP, finance, HR or core business system transformation, including Microsoft Business Central, SAP or other enterprise platforms.

Qualifications

  • A relevant third-level qualification, or equivalent professional experience, in business, technology, communications, organisational psychology, human resources or a related discipline.
  • A recognised change management certification, such as Prosci, APMG Change Management or ACMP Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP), would be beneficial.
  • Additional training in adoption, communications, learning, agile delivery or specific technology platforms would also be valued.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • A people-centred mindset, with the ability to understand how change affects individuals, teams and organisations and to design practical support that helps people adopt new ways of working.
  • Professional credibility and emotional intelligence to support colleagues, influence senior stakeholders, handle sensitive conversations and communicate with clarity, empathy and conviction.
  • Commercial awareness, including the ability to understand client priorities, constraints and value drivers, and to balance leading practice with what is practical in the client environment.
  • Curiosity, adaptability and composure in bringing structure to uncertain, evolving or complex situations.
  • A collaborative working style that builds trust, encourages participation and connects business, technology and delivery teams around shared outcomes.
  • A strong sense of ownership, with a focus on delivering high-quality work that is practical, evidence-based and creates lasting client value.
  • A commitment to continuous learning, including strengthening your change management expertise, consulting skills and understanding of how technology is shaping transformation.

What You Can Expect

  • Purposeful, varied work on transformation programmes that help organisations improve services, adopt new technologies and embed new ways of working.
  • Early and direct exposure to client leaders, programme teams and multidisciplinary colleagues, with meaningful responsibility for shaping practical outcomes.
  • Support to deepen your change management specialism while broadening your consulting experience across strategy, operating model, technology adoption and programme delivery.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team environment that values knowledge sharing, practical innovation, feedback and continuous learning.
  • Opportunities to coach junior colleagues, contribute to proposals and thought leadership and help shape the continued growth of our Change Management offering.

At Comvita we embrace the science of nature to support natural health and wellbeing, and to build global resilience. Our vision and aspiration to leave the world in a better place is captured in our Harmony Plan, and we are proud to be B-Corp accredited.


We believe in the power and wisdom of bees, and the idea of “One Hive”, where belonging makes each of us stronger. Paengaroa, where it all started, is the home of Comvita and our Market Support Centre. Comvita runs one of New Zealand’s largest Varroa management programmes across its apiaries. This project undertakes a constructive, cross-branch analysis of current practice, learning from sites, capturing strengths and identifying gaps using international best practice as a reference point. This work will create a measurable roadmap for improved efficiency, prediction, and treatment, to improve hive production and hive retention. Work directly with Comvita’s Apiary teams, learn international best practice, and help strengthen bee welfare.


The internship will be based in Whanganui.



Why choose our Internship?

  • We are a living wage employer and our internship pays $29.90 per hour.

  • A proud BCorp accredited business

title: Senior Systems Engineer | Shared Tech
description:
Craft:

Technology & Development

Job Description:

At King, we’re on a mission to make the world playful. The tools, platforms and infrastructure behind our games help teams turn great ideas into experiences enjoyed by millions of players.


Engineering System & Support (ESS) builds the shared foundations that make game development smoother: reliable CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, repository services, build tooling and developer workflows. We help teams spend less time waiting on systems and more time creating great games.


Your role within the Kingdom

As a Senior Systems Engineer (Developer Experience & Infrastructure), you’ll improve the platforms developers rely on every day—making them faster, more reliable and easier to use.


What You’ll Do:

  • Elevate Developer Experience: Design, build, and support self-service platform tools and automated workflows that speed up developer feedback loops.
  • Scale Infrastructure: Maintain and modernize our Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and containerized build systems across multi-OS and cloud environments.
  • System Design & Reliability: Shape platform architecture, strengthen monitoring, and troubleshoot complex distributed services.
  • Collaborate & Mentor: Partner closely with game teams across multiple locations, write clear platform documentation, and share knowledge across the engineering community.

Skills to create thrills

We evaluate candidates based on core capabilities and engineering fundamentals rather than tool-by-tool memorization.

  • Production Linux Expertise: Solid experience managing and troubleshooting Linux systems (e.g., Debian/Ubuntu) in production or high-availability settings.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Hands-on experience automating infrastructure provisioning using tools like Terraform, Puppet, or similar frameworks.
  • Cloud & Container Orchestration: Practical experience working with major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Bash, Python, Groovy, or PowerShell) to eliminate toil and automate pipelines.
  • Version Control Fundamentals: Solid understanding of Git workflows and modern developer ecosystems.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong communication skills, structured task prioritization, and a passion for supporting fellow developers.
  • Managed Services Operations: Experience owning and operating managed services as, artifactory, perforce, builbuddy, buildkite.

Bonus Points (Nice to Have, Not Required!)

  • Experience maintaining complex CI/CD pipelines across multi-OS environments (Linux, macOS, Windows).
  • Familiarity with build optimization or repository management tools (e.g., Artifactory, SonarQube, Incredibuild, or Veertu Anka).
  • Exposure to cloud-native monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, or Splunk).
  • Security awareness: An understanding of platform security and software supply-chain practices.

Bring your craft, curiosity and care for fellow developers. Together, we’ll build the foundations that help King teams create more moments of magic for players.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Associate, Project Valuations & Project Analytics
description:
ABOUT AVANTUS

Avantus develops, owns and operates utility-scale clean energy projects across California and the Desert Southwest. Our development pipeline of solar with integrated storage will generate enough dispatchable power to serve more than 10 million Americans, day and night. Backed by strategic investment from KKR and EIG, and building on more than a decade of industry leadership, Avantus is growing its position as an independent power producer, delivering affordable, reliable clean energy solutions to meet America’s growing energy demand.

ABOUT THE POSITION

We are seeking a highly motivated and organized candidate for the Associate, Project Valuation & Analytics position. The successful candidate will demonstrate sound industry knowledge, superior communications, and detail-oriented organizational skills. This role reports to our Y.

Associates of Project Valuation and Analytics at Avantus support financial modeling, valuation, and analytical work across the company’s utility-scale renewable energy project portfolio. This role will contribute to project investment decisions by developing financial models, analyzing market assumptions, and preparing materials used in internal investment reviews and project financing processes.

This position offers exposure to the full lifecycle of renewable energy development and project finance.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and update financial models for utility-scale renewable energy project portfolio.
  • Support valuation analysis including IRR, NPV, and cash flow projections.
  • Conduct sensitivity analysis on key variables including power prices, capital costs, operating expenses, and financing terms.
  • Analyze power price forecasts, storage revenue opportunities, and contract structures.
  • Support evaluation of PPA pricing, merchant exposure, and capacity revenues.
  • Work closely with Development and Commercial teams to update project economics as development milestones are achieved.
  • Track key project assumptions including interconnection costs, capital expenditures, and operating expenses.
  • Assist with preparation of investment memos, lender presentations, and financial summaries.
  • Support due diligence processes for project financing and acquisitions.
  • Maintain project valuation databases and analytical tools.
  • Support improvements to financial modeling templates and analytics workflows.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field
  • 2–5 years of experience in renewable energy, project finance, energy consulting, or investment banking
  • Exposure to financial modeling and infrastructure or energy project economics
  • Strong Excel and financial modeling capabilities
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail
  • Ability to synthesize quantitative analysis into clear insights

Avantus offers competitive compensation with an excellent benefits package, including 401(k) matching; comprehensive medical and dental plan options; and flexible PTO. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Senior Test Automation Engineer (Python / Playwright)
description:
We're looking for a Senior Test Automation Engineer who approaches quality as an engineering discipline embedded in system design - not as a separate phase at the end of delivery. You will help shape how testing, automation, and observability evolve across a cloud-native SaaS platform built with React / Next.js, Material UI, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL, running in a Kubernetes-based environment.

Our software supports ERP and operational workflows within the circular economy and waste management domain - systems that combine real-world logistics, regulatory constraints, and data-intensive processes. Reliability and long-term maintainability matter more than short-lived feature velocity.

Our development workflow is strongly automation-driven and AI-assisted. Faster iteration cycles place greater emphasis on thoughtful test strategy, instrumentation, and feedback loops. We're looking for someone who can help engineering teams move confidently without sacrificing system integrity.

This role is hands-on but also strategic: you will influence practices, help define pragmatic standards, and raise the overall maturity of automation across the platform.

What You'll Work On

  • Designing and evolving end-to-end and integration automation
  • Building sustainable testing frameworks across the stack
  • Working closely with developers to ensure systems are testable by design
  • Integrating automation into CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines) and reducing friction in the delivery process

What You Bring

Technical Experience

  • Strong Python / JS / TS background in automation contexts, with deep hands-on Playwright experience
  • Experience testing modern React-based web applications and component-driven UIs (Material UI or similar)
  • Strong API and service testing experience; familiarity with FastAPI-style architectures is a plus
  • Integration testing against PostgreSQL or similar relational databases, and systems deployed on Kubernetes or other cloud-native environments
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) plus logs, metrics, tracing, and instrumentation

Nice to Have

  • Experience defining or evolving testing strategy across teams
  • Background in quality engineering, SRE, or platform engineering
  • Experience with contract testing or schema validation
  • Interest in how AI-assisted development changes engineering workflows and testing approaches

What Success Looks Like

  • Automation enables faster iteration without compromising reliability
  • Engineers gain confidence through fast, trustworthy feedback loops
  • Testing becomes a natural part of system design rather than a separate activity
  • Tooling and practices scale with the platform instead of becoming bottlenecks

Why Join

  • Work on software that supports real operational systems in the circular economy
  • Contribute to a pragmatic engineering culture focused on long-term quality
  • Help shape how testing and automation evolve in a modern SaaS environment
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers who value ownership and practical solutions

Location & Ways of Working

  • Hybrid — approximately 3 days per week at the office
  • Office in Pasila, Helsinki — about a 10-minute walk from Pasila train station
  • Start immediately — onboarding is ready as soon as you are

Tietomitta delivers innovative software solutions for the waste management and circular economy industry. Our systems provide customers with tools to improve efficiency and meet regulatory requirements - helping them work smarter and more sustainably.

Vitec is a leading provider of Vertical Software and has its origin and headquarters in Umeå, Sweden. Our products have been developed to meet specific needs within various niche markets in society. The expertise of our employees, combined with our shared corporate culture and business model, enable continuous improvement and innovation. title: Order Management Coordinator
description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

The Order Management Coordinator will support the administration and execution of customer orders from receipt through fulfillment. This role will serve as a central point of coordination for sales order entry, purchase order review, order changes, delivery tracking, and routine customer order communications. This role will work cross-functionally with Business Development, Program Management, Production, Supply Chain, Finance, and other internal teams to ensure orders are accurately entered, required reviews are completed, changes are properly incorporated, and order status remains visible throughout the fulfillment process.

Responsibilities

  • Own the entry, maintenance, and administration of customer sales orders within NetSuite
  • Review incoming customer purchase orders and supporting documentation for completeness prior to order acceptance and entry
  • Coordinate the internal PO and contract review process across required functional stakeholders
  • Verify incoming contractual requirements against established FAR/DFARS compliance matrices and internal review procedures, escalating exceptions to the appropriate functional owner
  • Process and track customer order changes, contract modifications, delivery-date changes, part-number or revision updates, address changes, and supporting documentation
  • Maintain accurate and current sales order records, customer documentation, and order-related files
  • Monitor open orders, required actions, delivery commitments, and outstanding dependencies through fulfillment
  • Work closely with Production, Supply Chain, Program Management, and other internal teams to maintain accurate order and delivery status
  • Provide routine order status and delivery updates to customers as required
  • Identify order discrepancies, missing information, conflicting requirements, or potential fulfillment issues and drive resolution with the appropriate internal stakeholders
  • Ensure required internal reviews and approvals are completed prior to order acceptance or implementation of material order changes
  • Support coordination between order entry and fulfillment teams when product revisions, inventory allocations, or other order specific requirements necessitate updates
  • Maintain clear visibility of open actions, changes, and customer commitments associated with assigned orders
  • Support continuous improvement of order management processes, workflows, reporting, and internal controls as order volume scales

You should have the following

  • 2+ years of experience in order management, sales operations, customer operations, contract administration, program coordination, inside sales, or a similar coordination/operational role

Your responsibilities will include managing documentation, overseeing change controls, and driving corrective and preventative actions. A natural curiosity and a drive to continuously learn are essential to be successful in this role.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

    • PC hardware (including assembly and disassembly of desktop PCs)

    • A scripting language
    • Active Directory and Group Policy

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Certifications in CompTIAA+ or ITIL
  • Experience with cloud-based technologies (Azure, AWS, O365)

  • Familiarity with common AI platforms and the ability to write effective prompts, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve service delivery and operational efficiency
  • Experience with Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible and Terraform
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, able to see the big picture and make connections
  • Experience participating in and supporting a medium to complex, end‑to‑end IT project, in all phases from initial requirements gathering and planning through implementation, testing, stakeholder coordination, and ongoing operational support

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

description:

title: Data Scientist - Clearance Required
description:
Overview

The Data Scientist – Journeyman will support the Army's ammunition planning and resupply mission through the development, sustainment, and refinement of data-driven analytics and machine learning models. This role will work within a team to maintain and enhance ML-driven demand forecasts, support dashboard metrics in Army Vantage, and contribute to workflow automation that improves ammunition distribution efficiency and unit readiness.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Support development, testing, and refinement of forecasting and analytics models for ammunition consumption and resupply.
  • Maintain and enhance existing Vantage-based analytics, dashboards, and data products, including incorporating new data sources.
  • Assist in integrating and validating data into Vantage pipelines to centralize munitions data.
  • Conduct descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analytics on historical ammunition consumption and unit forecast data to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support requirement-gathering sessions with logisticians, ammunition SMEs, and Government stakeholders to define analytical use cases, data needs, and model enhancements.
  • Develop and maintain reproducible analytical workflows using Python, SQL, and related tools; document model logic, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Assist in monitoring model performance and key metrics.
  • Prepare clear visualizations and summary analyses to support leadership decision-making, including monthly status reports and briefings.
  • Support project backlog management by creating and updating user stories and technical tasks related to data science work.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, business analytics, or related discipline.
  • 2–5 years of experience in data science, analytics, or a closely related field.
  • Demonstrated experience with:
    • Python (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, numpy) and SQL for data preparation, analysis, and basic modeling.
    • Building and validating regression, time series, or classification models.
    • Working with large, structured datasets in relational databases or data warehouses.
  • Strong quantitative and critical thinking skills; ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical problems and solutions.
  • Ability to communicate analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders in clear, concise terms.
  • Self-directed, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in an Agile environment with shifting priorities.
  • Active or attainable SECRET clearance; please note, only US Citizens can obtain a clearance.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting an enterprise data analytics platform (e.g., Army Vantage, Army Data Platform, or similar).
  • Familiarity with Army logistics processes, ammunition management, or supply chain analytics.
  • Experience with dashboarding/BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or Vantage-native visualization tools).
  • Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and Agile/Scrum practices (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
  • Exposure to ML model monitoring and MLOps concepts.

Target salary range: $130,000-$160,000

Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

title: Inspector
description:
Position Title: Aircraft Inspector
Department: Maintenance / Quality
Company: Certified Aviation Services (CAS)
Reports To: Quality Manager / Chief Inspector
Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

Certified Aviation Services is seeking an experienced Aircraft Inspector to perform quality inspections of aircraft maintenance, repairs, alterations, and related documentation. This position will ensure maintenance work is completed in accordance with FAA regulations, approved technical data, manufacturer requirements, CAS procedures, and applicable customer requirements.

The Aircraft Inspector will work closely with maintenance personnel and leadership to identify discrepancies, verify corrective actions, and ensure aircraft and components meet applicable airworthiness and quality standards.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Perform inspections of aircraft maintenance, repairs, alterations, and installations.
  • Inspect work performed by A&P mechanics and maintenance personnel for compliance with approved procedures and technical data.
  • Verify completed maintenance work meets applicable FAA, manufacturer, customer, and CAS requirements.
  • Review maintenance records, work orders, inspection records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.
  • Perform required in-process, final, and return-to-service inspections as authorized.
  • Identify maintenance discrepancies and ensure corrective actions are properly documented and completed.
  • Verify the proper use of current maintenance manuals, technical publications, engineering data, and applicable Airworthiness Directives.
  • Ensure required inspections and maintenance documentation are properly completed before aircraft or components are released.
  • Assist with quality audits, investigations, and corrective-action activities.
  • Monitor maintenance practices and identify potential quality or compliance concerns.
  • Communicate inspection findings clearly to maintenance personnel and management.
  • Maintain accurate inspection records and quality documentation.
  • Support CAS compliance with applicable FAA regulations and Repair Station procedures.
  • Promote a safety-focused and quality-driven work environment.
  • Perform other inspection and quality-related duties as assigned.

title: Superintendent (LA County)
description:
