The Superintendent is responsible for overseeing field operations on multiple projects, crews, and scopes of work simultaneously to achieve timely and profitable completion. They will assist their General Foreman and Foreman daily to resolve issues, make sound decisions, as well as provide information and drive coordination to ensure work is executed safely and in the most efficient and effective manner. The Superintendent is also responsible for keeping the Project Manager accurately and fully informed of the field status of projects, particularly with regards to cost, schedule, quality, safety, and problems/issues. You can reside in Los Angeles/Orange/San Bernardino/Riverside Counties.

    • Instituting and participating in Weekly Toolbox Safety Meetings and performing regular project safety inspections to confirm the SSSP and Cal Solar Safety Guidelines are being adhered to in the performance of the work.
    • Helping review/address all unsafe conditions, near misses & accidents/incidents, promptly applying corrective actions to mitigate and prevent reoccurrence.
    • Assisting with updating, creating, & implementing safety policies and procedures.

  • Help create and execute Safety & Work Plans for all major tasks including Building Outage, Crane hoists, etc.

  • Support the creation of General Conditions / General Requirements (GC/GR) before contract execution, especially on retrofit bids where fencing, bathrooms, etc. will be required.

  • Participate in retrofit bid pre-design site surveys, design review, and pre-permitting meetings with Engineering teams, offering input regarding constructability and safety items, and supporting the creation of General Conditions / General Requirements (GCs/GRs).

  • Participate in Pre-Mobilization Meetings (preconstruction-to-construction hand-off) to ensure accurate and high-quality designs and plans have been established, identifying any issues pertaining to constructability, schedule, materials, labor capability/availability, site logistics, crane-pick locations, etc.

  • Perform pre-mobilization jobsite walks in advance of field crew mobilization, confirming there are no potential field-conditions that could impact the effectiveness and timeliness of executing the work.

  • Oversee start-up and preplanning of projects with the Project Foreman on all assigned projects.

  • Partner with the Procurement Manager and General Foreman to forecast BOM procurements for accuracy & lead times, and maintain visibility on truck/storage stock levels, to ensure projects consistently have the necessary equipment/materials to successfully execute the work. Communicate any field deficiencies in a timely manner.

  • Provide daily oversight of Miter timecard entry and Raken reporting required by Foreman, making certain that the correct project, labor code, and hours are being entered by field employees. Work with the Payroll Department to resolve problems timely.

  • Partner with the Labor Compliance department to ensure that labor requirements are met on all projects.

  • Provide leadership and training to the field teams in the execution of the work, ensuring the highest quality of craftmanship is achieved to avoid re-work, and encouraging the implementation of new field methods and procedures.
  • Help train & monitor the General Foreman and Foreman on the timely creation (minimum of 2-weeks prior to mobilization) of the Field Labor Tracker (FLT) spreadsheet.

  • Coordinate with the client, GC & subcontractors to ensure critical path activities occur in a timely manner and that the overall work is completed in accordance with the overall project scope and schedule.
  • Interface and coordinate with the client, GC, and/or subcontractors on items that impact our work (rough in conduit, power, low voltage, framing/blocking, etc.) to avoid field conflicts/problems and ensure proper installation occurs. Work with Cal Solar Project Manager to pursue resolutions in a timely and professional manner.
  • Help identify change-conditions to the work that create cost and/or schedule impacts are acted upon timely (change ordering pricing, T&M ticketing, etc.), including documentation of schedule updates, fragnets, etc.

  • Keep the Project Manager & Engineering team up to date on any field changes, and have full construction change mark-ups ready 4-6 weeks in advance of final inspection if resubmission to AHJ is required.
  • Lead weekly FLT review meetings of hours used & units installed, comparing results to budgeted production rates, identifying potential issues/concerns/overruns, and timely implementation of solutions. Share production rates with the Estimating team to improve accuracy of future bids.

  • Monitor material and equipment usage against budgets; identify cost-saving opportunities & cost-overrun risks. Work with Project Manager to understand/track all favors, risks, and opportunities, ensuring opportunities are maximized and risks minimized.

  • Ensure that the Foreman has all necessary plan sets, permits, job cards, etc. and verify that as-built drawings are kept current.

  • Develop, communicate, monitor, and update execution plan throughout duration of projects to ensure schedule adherence (with minimum 3-week “look ahead”), and forecast manpower/crew-size needs, material deliveries, etc. to avoid impacts to schedules or budgets.

  • Conduct routine jobsite meetings/visits with General Foreman and Foreman to review means and methods, schedule status, help with problem solving of day-to-day challenges, management of sub-subcontractors, and coordination with other subcontractors to make / coordinate cost-effective decisions regarding manpower, equipment, and material.

  • Confirm accurate completion of pre-commissioning reports, as-builts, IX photos, etc. and coordinate necessary manpower for utility visits/inspections, to enable projects to move timely through all post-mechanical completion stages.

  • Maintain strong understanding of manpower needs for each project to assist the General Superintendent with short term & long-term manpower projection/planning.

  • Participate in project post-mortem meetings, providing feedback on lessons-learned & issues experienced that can be implemented by the Preconstruction & Construction teams on future projects.


TEAM BUILDING & CULTURE

  • Embody and promote the Cal Solar core values and demonstrate those values in interactions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Foster open communication, team building, and sharing of best practices amongst all employees, to help create a continuous learning environment that drives team knowledge & preparedness.
  • Continually evaluate construction processes, finding new means and methods of construction (out-of-the-box thinking) & share best practices to help increase safety, profitability, quality, efficiency, etc. that can be captured within Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

  • Support the Field Training Manager by rigorously promoting high-quality standards that are consistently utilized by all, while also proactively working to help refine/improve these standards.

  • Encourage employees to take an active role and be accountable for their career growth.

  • Oversee the training and development of all direct reports through the performance planning process and maintaining1:1 meetings/check-ins, coordinating with the Field Training Manager to help identify available LMS courses and/or develop new training courses that may assist in their professional and personal development.

  • Establish and maintain good working relationships with governing agencies, inspectors, owners, GCs, and other subcontractors.

  • Support efforts to recruit and hire field employees that fit our core values and safety/quality culture.

  • Champion Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and Affirmative Action Programs.


Key Qualifications & Required Skills/Abilities

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in commercial/industrial solar construction.

  • Experience with construction management, in both self-performing and sub-subcontracting.

  • Strong understanding of the NEC (wire sizing, equipment ratings, installation requirements, etc.), NFPA 70E electrical safety guidelines, and plumbing code, with ability to reference these codes as required.

  • Working knowledge of Uniform Building Code (UBC) and building materials/techniques.

  • Strong understanding of grid-tied PV, solar domestic hot water, piping systems, pumped fluid circuits, and closed-loop heating systems.

  • Ability to read, understand, problem-solve, implement site-redesign, and mark-up (redline) electrical, plumbing, and structural plans.

  • Experience working directly with city/county permitting offices and inspectors.

  • OSHA-30 certification & JW Electrical Licensed, preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills/mindset.
  • Excellent organizational, attention to detail/process, analytical/problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Possess a positive attitude, ability to work independently, show initiative, and operate with a sense of urgency.
  • Excellent time management skills - ability to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, delegate, and support multiple projects in various stages of preconstruction & construction.
  • Strong supervisory and leadership skills with the ability to effectively train, motivate, and hold others accountable.
  • Experience with Dropbox, SCOOP, and Microsoft Applications Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) or similar software.
  • Bilingual (English-Spanish) preferred.
  • Ability to work extended hours to setup field crews for optimal/efficient execution daily.
  • Travel required within California.

For more than 14 years, California Solar Integrators, Inc. (Cal Solar, Inc.) has developed multi-family and commercial solar projects throughout California. title: Staff Solutions Engineer
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is a non-profit-backed technology company that has helped shape the internet for the better over the past 25 years. We’re the makers of Firefox, the privacy-focused web browser used by more than 225 million people around the world each month. As we look to the future, we’re working to shape the next 25 years of the internet—one that’s built for people, not just for profit.

Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the 501(c) non-profit Mozilla Foundation, meaning we’re accountable not to shareholders, but to our mission. Alongside thousands of contributors and collaborators around the world, Mozillians design, build, and maintain open-source software that empowers people to use the internet on their own terms.

We’re now seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer (DACH) to support the growth of Firefox Enterprise across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. This is a highly customer-facing technical role focused on helping enterprises evaluate, validate, and deploy Firefox Enterprise in secure, complex, and regulated environments.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical credibility, strong enterprise architecture experience, and a passion for helping customers solve real-world security, deployment, and interoperability challenges.

What you'll do:
  • Partner with Sales to support strategic enterprise opportunities across DACH.
  • Lead technical discovery and solution design with customers and partners.
  • Run workshops with customer stakeholders across security, infrastructure, IAM, endpoint management, and workplace technology.
  • Own the relationship to the customer’s technical counterparts during and after the sales process.
  • Help customers evaluate Firefox Enterprise in areas such as deployment, policy management, identity integration, logging, security controls, and operational fit.
  • Design and support pilots, proofs of concept, and rollout plans.
  • Advise customers on deployment models, architecture decisions, and integration approaches for enterprise environments.
  • Validate interoperability across systems such as SSO, MFA, SIEM, proxy/network controls, endpoint tooling, certificates/PKI, and browser policy frameworks.
  • Identify and help resolve technical risks early, including application compatibility, certificate handling, deployment complexity, and policy enforcement requirements.
  • Create reusable technical assets such as reference architectures, deployment guidance, validation plans, and technical enablement materials.
  • Support and enable partners involved in deployment, integration, and customer success.
  • Champion Mozilla’s values of openness, trust, and user agency in every customer interaction.
What you'll bring:
  • Significant experience (7+ years) in a senior Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Security Architect, or Technical Account Manager role.
  • Ideally deep knowledge of the DACH IT landscape, particularly within the public sector, financial services, or KRITIS (Critical Infrastructure) operators .
  • Strong background in enterprise security, endpoint management, browser security, Zero Trust, IAM, or digital workplace infrastructure.
  • Hands-on knowledge of:
    • Windows enterprise deployment
    • GPO / MDM / policy management
    • certificates / PKI / TLS / proxies
    • SSO / MFA / IdP integrations
    • SIEM / DLP / CASB ecosystems
    • Kubernetes / Helm for customer-operated environments
  • Experience supporting pilots, technical evaluations, or enterprise deployments in complex customer environments.
  • Ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into technical configurations and sales evidence.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with both technical teams and senior customer stakeholders.
  • Comfort working across ambiguity and helping customers move from evaluation to deployment with confidence.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Native-level fluency in German

What you'll get:

  • A highly competitive base salary, plus a high-impact, performance-driven sales bonus plan.
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Wavemaker, part of WPP, positively provokes growth for clients by reshaping consumer decision-making and experiences through media, content, and technology. Our name is both our mission and our method. We do our best work for brave brands and people who relish being challenged to go further and faster, together.

Location: Sydney

We have found a great balance of embracing flexible working whilst also maintaining in-office collaboration with most teams meeting in the office 3 days per week.

  • Strategic Leadership: Act as a critical senior contact, steering the day-to-day operational output to deliver exceptional, future-facing omnichannel campaigns.
  • Client Vision & Advisory: Partner closely with top-tier clients to drive their agenda, offering expert POVs on market trends and delivering innovative, strategic insights.

An inquisitive, strategic media leader with a robust offline background and a passion for mentoring, who is ready to take true ownership of massive campaigns and drive genuine innovation across the board. We’re also looking for;

  • Extensive Media Mastery: An exceptional understanding of the media landscape, particularly boasting strong offline and TV buying roots, with the vision to fuel broader omnichannel growth.
  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: A results-driven approach with a brilliant knack for translating complex data and market insights into clear, actionable optimisation strategies.
  • Inspiring Leadership: Proven experience in managing, motivating, and developing talent, resolving challenges smoothly, and championing a collaborative team culture.
  • Commercial Acumen & Negotiation: Superb negotiation skills with a history of delivering flawless financial accuracy and driving real commercial value.
  • Confident Communication: Top-tier problem-solving and presentation skills, ensuring you can articulate complex media principles to internal teams, media partners, and senior clients alike.

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What We Offer

At Wavemaker ANZ, we offer a competitive salary package, with 20 days holiday increasing with service to a maximum of 25 days, with the option to purchase extra leave of up to 4 weeks per year. We also offer a flexible working environment, paid parental leave, flexible public holidays, birthday leave and early finishes during the summer months. These are just some of the great perks you can utilise.

Based on the south side of the bridge in Barangaroo, our office has beautiful views of Sydney Harbour and is a great space to hang out with colleagues and friends!

We have a culture of learning where we invest in your career growth and development through a range of learning and development opportunities. title: Superintendent (Multi-Family Construction)

Impact Housing (IH) is a vertically integrated modular design-builder and developer headquartered in Southern California.

Our mission is to continuously evolve the world’s most sophisticated and efficient housing delivery system. We pursue this mission by reimagining every element of how multifamily projects are designed, manufactured, and built—driving down costs, shortening schedules, and expanding access to high-quality housing for the people who need it most, whether through LIHTC or unsubsidized projects.

To date this decade, the IH team has built or is actively developing close to 1,500 modular units demonstrating a scalable, repeatable path to affordability. With the capability to produce approximately 1,000 units per year today, IH is expanding to meet growing demand in San Diego, Los Angeles, and beyond.

We are now entering the next stage of our growth and strengthening every team across the company to achieve our next set of goals. We plan to manufacture and build more than 10,000 units through 2030. To accomplish this, we are implementing the Lean Standard Model company-wide; deploying AI at every level of the company; and positioning IH as a national thought leader in modular development.

The foundation for our success is firmly in place. Join us as we scale our operations, transition into a higher-capacity manufacturing facility powered by smart automation and robotics, expand our production capacity by more than 3x in the Western U.S., and prepare for future national growth.

The Superintendent will be an instrumental member of Impact Housing’s construction team, which is fully responsible for the execution of its real estate development projects. Under the direction of the Sr. Superintendent, the Superintendent will oversee construction of projects in the field, providing leadership to the trades to ensure a successful and timely completion of the projects.

  • Review and understand material budgets
  • Review and understand equipment budgets
  • Monitor project costs and identify areas for improvement
  • Provide leadership in quality process
  • Provide leadership in the safety and accident prevention programs
  • Document daily construction activities

  • Assist in development of detailed CPM Schedule

  • Experience working with Project Management team including successful completion of projects
  • Knowledge of San Diego trades and permit process a plus
  • Excellent communication and leadership

  • This position summary is a summary and not a complete representation of the position; the essential function of the position may change as duties are assigned

EDUCATION

COMPENSATION

  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and administer global mobility and immigration programs, policies, and processes across supported countries and employee populations.

  • Work closely and extensively with our global mobility and immigration partners, including immigration, tax, relocation, and other external providers; coordinate priorities, monitor service quality, costs, case progress, and employee experience..
  • Develop working knowledge of LOA and benefits programs, policies, systems, and processes.
  • Assist with LOA and benefits case coordination, vendor follow-up, documentation, and issue resolution.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in global mobility, immigration, or a closely related Total Rewards, People Operations, or HR operations role.
  • Demonstrated expertise in managing immigration and mobility programs, cases, vendors, and employee-facing processes across multiple countries or jurisdictions.
  • Experience working closely with global mobility and immigration partners and effectively coordinating work across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of immigration compliance, mobility policy administration, cross-border employee movement, and related risk considerations.
  • Excellent judgment and discretion when handling confidential, sensitive, and time-critical employee matters.
  • Strong project management, organization, prioritization, and follow-through skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an employee-centered approach.
  • Comfort working in an evolving, global environment with ambiguity and competing priorities.
  • Willingness and ability to learn LOA and benefits; prior experience is helpful but not required at the same depth as mobility and immigration expertise.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience supporting a high-growth, global, or technology organization.
  • Expertise with mobility and immigration.
  • Some experience in Benefits in LOA.
  • Experience managing or optimizing third-party vendor relationships.
  • Familiarity with global assignment, relocation, tax, payroll, or permanent-establishment considerations.
  • Relevant professional certification or education in immigration, global mobility, HR, benefits, or a related field.

title: Senior Game Artist | New Games
description:
Craft:

Art

Job Description:

We are looking for a Senior Game Artist to help define, create, and implement visual content for an IP Centric brand new Mobile Game

This role is ideal for an experienced generalist with strong 2D art foundations who has successfully moved into 3D production and understands how game art lives inside the engine. You will help shape ideas visually, create production-ready assets, and make sure they are implemented correctly in Unity.

The right candidate combines strong artistic taste, stylized visual design, solid 3D skills, and practical engine knowledge. You should be comfortable moving from sketch and concept exploration into modeled, textured, optimized, and integrated game assets, while also helping raise the quality bar for the wider art team. You’ll be a founding generalist and backbone of a new art team - a self starting attitude is essential!

Your role within the Kingdom

  • Create high-quality visual concepts for characters, props, environments, features, events, and gameplay elements.

  • Produce stylized, production-ready assets

  • Work across the full asset pipeline, from idea exploration to engine implementation.

  • Model, texture, optimize, and prepare assets for Unity.

  • Implement and review assets in-engine to ensure they meet visual and technical requirements.

  • Support visual development

  • Maintain consistency across art style, scale, readability, materials, and lighting.

  • Collaborate with Art Direction to refine visual direction and solve creative challenges.

  • Provide clear visual feedback and support to other artists when needed.

  • Help improve asset workflows, documentation, and implementation standards.

Collaboration and Integration

  • Work closely with Art Direction to maintain the project’s visual quality and style.

  • Collaborate with Game Designers to create visuals that support gameplay clarity and player understanding.

  • Work with Technical Artists and Unity developers to ensure assets are correctly implemented and optimized.

  • Support the team by sharing best practices for asset creation, optimization, and Unity implementation.

  • Respond well to feedback and iterate quickly while maintaining quality.

Skills to create thrills

  • Strong portfolio showing excellent concept art, visual design, and 3D game art

  • Strong drawing, shape language, color, composition, and design skills.

  • Solid 3D production skills, including modeling, texturing, materials, and optimization.

  • Strong experience implementing art assets in Unity.

  • Good understanding of real-time game art constraints and mobile performance requirements.

  • Ability to take an asset from concept through final in-engine integration.

  • Strong understanding of stylized art pipelines.

  • Good knowledge of scale, readability, lighting, materials, and asset consistency in-engine.

  • Experience working with established art direction and maintaining visual consistency.

  • Ability to troubleshoot asset issues in Unity and collaborate with technical teams.

  • Ability to mentor, guide, or support other artists through feedback and best practices.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to give and receive constructive feedback.

  • Good sense of polish, quality control, and production readiness.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on casual, mobile, or family-friendly games.

  • Experience with Blender.

  • Experience with Photoshop, Clip Studio Paint, or equivalent concept art tools.

  • Experience with Substance Painter, ZBrush, or equivalent 3D art tools.

  • Knowledge of basic shaders, materials, lighting, and prefab workflows in Unity.

  • Comfort supporting live game features, events, or seasonal content.

  • Experience working with basic animation and vfx

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to help shape the visual quality of a major global IP on mobile.

  • A collaborative art team focused on craft, clarity, and polish.

  • The chance to work across concept, 3D production, and in-engine implementation.

  • A healthy work culture that values trust, ownership, and teamwork.


Success in this role means ideas are explored clearly, assets are built beautifully, and final art is integrated smoothly into the game.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Guest Services Associate, Oakland
company: Ronald McDonald House Charities Bay Area
description:
ABOUT RONALD MCDONALD HOUSE CHARITIES BAY AREA (RMHC Bay Area)

For 45 years, RMCH Bay Area has been partnering with our region’s children’s healthcare providers to provide essential services that remove barriers, strengthen families, and promote healing when children need healthcare. Over the years – and only because of the generosity of donors who have supported our cause – we have evolved. We continue to develop programs to meet families’ needs as they face the medical uncertainty and financial stress of caring for their children. Today, RMHC Bay Area serves critically ill children through a network of Ronald McDonald House Charity programs that provide housing, meals and psychosocial support inside or nearby Lucile Packard Children’s Hospital Stanford and UCSF Benioff Children’s Hospital in San Francisco and Oakland. Our Ronald McDonald Care Mobile provides free dental care services to children in East Bay in partnership with John Muir Community Health Alliance.


JOB SUMMARY

The Guest Services Associate (GSA) is responsible for the internal operation of the Ronald McDonald House at Oakland while on shift, maintaining a supportive, safe, and secure environment for families, staff, and volunteers. The GSA team provides 24/7 guest services. Under the direct supervision of the Associate Director of Family Services, the GSA directs the work of volunteers, creates a welcoming atmosphere for guests, and ensures that services are delivered according to current policies and procedures. The GSA interacts with families and guests from diverse cultural and economic backgrounds within a semi-medical environment, properly badges them in, and connects them to the appropriate staff member.


Additionally, this role holds administrative responsibilities such as answering and transferring phone calls, processing staff and family packages and correspondence, greeting guests, checking in and out guest families, managing family access cards, logging maintenance orders, maintaining a clean main lobby, kitchen, laundry rooms, seating and dining areas, stocking and distributing household resources, and responding to all family questions and emergency situations.


The Guest Services Associate is a full-time or part-time, non-exempt role required to work some holidays and weekends.


Current Schedule Need:

Sunday-Wednesday 2:45 pm - 11:00 pm; Thursday 9:30 am - 6:00 pm.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Connect with outgoing/incoming GSA at the beginning and end of each shift to relay important information.
  • Respond to all family questions and emergency situations with compassion, attentiveness, and exercising professional boundaries, ensuring all appropriate departments are informed and communication is clear.
  • Maintain a safe and secure communal living environment for families by safeguarding the main entrance, identifying guests, frequenting communal areas, and communicating any concerns to the appropriate staff member.
  • Connect families, guest, visitors, volunteers or donors with the appropriate staff member via phone, in-person or share the correct contact information.
  • Perform walk-throughs of the entire house, multiple times during shift to ensure tidiness and safety, fostering an atmosphere of availability and approachability.
  • Register and monitor Day Pass families, providing tours, towels, and other resources.
  • Log all maintenance issues observed during walk-throughs or requested by staff or families through our Family Registry System, ensuring all necessary information is provided and recorded.
  • Complete all family requests and deliveries, including fridges, freezers, cots, pack & plays, breast pumps, and other linen items, to support families’ needs.
  • Accept, record, and distribute donations, ensuring donors are welcomed and appreciated for their support and their information is capture accurately.
  • Create, replace, and monitor family access cards.
  • Carry duty cell phone to ensure availability for families, guests and emergencies while not at the front desk.
  • Support the family care department with check-ins, check-outs, room changes, and the preparation of welcome folders/bags for incoming families.
  • Guide the work of volunteers, utilizing them as an extension of the team to restock storage spaces, tidy common areas, cover breaks, and attend to the family needs.
  • Receive, log and distribute all family and staff packages and correspondence, ensuring accurate record of date and time received, delivery company, appropriate storage.
  • Maintain a clean main lobby, kitchen, laundry rooms, seating, and dining areas by tiding them up, picking up trash, and wiping down surfaces.
  • Prepare, put out, and clean up daily continental breakfast, following safe food handling practices.
  • Support Meal Program with pick up, set up, clean up, and distribution of daily meals, following safe food handling practices.
  • Monitor, stock and distribute household resources including trash bags, toilet paper, laundry soap, cleaning cloths, diapers, toiletries, feminine pads, and other items to the laundry rooms, front desk and other storages.
  • Restock and monitor soda and water machines, as well as accept and organize soda deliveries using the first in, last out method.
  • Thoroughly disinfect fridges, freezers, cots, cribs, breast pumps, strollers, wheelchairs, and other items before to storing them or providing them to families.


QUALIFICATIONS AND PREREQUISITES:

Education and experience:

  • High School Diploma Required
  • 1 year of customer services experience


Knowledge, skills, abilities, and other:

  • Spanish-speaking, required
  • Compassionate and attentive customer service.
  • Good problem-solving and organizational skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work and adapt to a fast and slow-paced environment.
  • Good active listening.
  • Ability to handle difficult situations with confidence and compassion.
  • Service oriented.
  • Ability to set professional boundaries with families.
  • Ability to work as part of a large team, fostering a positive work environment.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Interest in working with families and children.
  • Ability to work with diverse populations.
  • Computer literate in MS Office suite of products or similar.
  • Ability to work in a semi-medical environment with children being treated with life-threatening illnesses and their families.
  • Certified in Adult & Pediatric CPR, First Aid and AED or ability to get certified.
  • Valid CA driver’s license.
  • Must be able to lift 50 pounds.

title: Software Engineer II
description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

Are you ready to join a dedicated team that is crafting the future of financial technology? At Ripple Labs Inc., we are on a mission to transform manual financial operations into flawless automated systems. As a Software Engineer on the Financial Core team, you'll play a crucial role in building the essential infrastructure that powers Ripple's global custodian network.

THE WORK:

We are the Financial Core team, the platform layer supporting Ripple's products. We manage vital infrastructure for money flow, including asset transfers across Ripple's global custodian network that covers fiat rails and crypto custody. Our responsibilities include settlement automation and liquidity management across many accounts and banking partners. The technology stack uses Java/Spring Boot on the backend, React/TypeScript for internal tools, and Postgres. These are deployed on Kubernetes with built-in observability and approval processes. We collaborate closely with Product Ops and Product to transform manual financial tasks into dependable, auditable, and automated systems.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Develop and deploy backend services and internal tools that automate settlement, funding, and liquidity management workflows
  • Work directly with Product Ops and Product to understand manual processes and build software that replaces or accelerates them
  • Contribute across the stack—REST API handlers, database migrations, and React UI components
  • Participate in on-call rotation and maintain production reliability for financial systems that move money in real time
  • Write well-tested, reviewable code and contribute to build discussions with your team and cross-functional partners

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 2-5 years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems
  • Backend experience in at least one language—Java, Go, Python, or TypeScript; comfort with object-oriented development and production-grade codebases
  • Comfortable contributing across the stack (backend APIs + UI components)
  • Solid grasp of relational databases, REST API development, and basic distributed systems concepts
  • Able to read, navigate, and add to existing codebases—not only new projects
  • Clear communicator with non-engineering partners—operations, finance, and product teams are your collaborators
  • Uses AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) actively as a core part of writing, reviewing, and debugging code. These tools are not a novelty but a genuine accelerant
  • Experience with financial systems, payments, or operations automation workflows
  • Familiarity with Spring Boot, Postgres, React
  • Experience crafting or deploying agentic systems—closed-loop automation that runs without a human in the critical path (approval workflows, reconciliation pipelines, event-driven monitoring)

title: Site Reliability Engineer II (AI Platform)
description:
This hybrid role requires working in the office two days per week.

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the job

As a Site Reliability Engineer II on the Serving Platforms team within Infrastructure Engineering, you will design, automate, and manage the core container stack and infrastructure powering our global business applications. Operating in a high-scale, self-hosted environment, you will serve as a subject matter expert for Kubernetes, Linux systems, and cloud-native automation, directly driving the reliability, security, and efficiency of our platform. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams worldwide, lead greenfield infrastructure projects, resolve complex incidents, and build self-service capabilities that empower application developers across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain, tune, and ensure high availability for the low-level Linux operating system and Kubernetes control plane across our self-hosted bare-metal infrastructure.
  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable container management, configuration management, and automation tools across global environments.
  • Investigate, resolve, and conduct root-cause analysis for complex infrastructure disruptions and performance bottlenecks at the system call level.
  • Participate in high-impact platform engineering projects and collaborate with globally distributed engineering teams to drive infrastructure standardization.
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation to support critical production systems and ensure operational resilience.
  • Develop and maintain self-service tools, automation pipelines, and robust infrastructure monitoring to eliminate manual operational overhead.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Linux experience (e.g., Ubuntu, CentOS) with expertise in kernel tuning (sysctl), process management (cgroups/namespaces), system calls, and performance optimization.

title: Learning and Organizational Development Specialist
description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

The Learning & Organizational Development Specialist builds workforce capability for Advanced Manufacturing by translating business, performance, and compliance needs into scalable learning solutions. The role combines organizational development consulting, instructional design, learning architecture, and LMS data analysis to improve employee proficiency, operational readiness, and the effectiveness of learning investments.

The Role

  • Partner with Advanced Manufacturing leaders, subject-matter experts, People partners, and employees to diagnose performance and capability needs; distinguish learning needs from process, role, tooling, or organizational issues; and recommend practical interventions.
  • Design role-based learning architectures, curricula, pathways, and qualification plans that connect job competencies, prerequisite knowledge, on-the-job practice, assessments, and reinforcement to measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead end-to-end instructional design for complex technical and professional learning using adult-learning principles and appropriate methodologies; create design documents, storyboards, facilitator guides, learner materials, assessments, and digital learning experiences.
  • Convert complex manufacturing concepts and procedures into accurate, accessible learning experiences in close partnership with technical experts while maintaining alignment with quality, safety, and document-control requirements.
  • Establish measurement plans and success criteria for assigned initiatives. Analyze LMS and related workforce data sets to identify participation, completion, proficiency, time-to-competency, recertification, and adoption trends; communicate findings and recommendations through clear reports or dashboards.
  • Maintain data quality for assigned LMS programs, including learning objects, curricula, audiences, assignments, completion rules, equivalencies, assessment data, and reporting logic; investigate discrepancies and coordinate sustainable corrections.
  • Lead small projects and pilots from discovery through launch and evaluation, managing scope, milestones, risks, stakeholder decisions, communications, and continuous-improvement actions.
  • Facilitate workshops, train-the-trainer sessions, working meetings, and learning experiences for employees and leaders; coach subject-matter experts on effective instructional practices.
  • Develop and refine reusable standards, templates, playbooks, and operating procedures that improve the quality, consistency, accessibility, and scalability of learning solutions.
  • Evaluate learning technologies, content, and vendor solutions; make recommendations based on user needs, technical fit, data requirements, maintainability, and value.
  • Manage multiple concurrent assignments independently, exercise judgment in selecting methods and priorities, and escalate material risks or decisions at the appropriate time.
  • Perform other related duties and support priority organizational development initiatives as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

  • Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls
  • Bachelor's degree in instructional design, learning sciences, organizational development, human resources, education, business, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of progressive experience in learning and development, organizational development, instructional design, learning experience design, or a related discipline, including independent ownership of complex learning projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct needs analysis, define performance outcomes, design curricula or learning pathways, develop assessments, and evaluate learning effectiveness.
  • Working knowledge of adult-learning theory, instructional-design models, facilitation practices, accessibility principles, and blended learning approaches.
  • Experience administering learning programs and working with LMS data, including assignments, completions, assessments, curricula, audience rules, data validation, and recurring or ad hoc reporting.
  • Ability to work with structured data sets using advanced spreadsheet functions and data-cleaning, reconciliation, analysis, and visualization techniques; ability to translate findings into decisions and actions for nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with common instructional-authoring, collaboration, presentation, and project-management tools.
  • Strong consulting, project management, written communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills; able to influence without formal authority and work effectively with technical and operational partners.
  • Ability to manage ambiguity, balance technical, procedural, and business constraints, and make independent recommendations on matters affecting assigned programs.
  • Ability to handle confidential employee and business information with sound judgment and discretion.
  • Ability to work onsite in an office and manufacturing environment; occasionally move between work areas, remain stationary for extended periods, and lift or carry materials weighing up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting advanced manufacturing, aerospace, automotive, engineering, production, quality, supply chain, or another technical operating environment.
  • Experience designing technical training, structured on-the-job training, qualification or certification programs, competency models, or role-based academies.
  • Experience with SCORM, xAPI, learning record stores, LMS integrations, or learning-content governance.
  • Experience with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or comparable query and visualization tools.
  • Knowledge of organizational development, change management, performance consulting, or talent practices beyond course design.
  • Relevant certification such as CPTD, APTD, instructional-design, facilitation, project-management, change-management, or analytics certification.

Work Environment

  • Work is performed primarily onsite in a professional office and active manufacturing environment. Exposure may include moderate noise, moving equipment, production activity, and areas requiring personal protective equipment and compliance with site safety rules.
  • Regular collaboration with manufacturing leaders, employees, technical subject-matter experts, People partners, and vendors is required. Occasional travel between company locations and schedule flexibility to observe or support multiple manufacturing shifts may be required.
  • The employee routinely uses a computer and standard office equipment and must be able to communicate and exchange information effectively in person and through digital channels.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Compensation

At Divergent, our pay range is based on the level of the job. For this role, we will consider candidates at level S04 as evaluated through our interview process.

  • S04 / Learning & Workforce Development Specialist: $94,610-$130,090
Pay Range
$94,610—$130,090 USD

What We Offer:

  • Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
  • Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
  • Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
  • Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
  • Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

  • Strong technical writing and communication skills
  • Strong safety awareness, good working safety record, and understanding of safe work practices

  • Opportunities for continued technical and professional development.

title: Senior Payload Systems Integration and Test Engineer
description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About this Role

As a Senior Payload Systems Integration and Test Engineer at Varda, you will own the end-to-end mission success for a diverse portfolio of payloads, including both internally designed payloads and hosted customer payloads. Example payloads may include inertial, RF, or optical sensors or communication systems, as well as various types of pharmaceutical processing equipment and instrumentation.

You will serve as the technical bridge between each payload and the Varda vehicle, defining interfaces, planning and executing integration and test campaigns, coordinating in-orbit operations, and ensuring safe recovery of payload data and hardware. When payloads require special accommodations or vehicle modifications, you will work across the vehicle engineering team to scope and implement these changes.

This role is ideal for system-minded engineers with broad cross-disciplinary background, looking to do both concept synthesis as well as hands-on integration and test.

Responsibilities

  • Act as responsible engineer for assigned payloads from initial scoping through post-flight data delivery, for both in-house pharma payloads and hosted customer payloads
  • Work with payload providers to understand mission objectives, derive detailed requirements, and capture detailed interfaces in formal ICDs
  • Take ambiguous mission concepts and formulate executable project plans, working with other engineering disciplines to scope & implement non-standard accommodations where necessary
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for external payload customers throughout the mission lifecycle (early-stage scoping through deorbit and recovery)
  • Plan and execute payload-level integration and test activities, including incoming inspection, functional checkouts, and environmental testing (vibration, EMI/EMC, TVAC), plus payload-specific verifications such as leak testing or pharmaceutical process testing
  • Identify, document, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues that arise during integration and test activities
  • Work with mission operations engineers to define payload flight operations, command sequences, and operations procedures, and support on-console operations as needed to accomplish mission objectives
  • Drive continued evolution of standard payload interfaces, accommodations, and integration workflow (documented in the Payload User Guide)
  • Serve as a technical resource across the team, reviewing others' work and offering mentorship to earlier-career engineers where helpful

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Chemical, Systems Engineering, or other relevant field
  • 5+ years of experience integrating and testing spacecraft, payloads, or comparably complex electro-mechanical hardware
  • Experience as the named responsible engineer for at least one payload or comparable hardware element through a full program cycle, including flight or equivalent end use
  • Experience developing and managing interface control documents, requirements, and verification/validation plans
  • Demonstrated ability to carry multiple hardware efforts concurrently against fixed schedule milestones
  • Wide technical background with knowledge in two or more of the following topics: structures, thermal management, electronics, embedded software, optics, RF systems, GNC, communication systems, fluid systems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working hands-on in a cleanroom with critical flight hardware
    • Must be physically able to regularly lift 25 lbs
    • Must be comfortable bending, stooping, and standing while working directly with hardware on the floor

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating hosted or customer-furnished payloads onto a spacecraft or launch vehicle
  • Hands-on experience with aerospace environmental testing (vibration, TVAC, EMI/EMC) and associated test standards (e.g., GSFC-STD-7000 and SMC-S-016)
  • Experience working with external partners or customers to define interfaces & coordinate joint execution
  • Exposure to pharmaceutical, biomedical, or other regulated-industry hardware and quality practices

description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a highly organized, technically capable, and efficiency-driven IT Systems Administrator to support day-to-day corporate IT operations. The role will initially be approximately 80% IT operations and support, with opportunities to grow into automation, integrations, internal application development, and engineering projects over time.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of recurring IT responsibilities, solve problems independently, improve inefficient processes, and help our internal technology function scale as the company grows.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day technical support for employees and corporate systems.
  • Manage onboarding, offboarding, account provisioning, permissions, groups, and software access.
  • Support Google, Microsoft, AWS and other SaaS platforms.
  • Troubleshoot authentication, browser, application, device, and access issues.
  • Maintain accurate IT documentation, procedures, system records, and asset information.
  • Assist with endpoint, account, license, and access management.
  • Coordinate with vendors and external support when needed.
  • Take ownership of recurring IT tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Identify repetitive or inefficient processes and recommend ways to simplify or automate them.

Growth Opportunities

As Valiant expands its internal development and engineering capabilities, this position may have opportunities to contribute to:

  • AI-enabled internal tools
  • Workflow automation
  • Scripting
  • API integrations
  • Internal applications
  • Data processing and reporting
  • Cloud systems
  • Software and platform engineering projects

Desired Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of IT support, systems administration, help desk, or similar technical experience preferred. Strong entry-level candidates will be considered.
  • Development experience is not required, but an interest in automation, artificial intelligence, software, or engineering is strongly preferred.
  • Strong troubleshooting and general technical skills.
  • Experience administering business applications or SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or similar environments.
  • Basic understanding of permissions, authentication, networking, endpoints, and cloud applications.
  • Strong organization, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to learn new technologies.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, JavaScript, APIs, automation platforms, SQL, Git, cloud platforms, or web development is beneficial but not required.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 3 months: Learn Valiant's systems, handle common support requests, and take ownership of core onboarding, offboarding, and account administration tasks.
  • 3-6 months: Independently manage a significant portion of routine IT operations and begin improving or automating recurring processes.
  • 6-12 months: Become a dependable owner of day-to-day IT operations, reduce senior staff involvement in routine support, and begin contributing to automation, integration, or development projects.

Ideal Candidate is:

  • Highly organized and dependable
  • Efficiency-focused
  • Technically curious
  • Comfortable working directly with employees
  • Able to investigate problems independently
  • Interested in improving and automating repetitive work
  • Looking for a role with room to grow into broader technical responsibilities

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions is a security-focused IT solutions provider with public clients nationwide. Named one of the fastest growing privately held companies by Inc. 5000, Washington Technology’s Fast 50, and Washington Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in the D.C. area, Valiant Solutions prides itself on providing its employees with great benefits and career development opportunities. As a company, we are just as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class IT solutions, all while enjoying an unparalleled work-life balance. We are in a phase of tremendous growth and building the team that will take us to the next level. We seek people whose talents and accomplishments will contribute to a thriving company, who have the character to support their capacity, and can make a positive impact on our culture. Alongside our talented team, you’ll learn to think quickly on your feet and expand your own personal and professional skill set. Our management team will inspire you to consider new perspectives and challenge you to become a better practitioner in the fast-paced industry of IT security. We hire people we respect – and we trust them to deliver results leveraging their expertise. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment as part of a stellar team of professionals, then we invite you to apply online today.

Where a candidate falls within the band can be determined based on one or more of the following: skillset, experience level, achievements, education, geographic location, security clearance, involvement in corporate tasks, and other non-discriminatory factors. In addition to the base salary, this role will include benefits as described above. Valiant reserves the right to adjust the salary range, experience requirements, and position responsibilities at any time without prior notice.

Remote Work Policy

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that align with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. description:

This position facilitates rail shipments across multiple origins, destinations, and railroad networks supporting large oilseeds processing faculties and various origins. This role oversees railcar fleet utilization, coordinates movements with multiple Class I and short line railroads, and works closely with commercial and operations teams to ensure efficient product flow, reliable customer service, and cost-effective transportation.

title: Building Maintenance Specialist I - Full-time Temporary up to 120 calendar days

$27.00-$30.00

title: Production Planning Expediter Aerospace
company: THE LIGHTHOUSE FOR THE BLIND INC
description:
The Lighthouse for the Blind, Inc. transforms the lives of people who are blind, DeafBlind, and blind with other disabilities. Through employment opportunities, we are a catalyst for empowerment. We foster self-confidence and instill a life changing affirmation that independence is possible. From our expertise in cutting-edge technology to our understanding of mobility, we help people who are blind and DeafBlind live fulfilling lives.

We believe everyone, no matter their vision abilities, deserves to experience the power of employment. Our goal for each person we reach is to ignite a fire of determination that is centered on the reality that blindness doesn’t define who you are or how you choose to live.

Purpose:

The Production Planning Expediter is responsible for ensuring that materials and documentation are ready to support a stable, constraint-aware production schedule. This role drives flow by prioritizing and coordinating raw material, internal work-center priorities, and outside processing to ensure goods are manufactured efficiently and on time. They are a key link between customers, production, quality, and suppliers to prevent shortages and resolve delays.

Responsibilities:

• Serve as point of contact for assigned aerospace customers regarding delivery requests, schedules, and material status.
• Maintain customer delivery portals/excel spreadsheets. Provide accurate and timely updates.
• Monitor ERP/MRP exceptions, including shortages, late operations, and material discrepancies.
• Develop reporting tools to streamline customer inquiries and internal visibility.
• Track jobs through manufacturing to ensure on-time completion.
• Partners with supervisors to prioritize work based on customer demand, expedite needs, hot requirements, and constraints.
• Identify delays, shortages, and manufacturing bottlenecks. Work with cross functional groups to resolve obstacles before they impact customer delivery. Escalate issues to supervisor.
• Create and manage purchase orders for outside processing (heat treat, finish, machining) and track delivery commitments.
• Monitor outside supplier on-time delivery, escalate risks, and drive recovery plans for late or at-risk purchase orders.
• Assist in creating/releasing work orders to manufacturing based on material availability, capacity, and priority rules.
• Support internal daily standup meetings with status updates, risks, and next actions.
• Maintain a daily “Top Issues” list with owners, due dates, and recovery plans.
• Contribute to lean initiatives and scheduling improvements.

Requirements:

• College degree preferred. May substitute 2+ years of aerospace equivalent experience in expediting, planning, scheduling, or supply chain.
• Strong understanding of ERP/MRP systems.
• Ability to interpret bills-of-materials, routings, engineering drawings, and material certifications.
• Familiarity with outside processing (heat treat, finish, machining).
• Knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards and manufacturing best practices.
• Proficient in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, exception logic).
• Strong problem-solving, prioritization, communication, and organizational skills.
• Effective communication across customers, production, quality, and suppliers.
• Comfortable working in a high-mix, fast-paced aerospace manufacturing environment.
• Ability to work schedule as assigned.

Company benefits may include:

  • 2 weeks vacation after one year of employment

  • Long-term and short-term disability, AD&D

  • Team Member Referral Bonus Program
