title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Ventura, California.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Ventura area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Ventura requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Senior Staff Technical Data Analyst – Finance Technology
description:
The Intuit FLP (Finance, Legal, and Privacy) Tech team builds Intuit's core capabilities across enterprise finance, legal, and privacy applications. Within FLP Tech, the Finance Data & Analytics team is the trusted source of truth for how Intuit's Finance organization sees its own business — from month-end close and SOX-certified financial reporting to workforce, revenue, and expense analytics used across the company.

Finance data at Intuit is in the midst of a rapid shift toward AI-assisted and agentic approaches to financial reporting, controls testing, and business intelligence. We are hiring a Staff Technical Data Analyst to help lead this shift.

This is not a report-writing role. You will own report and dashboard architecture and strategy across a large, SOX-sensitive portfolio spanning Revenue, Expense, Workforce, and Compliance reporting, partnering directly with Finance, SOX/Internal Audit, and Data Engineering to make sure that portfolio is accurate, governed, and audit-ready — while also pushing it forward: consolidating redundant reporting, modernizing the underlying data architecture, and identifying where GenAI and agentic tooling can remove manual effort from financial control work rather than just producing more dashboards.

You are accountable for the outcome, not just the artifact. If a report is technically correct but doesn't survive an audit walkthrough, or a dashboard ships but nobody adopts it, that is your problem to solve.


Responsibilities

  • Report & Dashboard Portfolio Ownership: Own the architecture, roadmap, and health of a large-scale reporting portfolio (SOX and non-SOX) spanning multiple Finance domains. Maintain a single, authoritative view of what exists, who owns it, and where consolidation or retirement opportunities exist, and drive that consolidation rather than letting the portfolio grow indefinitely.

  • SOX Control Design & Compliance Reporting: Design and maintain the data validation and control frameworks that keep SOX-certified financial reporting accurate, traceable, and audit-ready. Partner directly with Internal Audit and external auditors on control design, evidence, and walkthroughs, and build the automated validation and lineage tooling that lets the business scale compliance without scaling headcount.

  • Data Architecture & Migration: Lead the technical design and execution of large-scale data migrations, including legacy BI platform to governed cloud data lake/warehouse migrations, catalog and access-control modernization, and the report-logic migrations that follow. Ensure every migration preserves data lineage, auditability, and business continuity.
  • Data Discovery for New Engagements: Partner with product managers, data engineers, and AI/data scientists at the start of new product and AI initiatives to explore, analyze, and profile the underlying data first, understanding what data exists, its quality, and any gaps, before it's used to build models, products, or pipelines.

  • Data Asset Management & Governance: Manage financial and business data as a governed asset across its lifecycle: data quality monitoring, access governance, metadata and lineage, and alignment with Intuit's data compliance standards. Prepare and maintain clean, well-documented data for both traditional BI consumption and AI/ML pipelines.

  • AI-Driven Innovation in Finance Reporting: Identify and pilot where GenAI and agentic approaches can modernize SOX testing, financial reporting, and BI: automated control testing and anomaly detection, natural-language and narrative-driven reporting, AI-assisted data quality and lineage tooling, and prompt-to-SQL or self-service analytics for business users. Bring a critical eye for where AI creates real leverage in a regulated environment and where human review and audit trails remain non-negotiable.

  • Stakeholder Partnership & Influence: Act as the primary technical partner to Finance business stakeholders (FP&A, Accounting, Revenue, Workforce Planning) and cross-functional technology teams, translating ambiguous business needs into clear technical requirements and data-driven recommendations, and translating technical constraints back into terms Finance leadership can act on.

  • Technical Delivery & Craft Leadership: Design, build, and maintain BI solutions end to end using tools such as Qlik, Databricks, Tableau, SQL, and Python, from data exploration and modeling through visualization and automated pipeline delivery. As a Staff-level individual contributor, set the craft standard for technical solution design, data quality, and documentation across the team, mentoring analysts and contingent workers and reviewing their work.


Qualifications

  • 10+ years of industry experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or technical reporting supporting Finance, Accounting, SOX/regulatory compliance, or another tightly controlled business function.

  • BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Finance/Accounting, or equivalent practical experience

  • Data & Analytics Craft Qualifications:

    • Proven strong SQL and data modeling skills, with working proficiency in Python for data pipelines, automation, or analysis.

    • Proven experience building and maintaining BI solutions and dashboards end-to-end, from data exploration and architecture through visualization and delivery, using tools such as Qlik(Sense), Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

    • Proven experience with cloud data platforms and lakehouse architectures (e.g., AWS, Databricks, Glue/Lake Formation, Snowflake), including migrations between platforms.

    • Proven experience defining data quality frameworks, lineage documentation, and access governance for data used in regulated reporting.

  • Finance & SOX Domain Expertise:

    • Direct experience supporting SOX-certified financial reporting or a comparable regulated-controls environment: control design, evidence gathering, audit walkthroughs, and change management for report-logic changes.

    • Familiarity with core Finance data domains such as revenue recognition, expense/GL data, workforce/headcount reporting, month-end close, or FP&A reporting cycles.

    • Experience partnering with Internal Audit, external auditors, or SOX/GRC teams on control testing and documentation.

  • AI Fluency & Innovation Qualifications:

    • Active, critical user of GenAI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) in your own analytics work, such as query generation, documentation, data profiling, or narrative reporting.

    • A point of view on where agentic AI and automation can responsibly modernize financial reporting and controls testing, and where human review and auditability must remain non-negotiable.

    • Curiosity about emerging AI-native BI and data-quality tooling, with a track record of piloting new tools and technologies rather than waiting for them to be handed down.

  • Sr Staff-Level Craft Qualifications:

    • Strategic Thinking & Solution Design: turns ambiguous business problems into a clear technical roadmap, and identifies roadblocks before they become blockers.

    • Technical Depth: deep, hands-on fluency across the reporting/BI stack; equally comfortable in an architecture conversation or writing (and reviewing) the SQL.

    • Ownership & Accountability: owns outcomes end-to-end, including production issues and audit findings, not just the deliverable that was originally scoped.

    • Influence Without Authority: bridges Finance, Audit, Engineering, and Data Governance stakeholders and drives alignment even where nothing formally reports to you.

    • Mentorship: raises the bar for the team through technical reviews, coaching analysts and contingent workers, and contributing to hiring and calibration.


Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. title: Art Director | New Games
description:
Craft:

Art

Job Description:

We’re looking for a hands-on Art Director to help shape the next generation of casual mobile games at King. You’ll join a small, newly formed, cross-functional team exploring new game ideas through rapid prototyping and player testing, then developing the titles that show promise.


The team is an on-site team (5 days a week) based in Stockholm.


This role combines creative leadership with making art. You’ll define the visual direction, create assets yourself, and work closely with the team to get appealing art into playable builds quickly. You will have a close collaboration with the creative director to define the visual world fantasy. Fluency in AI-assisted art creation is essential: you know how to guide, refine and combine AI outputs with your own 2D and 3D skills to achieve the visual result you want.


You’ll bring strong artistic judgment, curiosity and the confidence to put work in front of external players early. You understand what needs polish, what’s ready to test, and when a different direction will teach us more.


Your role within the Kingdom

  • Define and deliver the artistic vision. Explore distinctive, appealing visual directions for casual mobile games, working with both new and existing IP. Translate promising ideas into a coherent look that supports gameplay and connects with players.
  • Create art hands-on. Produce concepts, mock-ups and game-ready assets using 2D, 3D and AI-assisted workflows. Work closely with developers to get art into the game and evaluate it in context.
  • Make AI part of your creative practice. Choose the right tools for the task and take control of their outputs through clear direction, iteration and hands-on editing. Build practical, repeatable workflows that help the team move faster while maintaining a consistent style.
  • Prototype, test and adapt. Create good-looking art quickly and evolve the visuals based on player data. Be comfortable changing direction or letting go of work when a stronger opportunity emerges.
  • Lead and develop others. Give clear direction and actionable feedback to artists across game art, VFX, UI and animation. Coach and mentor the art team, lead external partners when needed, and balance leadership with your own creative contribution.
  • Collaborate across disciplines. Work closely with producers, designers, developers and marketing to connect visual decisions with gameplay, technical needs and the broader player experience.

Skills to create thrills

  • Senior art direction experience and a strong craft foundation
  • Practical fluency in AI-assisted art creation
  • Hands-on skills in both 2D and 3D
  • An excellent eye for casual game visuals
  • A fast, flexible approach to development
  • A player-focused mindset
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary art teams
  • Clear, collaborative communication
  • An understanding of in-game implementation

Bonus points

  • Experience in small teams, new game development or rapid prototyping.
  • Hands-on experience implementing art in Unity.
  • Experience with world building, video production or animation.
  • Experience developing new IP or adapting established IP for new game experiences.

Show us your work

Please include an online portfolio showing your artistic range, hands-on work and art direction experience, including examples of both 2D and 3D work.

We’d especially like to see how you move from an idea to visuals in a playable game, and how you use AI within that process. For collaborative projects, clearly describe your contribution. Process examples, iterations and work shaped by player feedback are welcome alongside finished work.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Commissioning Technician III
location: Long Beach, California, United States; Torrance, California, United States
description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

The Commissioning Technician III is responsible for commissioning, calibration, troubleshooting, repair, rework, and qualification of large-format laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) 3D printers and supporting manufacturing equipment.

The role brings complex equipment and integrated systems online, verifies performance against engineering requirements, restores non-conforming equipment to full capability, and prepares equipment for production operation.

The Technician is specifically responsible for multi-laser optical calibration and verification, including laser alignment and registration to the machine coordinate system and build plane. The role also supports mechanical, electrical, motion, pneumatic, hydraulic, controls, robotics, powder-handling, inert-gas, and other systems as applicable.

The Role

Equipment Commissioning & Systems Integration

  • Commission LPBF printers and supporting manufacturing equipment following assembly, installation, or major modification.
  • Bring equipment and subsystems online in a controlled sequence and verify performance against engineering requirements.
  • Commission LPBF systems including X/Y/Z motion, powder handling, inert gas, condensate collection, controls, recoater systems, and multi-laser optical systems.
  • Verify system interfaces, machine configuration, and conditions required for calibration and qualification.
  • Identify conditions affecting accuracy, repeatability, throughput, quality, or production readiness.

LPBF Printer Commissioning

  • Commission X/Y/Z motion stages and verify positioning, homing, travel limits, alignment, and repeatability.
  • Commission powder handling, inert gas, condensate collection, and associated control systems.
  • Bring hardware controls online and verify communications, I/O, sensors, actuators, alarms, and interlocks.
  • Install, align, adjust, and verify recoater systems.

Multi-Laser Optical Calibration & Verification

  • Perform and document optical calibration of multi-laser LPBF systems in accordance with engineering requirements.
  • Align and register each laser to the machine coordinate system and common build plane.
  • Verify laser-to-laser alignment, positioning, and optical performance across the build area.
  • Use optical measurement and calibration equipment to identify and correct alignment or performance issues.
  • Perform approved optical adjustments, calibration, and related mechanical rework.
  • Troubleshoot optical issues and work with Engineering on conditions outside established procedures.
  • Repeat calibration following repairs, component changes, or other modifications affecting optical performance.
  • Maintain calibration records and confirm optical acceptance criteria before machine qualification.

Supporting Manufacturing Equipment

  • Commission depowdering equipment and verify material removal, containment, collection, controls, and safety systems.
  • Commission powder sieving and handling systems and verify material flow, transfer, controls, and interfaces.
  • Commission anodizing and coating lines and associated material handling, fluid systems, controls, and safety systems.
  • Commission robotic assembly cells, including robots, tooling, fixtures, sensors, safety systems, and programmed sequences.
  • Commission automated material-handling systems supporting LPBF production.

Motion, Mechanical & Equipment Calibration

  • Commission and verify precision motion systems using established procedures and engineering requirements.
  • Establish and verify machine coordinate systems, homing, travel limits, positioning, and motion performance.
  • Perform mechanical alignment, calibration, adjustment, and verification using precision measurement equipment.
  • Troubleshoot motion issues involving mechanical components, sensors, motors, drives, encoders, controls, and configuration.
  • Document calibration results and escalate conditions requiring Engineering support.

Controls, Automation & System Verification

  • Commission controls including sensors, actuators, drives, valves, motors, robots, and interlocks.
  • Verify I/O, communications, machine states, alarms, safety systems, and interlocks.
  • Execute functional checks and verify commanded versus actual equipment response.
  • Troubleshoot automation issues using equipment behavior, measurements, diagnostics, and system information.
  • Verify robotic sequences, automated cycles, material handling, and equipment interfaces.
  • Work with Controls, Software, Robotics, and Development Engineering to resolve system-level issues.

Repairs, Rework & Troubleshooting

  • Perform repairs, rework, adjustments, replacements, and corrective actions required to bring equipment into specification.
  • Diagnose non-functioning or underperforming equipment and determine the appropriate repair, rework, or escalation path.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, motion, controls, robotic, optical, powder-handling, fluid, and gas systems.
  • Use drawings, specifications, test data, configuration information, and diagnostics to identify sources of non-conformance.
  • Verify repaired or reworked equipment meets functional, calibration, safety, and performance requirements.
  • Document repairs, rework, component changes, and verification results.
  • Own commissioning issues through identification, corrective action, and verification.

Test Runs & Machine Qualification

  • Execute equipment test cycles, process runs, and qualification activities following commissioning and calibration.
  • Execute LPBF test prints to verify alignment, calibration, functionality, and production readiness.
  • Verify critical commissioning gates, including optical calibration, laser registration, motion calibration, and recoater alignment, before qualification builds.
  • Prepare machines for qualification by verifying configuration, calibration, consumables, process parameters, and safety conditions.
  • Execute verification activities for depowdering, sieving, coating, anodizing, robotic assembly, and other supporting equipment.
  • Evaluate machine and process data against engineering requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Perform follow-up measurements, adjustments, repairs, or rework as required.
  • Document test and qualification results and support final equipment acceptance.

ERP, Configuration & Documentation

  • Use ERP and manufacturing systems to record commissioning work orders, equipment status, material consumption, and completed operations.
  • Maintain equipment configuration, serialized hardware, component revision, calibration, and commissioning records.
  • Document as-built configuration and approved changes made during commissioning.
  • Complete commissioning, inspection, calibration, and qualification records while maintaining traceability of repairs, rework, component changes, optical calibration, and configuration updates.

Commissioning Process Improvement

  • Identify sources of commissioning delay, rework, variability, and recurring failures.
  • Develop and implement improvements to commissioning sequences, procedures, tooling, fixtures, calibration methods, and test methods.
  • Improve optical calibration methods while maintaining required accuracy and repeatability.
  • Use commissioning data, failure history, and team feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Standardize effective commissioning methods across equipment and manufacturing cells.
  • Capture lessons learned and incorporate improvements into procedures, standard work, training, and troubleshooting guides.

Team & Cross-Functional Support

  • Work collaboratively with technicians of varying skill levels to complete commissioning, troubleshooting, repair, rework, and qualification activities.
  • Provide technical assistance and knowledge transfer to less-experienced technicians and seek support when required.
  • Share troubleshooting methods, equipment knowledge, and lessons learned.
  • Communicate equipment status, technical issues, risks, and required support clearly.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Controls, Software, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls.
  • 5+ years of experience in equipment commissioning, machine integration, electromechanical assembly, manufacturing, testing, automation, robotics, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical and electromechanical equipment.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, schematics, specifications, procedures, and technical documentation.
  • Working knowledge of motion systems, motors, drives, sensors, actuators, and industrial controls.
  • Experience using mechanical and electrical measurement equipment.
  • Experience with commissioning, calibration, verification, and structured troubleshooting.
  • Ability to recognize conditions that do not conform to engineering requirements.
  • Experience using ERP, MRP, MES, or similar manufacturing systems.
  • Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a multidisciplinary team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience commissioning industrial 3D printers, additive manufacturing equipment, or complex capital equipment.
  • Experience with LPBF systems and multi-laser optical calibration or alignment.
  • Experience with depowdering, powder sieving, powder handling, coating, anodizing, robotic assembly, or automated material handling.
  • Experience with precision motion systems, servo systems, encoders, motors, and drives.
  • Experience with pneumatic, hydraulic, inert-gas, vacuum, fluid, or powder-handling systems.
  • Experience with PLCs, industrial controls, robotics, sensors, actuators, and automated equipment.
  • Experience with machine qualification, acceptance testing, or production release.
  • Experience with precision alignment, calibration, GD&T, and dimensional measurement.
  • Experience in aerospace, automotive, robotics, semiconductor, additive manufacturing, or other advanced manufacturing environments.
  • Experience developing standardized processes or applying Lean/continuous-improvement methods.

Work Environment

  • Fully onsite within a development, manufacturing, and equipment commissioning environment.
  • Work around large-format industrial equipment incorporating mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, robotic, optical, inert-gas, powder-handling, coating, and automated systems.
  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, reaching, climbing, and working around large machine assemblies and manufacturing cells.
  • Ability to lift and move up to 50 pounds independently; heavier components require assistance or appropriate equipment.
  • Follow applicable PPE, ESD, laser, electrical, inert-gas, powder-handling, chemical/process, cleanliness, and machine-safety requirements.
  • May require extended hours, shift work, or weekend support during commissioning, qualification, production ramp, and equipment deployment.
Pay Range
$36—$50 USD

What We Offer:

  • Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.
  • Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.
  • Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.
  • Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.
  • Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

Job Summary:

Integrated Fire & Security Solutions, Fort Myers Branch is seeking a Fire Alarm Inspector to join our team. The Inspector is responsible for conducting inspections, testing, and preventative maintenance of fire alarm systems to ensure compliance with all local, state, federal, and applicable NFPA codes, as well as customer operational requirements. This individual will focus on the proper function of fire alarm systems while also inspecting and testing other low voltage systems that support our customers, including but not limited to Intrusion, Access Control, and CCTV systems.

The ideal candidate has experience performing inspections, troubleshooting system deficiencies, completing inspection documentation, and ensuring all work is performed safely and in compliance with industry standards.

The Inspector reports directly to the Service Manager and works closely with the Service Coordinator and other members of the service team. Service area will primarily be Fort Myers and surrounding Southwest Florida markets.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct routine inspections, testing, and preventative maintenance on Fire Alarm, Access Control, CCTV, and Intrusion systems, as well as similar competitive manufacturers' products.
  • Perform testing and verification of low voltage systems and associated devices to ensure proper system operation and code compliance.
  • Identify deficiencies, document findings, and communicate recommendations for corrective action.
  • Complete Service Acknowledgements, inspection reports, and all required documentation accurately using electronic or hard-copy formats.
  • Maintain inspection records and documentation required by customers and authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs), including healthcare and life safety regulatory agencies where applicable.
  • Manage assigned inspection schedules and complete inspections in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Input, retrieve, and maintain inspection documents electronically.
  • Adhere to all company safety standards, policies, and procedures.
  • Maintain professional interactions with customers while providing excellent customer service.
  • Coordinate with service technicians, project teams, and branch personnel to address inspection findings and customer needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Service Manager.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of experience performing inspections, testing, or servicing fire alarm systems and/or low voltage systems.
  • Working knowledge of fire alarm systems, applicable NFPA standards, and inspection procedures.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, specifications, and technical manuals.
  • Ability to identify system deficiencies and recommend corrective actions.
  • Experience completing inspection reports and maintaining accurate documentation.
  • Ability to meet company driving eligibility requirements, including holding a valid driver's license and maintaining an acceptable motor vehicle record.
  • Ability to maintain professional and technical knowledge through ongoing training and industry education.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while effectively managing time and priorities.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated reliability, responsibility, and professionalism.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with team members and customers.
  • NICET certification or Florida Fire Alarm Inspector licensing is preferred but not required.

This role may require extended periods of sitting or standing, movement around the office or job site, and operation of standard equipment. Physical activities can include reaching, bending, kneeling, climbing, and lifting up to 75 lbs. Field positions may involve heavy lifting, working in varying climates (including outdoor conditions), construction or low-voltage environments, and exposure to dust, noise, or confined spaces. title: 22589 - Community Payback Co-Ordinator - Reading - Outcome in a Day (South Central)
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other live applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Project Manager – Procurement Services
description:
Energy Project Solutions (EPS) is an energy consulting firm that helps partners deliver efficient, high-value projects through localized expertise and real-world insight. With more than 500 years of collective experience, our team leads complex energy developments from inception through construction, bringing deep knowledge across engineering, real estate, business development, and finance while leveraging strong relationships with developers, owners, financial institutions, and property owners nationwide.

This is an opportunity to sit at the center of complex energy and infrastructure projects and help turn strategy into execution. As a Project Manager within our Procurement Services group, you’ll play a key role in sourcing, logistics, quality, and material coordination, working cross-functionally to ensure the right materials, vendors, and processes are in place to support successful project delivery. If you enjoy ownership, problem-solving, and building structure in fast-moving environments, this role offers meaningful impact from day one.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute and support sourcing activities including RFQs, bid evaluations, supplier selection, and commercial coordination.
  • Partner with internal teams to understand project requirements and translate them into effective procurement and execution plans.
  • Manage vendor relationships, monitor performance, and support contract administration and issue resolution.
  • Coordinate logistics, transportation, and trade compliance activities to ensure timely and compliant material delivery.
  • Support quality surveillance and inspection activities, including documentation, reporting, and non-conformance tracking.
  • Own deliverables from kickoff through completion, maintaining trackers, schedules, risk logs, and client-facing reports.

Who You Are

  • You have 4–7 years of experience in procurement, supply chain, project management, or related operational roles.
  • You understand sourcing, logistics, vendor management, and project coordination fundamentals.
  • You’re highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams with competing priorities.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally with clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • You bring strong attention to detail and follow-through, ensuring accuracy and quality in deliverables.
  • You thrive in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments and take ownership without needing heavy direction.
  • You have a "Do what needs to be done" mindset, taking ownership beyond assigned tasks and stepping in wherever needed to keep projects, teams, and customers supported and running smoothly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in energy, construction, utilities, infrastructure, or industrial sectors.
  • Exposure to quality inspection processes, trade compliance, or material management.
  • Familiarity with ERP or procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Coupa.
  • Strong analytical skills related to market trends, pricing, and supply chain risk.
  • Interest in process improvement and building scalable procurement practices.

Why EPS?

At EPS, we believe your work should support your life, not the other way around. Here's what you can count on when you join our team:

  • Meaningful Growth: Whether you're just starting out or looking to advance, we offer hands-on training, mentorship, and clear paths for professional development so you can grow with purpose.
  • Real Collaboration: Join a team that brings diverse perspectives together to solve complex challenges with creativity, curiosity, and a shared commitment to quality.
  • Respect for Your Time: We value work-life balance and offer generous PTO and a supportive environment that helps you manage both personal and professional responsibilities.
  • Benefits That Care: You’ll have access to health coverage that supports your total well-being, plus a 401(k) match, paid holidays, and more resources to help you thrive.
  • Weekly Team Lunches: Take a break and recharge with your teammates. We believe food brings people together.
  • Culture That Connects: We invest in experiences that build strong teams and strong communities.

title: Sleep & Pulmonary Function Technologist
description:
Union: Non-Union
Number of vacancies: 1
New or Replacement Position: Replacement
Site: West Park Healthcare Center
Department: RES- Respiratory Evaluation Services
Reports to: Program Manager
Salary Range: $34.88 to $43.59
Hours: 37.5
Shifts: 8 hour and 12 hour shifts- days, nights, and weekends (as required
Status: Permanent Full-Time
Closing Date: October 22, 2026

Position Summary

The Sleep and Pulmonary Function Technologist is responsible for the performance of routine tests of pulmonary function (PFTs) as well as studies of overnight polysomnography on individuals with suspected or established disease. Major Responsibilities of the Sleep and Pulmonary Function Technologist at UHN- West Park Healthcare Centre include:

Collect and analyze sleep and pulmonary function test data on a variety of patients, including those with complex medical needs and/or chronic or progressive disease by:

  • preparing patients for overnight polysomnography tests and collecting data in accordance with accepted professional and laboratory standards.
  • assisting with patient’s personal care needs during the night which may include physical and mechanical lift transfers of patient to bed and wheelchair, turning, positioning, toileting etc.
  • applying treatment devices (eg. CPAP, BiLevel PAP, volume ventilators, oxygen) and adjusting parameters through the night based on clinical observations.
  • documenting observations, recommendations and clinical findings.
  • performing daytime pulmonary function tests such as (but not limited to) Spirometry, Diffusion, Body Plethysmography, MIPS/MEPS in accordance with accepted professional and laboratory standards with bronchodilator administration as required.
  • performing daytime analysis of sleep and pulmonary function data in accordance with accepted professional and laboratory standards and producing timely and accurate reports.
  • sharing information gathered with patients and their family members, physicians, service coordinators and other interprofessional healthcare team members as required

Ensuring patient safety is a priority by:

  • complying with hospital and legislated safety standards.
  • preventing, identifying and responding appropriately to safety and medical issues and emergencies.

Maintaining effective, efficient and quality service through:

  • requisition assessment for patient acuity to ensure appropriate care.
  • equipment set-up, calibration, routine maintenance, troubleshooting, disinfection and sterilization and maintenance of all associated records.
  • quality control and assurance of equipment and data collected.
  • clerical duties such as filing, entering data into database and supply ordering.
  • active participation in departmental/Professional Standards & Issues Committee (PSIC) meetings and hospital-wide committees and policy and procedure development.
  • collaboration and communication with hospital staff, physicians, external diagnostic facilities and equipment vendors.
  • obligation of staff to obtain registered sleep and pulmonary function designations within allotted timeframes.

Continuing education and teaching:

  • attendance and participation at rounds, conferences, webinars etc.
  • completion of centre-wide e-learning modules.
  • teaching Respiratory Therapy, Sleep, Medical and Physiotherapy students in accordance with University of Toronto and Michener Institute teaching curriculum.
  • educating patients through monthly sleep and pulmonary function talks within the hospital.
  • training and mentoring of new staff members which includes accountability for quality test data and patient care for up to 1 year.

Exemplifying the core values of UHN:

  • Safety, Compassion, Teamwork, Integrity, Stewardship.
  • Following UHN's core purpose of transforming the lives and communities through excellence in care, discovery, and learning along with our primary value of the needs of patients come first.

Required (Minimum):

  • University degree and/or college diploma in Human Life Sciences, Pulmonary Function/ Sleep Technology or equivalent.
  • Registered pulmonary function technologist or registry eligible.
  • Registered polysomnographic technologist or registry eligible.
  • Ability to work independently in a sophisticated laboratory environment.
  • Strong technical skills.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and teamwork abilities.

Desired/ Preferred:

  • Current BLS certification.
  • Experience working with people with complex or progressive illnesses or disabilities, including patients with a tracheostomy and/or ventilatory assisted individuals, and individuals with limited mobility.
  • Practical understanding of mechanical ventilators.

Why join UHN?

In addition to working alongside some of the most talented and inspiring healthcare professionals in the world, UHN offers a wide range of benefits, programs and perks. It is the comprehensiveness of these offerings that makes it a differentiating factor, allowing you to find value where it matters most to you, now and throughout your career at UHN.

  • Competitive offer packages
  • Government organization and a member of the Healthcare of Ontario Pension Plan (HOOPP )
  • Close access to Transit and UHN shuttle service
  • A flexible work environment
  • Opportunities for development and promotions within a large organization
  • Additional perks (multiple corporate discounts including: travel, restaurants, parking, phone plans, auto insurance discounts, on-site gyms, etc.)

Current UHN employees must have successfully completed their probationary period, have a good employee record along with satisfactory attendance in accordance with UHN's attendance management program, to be eligible for consideration.

All applications must be submitted before the posting close date.

UHN uses email to communicate with selected candidates. Please ensure you check your email regularly. At University Health Network (UHN), artificial intelligence technologies may be used to assist in the screening, assessment, and selection of candidates for this position.

Please be advised that a Criminal Record Check may be required of the successful candidate. Should it be determined that any information provided by a candidate be misleading, inaccurate or incorrect, UHN reserves the right to discontinue with the consideration of their application.

UHN is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive recruitment process and workplace. Requests for accommodation can be made at any stage of the recruitment process. Applicants need to make their requirements known.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

title: [CES] 딜리버리 파트너십 전략 매니저 (Operation Strategy)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡이츠서비스(Coupang Eats Services)는 Delivery service에 대한 차별화 전략을 세우고, 쿠팡이츠의 고객, 상점주, 그리고 배달파트너들에게 한층 더 강화된 서비스와 지원을 제공하고 있습니다.
쿠팡이츠서비스는 원하는 음식을 언제 어디서든 빠르고 안전하게 배달함으로써 고객에게 놀라운 고객 경험을 선사하고, 상점주에게는 주문부터 배달, 고객응대까지 제공하는 원스톱 서비스를 통해 안정적인 판매 기회를 확보할수 있는 시스템을 운영하고 있습니다.
여러 분야의 전문가로 구성된 쿠팡이츠서비스는 하나의 팀으로서 고객과 상점주, 배달파트너가 원하는 가치를 고민하고 연구하며, 새로운 혁신과 패러다임 변화를 이끌어가고 있습니다.

직무 소개

Operations Strategy 팀은 딜리버리 벤더 생태계를 고도화하고 성장 구조를 설계하는 전략 팀입니다.
운영이 고도화된 환경에서는 CX 기반 세일즈 타겟 도출과 벤더향 데이터 솔루션 상품화에 집중하고, 신규 지역에서는 계약 모델 설계부터 세일즈 및 현장 오퍼레이션 관리까지 사업 전반을 리드합니다.
각 시장에 최적화된 전략과 데이터 솔루션을 통해 전사 딜리버리 인프라의 경쟁력을 강화합니다.

업무 내용

  • 글로벌 푸드딜리버리 3PL 생태계를 관통하는 계약 모델 설계, 사업 타당성 검토 및 타겟팅 전략 수립
  • 파트너십 리스크와 수익성을 균형 있게 고려한 거버넌스 및 상업적 프레임워크 구축, 데이터 솔루션의 아이디어 도출부터 유상 상품화까지 End-to-End 라이프사이클 총괄
  • 다양한 팀과의 협업을 통해 전략적 요구사항이 실제 시스템 로직 및 신규 기능으로 구현되도록 리드
  • 지역별 수요 및 CX 예측 상황을 반영한 최적 오더량/목표 도출 및 오퍼레이션 거버넌스 수립
  • 거시경제, 산업 트렌드, 규제 변화 및 경쟁 환경에 대한 데이터 기반의 리서치·분석 체계 구축
  • 주요 실행 지표(KPI) 정의, 대시보드 트래킹 체계 구축, 원인 분석을 통한 지속적인 비즈니스 및 CX 개선 이끌기

자격 요건

  • 10년 이상의 관련 직무 경력을 보유하신 분
  • 복잡하고 방대한 Raw Data를 구조화하여 실행 가능한 비즈니스 전략 및 기능으로 전환해 본 경험과 데이터 기반 문제 해결 능력을 보유하신 분
  • 정답이 정해지지 않은 환경에서 신규 이니셔티브를 정의하고 End-to-End로 프로젝트를 완수한 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자 간의 우선순위를 정렬하고 의사결정을 이끌어내는 영향력을 보유하신 분
  • 비즈니스 수준급 영어 또는 일본어 소통이 가능하신 분

우대 사항

  • 이커머스, 퀵커머스/인스턴트 커머스, 라스트마일, 3PL 물류, 글로벌 플랫폼 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 한국-일본 간 크로스보더 프로젝트 또는 글로벌 비즈니스 스케일업/롤아웃 리딩 경험을 보유하신 분
  • SQL, Superset, Power BI 등 데이터 분석 툴 활용 능력 및 데이터 모델링에 대한 높은 이해도를 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 직무 적합성 인터뷰 - 핵심 역량 인터뷰 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupanges.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Mobile QA
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer, Mobile QA to join the App Infra team within the Consumer & Business group. The team is leading the greenfield native rewrite of Coinbase's retail mobile app in Swift and Kotlin, replacing the existing React Native codebase to deliver a significantly faster experience for millions of customers. As we do so, we need to reinvent our mobile release process from the ground up to ensure each release passes rigorous quality gates before reaching customers. You'll set Coinbase’s Frontend quality bar, translating org-level strategy into the test infrastructure and operational practices that ~30 product teams depend upon.

What you'll do:

  • Own the technical strategy for mobile QA infrastructure across the native rewrite, operating at depth across the team's codebases and designing operational practices that lower maintenance and operational overhead while raising release quality.
  • Build and scale automated test systems for recurring regression testing. Before asking for additional headcount, you set and refine what gets automated versus what stays human across regression, performance validation, and release readiness gating.
  • Lead the QA readiness workstream for the phased rollout, driving clarity across success metrics, resourcing, and operations.
  • Guide when to invest more testing resources and when to pull back as quality gains diminish.
  • Partner cross-functionally with engineering leadership, product, and design to define SLOs and quality dashboards that provide the metric-driven controls for rollout speed decisions.
  • Shape the QA onboarding playbook for product teams transitioning to native, setting the team's hiring bar for QA contributors and mentoring L3-L5 engineers on test architecture, native debugging, and quality standards.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with deep expertise in mobile test infrastructure, including architecting automated regression systems for native iOS and Android at scale.
  • Track record of defining and delivering test infrastructure strategy that other engineering teams depend on.
  • Strong proficiency in Swift and Kotlin with the ability to architect test frameworks, debug native app behavior, and enforce compile-time quality constraints, maintaining standards even in the face of pressure to ship.
  • Experience operating QA processes during large-scale migrations or platform transitions, including managing dual-codebase parity validation, phased rollout quality gates, and leading SEVs and postmortems that improve team practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to build alignment and secure commitment from cross-team and cross-functional partners on quality standards, testing strategy, and release criteria.
  • Uses generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and measurable gains in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Nutrition Specialist
description:
About Start Corporation

Start Corporation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization founded in 1984. Our Mission is to promote opportunities, which enhance the self-sufficiency of people to empower them to live and function independently.


Job Description

Provides nutrition assessment, counseling, education, and referral services to clients while evaluating nutritional needs, health risks, and eligibility requirements. Maintains accurate documentation, monitors program compliance and quality improvement efforts, and supports clinical audits and accreditation requirements. Collaborates with healthcare providers, clients, and community partners to coordinate services and ensure appropriate nutrition care and resources.


Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Nutritional Sciences, Community Nutrition, Clinical Nutrition, Dietetics, Public Health Nutrition, or Home Economics with emphasis in Nutrition. 15 hours of nutrition education required.
  • Be over 18 years of age
  • Possess a valid driver’s license
  • Current CPR certification
  • Prior experience preferred


Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of electronic documentation program.
  • Knowledge and ability to monitor and measure programs compliance with all applicable policies, funding and billing regulations and laws.
  • Knowledge of compliance audits and ability to participate in audits related to documentation requirements, clinical quality, and program licensing regulations, and accurately report findings.
  • Knowledge and ability to monitor all aspects of quality assurance/improvement and to implement plans to further improve quality.
  • Knowledge and ability to assist in monitoring program’s compliance to applicable accreditation standards and implementing corrective action plans as necessary.


Job Duties / Skills Required

  • Screens applicants for eligibility. This requires interviewing applicants to determine and verifying income for the household, and computing the information using electronic software for determination.
  • Provides participant centered nutrition counseling and referral services for clients.
  • Completes a nutrition assessment for applicant, utilizing the information to accurately assess nutrition risk and provide nutrition and health recommendations for the participant.
  • Breastfeeding promotion for clients, community partners, and health providers. Refers breast-feeding clients to the Breast Feeding Peer Counselor Program.
  • Prescribes Food packages tailored to the participant’s needs, issuing warrants following policies and procedures.
  • Schedules and maintains appointments in computerized database.
  • Refers high risk clients to Registered Dietician services for additional nutrition counseling.
  • Knowledgeable and detailed operation of the Louisiana software for warrants preparation, distribution and record’s maintenance.
  • When required, completes health measurements on all applicants. This includes height, weight, and blood samples. These measurements need to be completed following methods approved by the State of Louisiana Program as ensured by the Clinical supervisor.
  • Provides clerical duties including the use of a copier, fax, computers and other office equipment, filing and web based operations and light housekeeping duties.
  • Maintain a clear driving record in order to be able to drive company vehicles when necessary.
  • Attends all staff meetings as scheduled.
  • Other duties may be assigned.


Benefits include:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance; disability and life insurance; paid time off; 13 paid holidays per year for regular full-time employees; and a 403(b) retirement plan with employer matching.

title: Data Architect
description:
As a Data Architect you will help drive data and AI transformations for our clients by helping our clients .   • Multi-cloud, data warehousing and data lake platforms

  • Data manipulation, integration and ingestion technologies

  • Programming/scripting languages

  • ML/AI frameworks

  • Infrastructure & DevOps concepts and tooling,

IT

In this role, you will provide day-to-day IT support, interact positively with staff, and play a key role in onboarding new hires to ensure productivity from day one. This role is ideal for someone seeking fast-tracked career progression, exposure to multiple technologies, and the opportunity to be a valued member of a vibrant, collaborative IT team. A natural curiosity and a drive to continuously learn are essential to be successful in this role.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

  • Carry out the day-to-day functions required to provide quality IT support and service by interacting positively with our staff, answering inquiries, and effectively handling complaints
  • Track and update support desk Incident, Request, Problem, and Change, Project tickets, and other documentation
  • You will be the point of contact for any onboarding of new hires to ensure they are setup and productive from day one

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years’ experience in IT support and high school diploma or GED
  • Exposure with most and solid operational experience in at least two of the following:
    • Windows or Linux desktop operating systems (including imaging, maintenance, troubleshooting)
    • PC hardware (including assembly and disassembly of desktop PCs)
    • Understanding of networking infrastructure and basic troubleshooting (TCP/IP/DNS)
    • A scripting language
    • Active Directory and Group Policy

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Certifications in CompTIAA+ or ITIL

  • Familiarity with virtualization technologies and public/private cloud environments
  • Familiarity with common AI platforms and the ability to write effective prompts, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve service delivery and operational efficiency
  • Experience with Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible and Terraform
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, able to see the big picture and make connections
  • Experience participating in and supporting a medium to complex, end‑to‑end IT project, in all phases from initial requirements gathering and planning through implementation, testing, stakeholder coordination, and ongoing operational support

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.
