title: Executive Producer - Call of Duty
description:
Job Title:

Executive Producer - Call of Duty

Requisition ID:

R028234

Job Description:

Job Title: Executive Producer

Reporting To: Senior Director of Production

Department: Production

Location: Santa Monica, CA



Your Platform

Founded in 1979, Activision has continuously disrupted the world of entertainment as a leader in the videogame industry. With a history of delivering iconic game changers -- like Pitfall®, Tony Hawk®, Guitar Hero®, Crash Bandicoot™, Skylanders™ and Call of Duty® -- our obsession is delighting our players around the globe. Focused and committed to innovation, we consistently deliver the most beloved, engaging and successful entertainment.


And while we have world-class franchises, infrastructure and resources, our success comes from a passionate, talented and diverse team of people producing greatness together. So, if you’re interested in our biggest priority, it’s our people.


We’re currently driving the next era for our company and community by creating amazing experiences for fans and continuing to make Activision an inclusive place where everyone can thrive.


Join us, make history. To learn more, check us out at , or @Activision on Instagram, Twitter, Facebook and LinkedIn.


Your Mission

Activision Publishing is currently looking for an Executive Producer to join the Call of Duty franchise production team. We are looking for an individual who has a passion and proven track record of leading production initiatives.


As Executive Producer, you will manage production initiatives on one or multiple projects across various platforms from both a business and publishing perspective. You will partner with both internal and external studios in a wide range of areas to achieve franchise initiatives as well as attain financial and schedule goals. This entails day-to-day involvement with the development teams and key publishing stakeholders throughout all phases of development, including pre-production, production, submission, and release. Specific duties include: working with teams to build out initiative requirements, goals, and roadmaps; ensure milestones are delivered on-time and the game meets quality standards; help maintain creative vision; track overall development; and work closely with all developers and cross-functional groups to deliver initiatives, activations, and digital content to meet all project and franchise goals. You will guide and advance Call of Duty as you work with all Studios and Business Partners. This role will continuously iterate on best practices across all the franchise games, adapting with the business.


You will be a project leader, and work in with multiple cross-functional groups, ranging from Activision executive leadership to development studios, and use your experience on the front lines to improve production and organizational processes, as well as drive key franchise initiatives with both developers and internal department leads.


This position is based in our Santa Monica, California office and follows an in-office work model of four days per week. Working arrangements may evolve based on business needs.


Your responsibilities will include

  • Manage and track game development with internal / external studios across all SKUs of production initiatives tied to a mainline product and its digital life-cycle.
  • Support the creation, development, and execution of production initiatives, projects, pathways, and overall plan; continue to provide supervision and support through full operations life-cycle
  • Collaborate with business partners and studios to provide players with a steady stream of compelling features, content, and events
  • Partner with monetization and analytics teams to understand the game’s status and plan updates accordingly
  • Act as primary point of contact with Game Development Studios, 1st Parties, Marketing, PR, Operations, Sales, Supply Chain, Licensors, and external contractors across project initiatives
  • Partner with Marketing to execute plans for the product lines, brands, and lines of business
  • Partner with Developers to ensure specific game features are tied to overall title positioning and goals
  • Be an internal and external advocate for the product and support as needed at trade shows and PR events.
  • Coach and develop staff to ensure growth and expand the talent base
  • Create a culture that promotes collaboration, continuous feedback, support and empowerment. Set clear goals for the team and hold employees accountable for deliverables; recognize and reward employees for strong performance
  • Establish model behavior that supports Activision’s standards of professionalism, integrity, and ethics
  • Provide creative and executional direction to development studios to improve product quality and drive franchise innovation. Ensure the titles and franchise maintain or exceed creative and technical objectives with each release

What you bring to the table

  • Proven Executive Producer with either internal development or publishing experience who delivers projects to quality, on time and budget.
  • 10+ years of experience in the gaming industry (in a production role); experience with First Person Shooters or Online FPS preferred with 3+ years of experience at Senior Producer level or above.
  • The ability to identify risks early and often and suggest mitigation strategies that are thought through and take into account multiple paths to a solution.
  • A Leader of People. Be prepared to lead, mentor and develop future leaders.
  • You are knowledgeable about games and trends in the industry ranging from other competitive FPS titles, Monetization, E-Sports and other ways games are expanding beyond the core mainline experience.

Collaborator & Communicator

  • You speak other languages; specifically, the languages of marketing, PR, Sales, QA, Customer Service, Localizations, Tech, Monetization, CRM, etc. Producing the game is only part of the job. You’ll collaborate with a wide variety of groups and people.
  • Experience effectively collaborating with internal teams and development studios within the video game industry. You will only be as successful as your relationship with the development teams allows.
  • You will be the main point of contact for one of the biggest entertainment franchises in the world and requires best in class and timely communications across all mediums (emails, phone, meetings, presentations, etc.)

Gamer Who Knows How to Make a Game Great

  • You are passionate about making video games.
  • Ability to evaluate and judge gameplay in its current state and its trajectory towards close. Can identify what plays and looks good and how to drive improvements toward greatness by leveraging qualitative assessments.
  • Experience identifying the strengths and weakness in a game and knowing when to marshal resources to lean into strengths or address weaknesses.

Strategist with the Skills to Execute

  • Strong business/financial acumen and understanding of current business models in gaming
  • Never afraid to roll up your sleeves to get the job done
  • Facilitator who clear roadblocks in front of your team or the development team
  • Able to juggle competing priorities and timelines
  • Able to break down impossible tasks and make them possible through ingenuity, creativity, and effort.

The Skills & Experience we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher education degree preferred
  • 10+ years of experience in the gaming industry (in a production role)
  • 3+ years of experience at Sr. Producer level or above
  • Experience shipping 3+ high quality titles
  • Experience shipping on Xbox, PlayStation, and PC platforms.
  • Experience with online FPS games preferred.

Our World

At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences.


We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization.


We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up.

Ready to Activate Your Future?

We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.


We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to candidate-accommodations@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.

Rewards

We provide a suite of benefits that promote physical, emotional and financial well-being for ‘Every World’ - we’ve got our employees covered! Subject to eligibility requirements, the Company offers comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision, health savings account or health reimbursement account, healthcare spending accounts, dependent care spending accounts, life and AD&D insurance, disability insurance;
  • 401(k) with Company match, tuition reimbursement, charitable donation matching;
  • Paid holidays and vacation, paid sick time, floating holidays, compassion and bereavement leaves, parental leave;
  • Mental health & wellbeing programs, fitness programs, free and discounted games, and a variety of other voluntary benefit programs like supplemental life & disability, legal service, ID protection, rental insurance, and others;
  • If the Company requires that you move geographic locations for the job, then you may also be eligible for relocation assistance.

Eligibility to participate in these benefits may vary for part time and temporary full-time employees and interns with the Company. You can learn more by visiting .

In the U.S., the standard base pay range for this role is $136,880.00 - $253,260.00 Annual. These values reflect the expected base pay range of new hires across all U.S. locations. Ultimately, your specific range and offer will be based on several factors, including relevant experience, performance, and work location. Your Talent Professional can share this role’s range details for your local geography during the hiring process. In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role may be eligible for incentive compensation. Incentive compensation is not guaranteed. While we strive to provide competitive offers to successful candidates, new hire compensation is negotiable.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Greensboro, North Carolina.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Greensboro area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Greensboro requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Permit Writer (Environmental Specialist 4)
description:
Description



Keeping Washington Clean and Evergreen



The Department of Ecology is hiring a Permit Writer (Environmental Specialist 4) within the Water Resources Program. (WR)


Location:

  • Headquarters Office in Lacey, WA.

  • Upon hire, you must live within a commutable distance from the duty station.

Schedule:

  • This position is eligible for telework and flexible schedule options.

  • This position is required to be in the office 2 days each week, on Tuesday and Wednesday.

  • Schedules are dependent upon position needs and are subject to change.

Application Timeline:

  • Apply by October 11, 2026

  • Applications submitted after the date above may not be reviewed unless additional qualified applicants are needed.


Duties

In this role, you will have the exciting opportunity to implement Washington Water Law. You will be responsible for managing, processing, evaluating, and drafting support documents for water right decisions. This includes completing investigations by researching, collecting, and analyzing technical data and other information to support water right decisions. You will have the opportunity to identify issues and find possible solutions. You will get to interact with other government agencies, municipalities, and citizens that are looking for water for their projects or homes. There is also an opportunity to let your GIS and mapping skills shine. We are looking for people that want to make a difference, enjoy being part of a team, and are willing to learn.

What you will do:

  • Recommend and process water right decisions.
  • Conduct investigations and technical reviews to support decisions.
  • Evaluate projects for feasibility, compliance with laws, regulations, and policies.
  • Work with other local and state government agencies and Tribes regarding Washington water law.
  • Respond to inquiries from water right applicants, their consultants, other agency staff and the public.
  • Develop maps and locate water rights using GIS and web mapping tools and software.

Qualifications

For detailed information on how we calculate experience and responses to other frequently asked questions, please visit our Recruitment website.


Required Qualifications:

Nine years of combined education and/or experience performing related to the duties of the position, that includes the following:

• Experience collecting, researching, and analyzing complex hydrologic or hydrogeologic data to support technical evaluations and regulatory decisions.

• Ability to apply scientific, hydrologic, or hydrogeologic findings and/or principles to permitting related decisions.

• Demonstrated skill in preparing technical written reports that summarize analyses, findings, and defensible recommendations for permitting decisions.

• Ability to conduct and interpret field investigations under the oversight of a licensed hydrogeologist, including groundwater and surface water related analyses.

• Experience reviewing proposed water related projects for legal, technical, and policy compliance.

• Strong communication and customer service skills, with the ability to interact professionally with applicants, consultants, tribal governments, partner agencies, and the public.

• Ability to manage and monitor complex permitting systems, for example water right authorizations.

• Familiarity with GIS and mapping tools to analyze and document water rights information, and ability to serve as a technical resource on mapping related tasks.

• Ability to mentor and support junior staff, collaborate on statewide workgroups, and independently manage workload priorities in a regulatory environment.

Education: Involving a major study in environmental, physical, or one of the natural sciences; environmental or natural science interdisciplinary studies; environmental planning, or related studies.


Examples of how to qualify:

  • 9 years of experience.

  • 8 years of experience AND 30-59 semester or 45-89 quarter college credits.

  • 7 years of experience AND 60-89 semester or 90-134 quarter college credits (Associate’s degree).

  • 6 years of experience AND 90-119 semester or 135-179 quarter college credits.

  • 5 years of experience AND a Bachelor’s degree.

  • 3 years of experience AND a Master’s degree.

  • 2 years of experience AND a Ph.D.

Desired Qualifications:


  • Bachelor Degree in environmental, physical, or one of the natural sciences; environmental or natural science interdisciplinary studies; environmental planning, or an academic discipline related to the duties of the position.

  • Demonstrated professional experience implementing water resource management laws and rules Knowledge of Washington State water law, related rules, policies, and water rights permitting processes,

  • Experience in applied geology, hydrogeology, or related disciplines.


If you are excited about this role and meet the required qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Desired qualifications reflect additional knowledge, skills, or experience that are nice to have but not required. Studies have shown that some applicants, especially women and people of color, are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed qualification. At the Department of Ecology, we are dedicated to building a diverse and authentic workplace centered in belonging, and we welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and unique perspectives.


Supplemental Information

Ecology does not use the E-Verify system; therefore, we are not eligible to extend STEM Optional Practical Training (OPT). For more information, please visit .


Our Commitment to DEIR

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Respect (DEIR) are core values central to Ecology's work. We strive to be a workplace where we are esteemed for sharing our authentic identities, while advancing our individual professional goals and collaborating to protect, preserve, and enhance the environment for current and future generations.


Diversity: We celebrate and appreciate diversity; our unique perspectives and abilities enrich us all and lead to innovative approaches and solutions.


Equity: We champion equity, recognizing that each of us need different things to thrive.


Inclusion: We intentionally create and hold space so that we all have meaningful opportunities to participate and contribute to Ecology’s work.


Respect: We treat each other with respect and dignity, acknowledging the inherent worth of our diverse perspectives and lived experiences, even in times of uncertainty and disagreement.


We believe that DEIR is both a goal and an action. We are on a journey, honoring our shared humanity and taking steps to demonstrate our commitment to a vision where each of us is heard, seen, and valued.



Application Process

Ecology seeks diverse applicants: We view diversity, equity, inclusion, and respect through a broad lens including race, ethnicity, class, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, immigration status, military background, language, education, life experience, physical disability, neurodiversity, and intersectional identities. Qualified job seekers from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.


How to Apply

Click “Apply” at the top of this page. Complete the entire application, including full work history and responses to all supplemental questions, and attach:

  • Cover letter, describing your interest in and qualifications for this position

  • Resume

Because we base our selection on the information you provide, it is in your best interest to complete the application thoroughly. A resume will not substitute for the “work experience” section of the application or vice versa. Applications with blank fields or supplemental question responses with comments such as “see resume” may be considered incomplete.


For detailed application information, please visit our Recruitment website.


Application Attestation: By submitting an application, you are affirming that the information contained in your application and on all attachments is complete and truthful. The state may verify this information, and any false or misleading answers may result in rejection of your application or dismissal if employed.


Need an Accommodation?

If you need reasonable accommodation during the application and/or screening process, including this job announcement in an alternate format:

  • Please contact us at 360-407-6186 or careers@ecy.wa.gov

  • If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you may call through the Washington Relay Service by dialing 711 or 1-800-833-6384.

Questions?

  • For specific questions about the position location options, schedule, or duties, please contact Melanie Redding at Melanie.Redding@ecy.wa.gov

  • If you need assistance applying for this job, are inquiring about the status of your application, would like to request the full position description, or have any other questions, please contact the Recruitment Team at careers@ecy.wa.gov

Water Resources Program Mission: We manage water resources to benefit all Washingtonians and to protect the natural environment for current and future generations.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Reliability
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Are you a seasoned engineer with a passion for reliability and scalability? We’re looking for exceptional Software Engineers to join the Reliability team at Roblox. In this pivotal role, you will drive the evolution of our systems, ensuring they meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and efficiency. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to build robust infrastructure that supports our growth. If you have a track record of solving complex technical challenges, we want to hear from you. Join us in shaping the future of our platform and delivering unparalleled value to our users.

At Roblox, our vision is to achieve 1 billion daily active users. We believe this engineer will be instrumental in driving us towards that ambitious goal.

You Will:

  • Create libraries that promote fault-tolerance and resilience– like retries, circuit breakers, and adaptive concurrency limits.
  • Build, automate and standardize process automation to create a "golden path" of tooling and platform support that powers the fundamental Roblox ecosystem.
  • Create tooling that provides production guardrails, for example evaluating release candidate capacity with load testing tooling before deploying to production.
  • Create performance monitoring services and observability towards understanding capacity issues and platform degradations.
  • Create tooling that monitors production services and their changes, like generalized canarying services with alerting.

You Have:

  • Experience: you have a BS degree (or equivalent professional experience) in Computer Science or related engineering field with at least 4+ years of experience with added advantage working in the Site Reliability space in SRE or Software Engineering
  • Passion for systems: You have experience and good habits around building software and tools and getting them adopted. Your system's focus informs a view of code needing to be deeply reliable.

You Are:

  • A Partner: You know that the best tools integrate broadly with the tooling ecosystem. You approach partners and processes with curiosity and seek to understand a problem deeply before you start coding.
  • A Coder: you have experience writing common programming languages ( Go, C#, Java…).
  • Self-organized: you're excited about getting in front of complex problems, organizing your work by any means possible; overcome emergent issues and contributing to long-running projects as a part of the team.
  • Problem Solver: you ask the right questions to solve issues within your expertise and you use data to test your theories.
  • Planner - You have experience in large project lifecycles. You have experienced working in sprints, breaking down complex tasks into milestones, and reporting status to keep project scheduling accurate.

title: IT Program Manager
description:
Who we are:

Altagrove delivers smart and innovative technology solutions that create competitive advantages for our customers and their missions. Our focus areas include Space, Connectivity, Cyber, Cloud, Analytics, and Solution Integration. As we continue to grow, Altagrove is actively recruiting for an IT Program Manager to join our energetic and entrepreneurial team supporting mission-focused technology programs. A successful candidate will bring strong program leadership, customer engagement, and experience delivering complex IT solutions in DoD, federal, or national security environments.


Follow us at -


What you will do:

  • Lead day-to-day execution of federal and DoD IT programs from kickoff through delivery and sustainment.
  • Manage program scope, schedule, budget, staffing, risks, deliverables, and customer expectations.
  • Serve as a primary customer interface and maintain strong relationships with Government program, technical, and contracting stakeholders.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across network engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, software, SATCOM, and infrastructure disciplines.
  • Develop and maintain program schedules, milestones, staffing plans, status reports, performance metrics, and risk registers.
  • Track contractual requirements, deliverables, dependencies, corrective actions, and program performance against established baselines.
  • Support financial management including forecasting, labor utilization, burn rates, subcontractor costs, and program profitability.
  • Lead recurring program reviews, internal status meetings, customer briefings, and technical coordination sessions.
  • Manage subcontractors, technology partners, vendors, and internal resources supporting successful program execution.
  • Support change management, task order modifications, proposals, estimates, follow-on growth, and continuous improvement while ensuring alignment with applicable DoD security, quality, and compliance requirements.


What you will bring:

  • 7+ years of experience supporting IT, engineering, or technology programs, preferably within the DoD, Intelligence Community, NATO, or federal government.
  • 3+ years of direct program or project management experience leading technical teams and complex, multi-stakeholder efforts.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise IT environments including networking, cloud, cybersecurity, software, or infrastructure.
  • Experience managing program schedules, budgets, staffing, resources, risks, deliverables, and customer reporting.
  • Experience supporting federal contracts, task orders, contractual deliverables, and Government customers.
  • Strong understanding of financial tracking, forecasting, labor utilization, burn rates, and program performance metrics.
  • Excellent written, verbal, organizational, and customer-facing communication skills with the ability to translate technical issues into clear program impacts and action plans.
  • Experience coordinating subcontractors, technology partners, vendors, and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Teams, SharePoint, and project or schedule management tools.
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, ITIL, or equivalent program/project management certification preferred.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, cloud, Zero Trust, RMF, SD-WAN, EVMS, Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), WBS/CWBS, or similar program controls is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Program Management, or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Active Secret security clearance is required; Top Secret clearance is preferred. Must be able to work onsite in Carlsbad, CA with hybrid flexibility, and travel as required.

title: Degreed Nutritionist
description:
Position Description

POSITION: DEGREED NUTRITIONIST

REPORTS TO: PROGRAM DIRECTOR

PROGRAM FUNDS: ☐ GAA N/A ☒ WIC 100% ☐ HS N/A ☐ MHS N/A ☐ CWR N/A

TIME ALLOCATIONS: ☐ CORP. N/A ☐ FIELD SITES N/A ☐ KITCHEN N/A ☒ WIC 100% ☐ CWR N/A

FLSA STATUS: NON-EXEMPT

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: NONE

SCHEDULE: Part-Time

Revision date: 9/29/2026

GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY:

Provides nutritional counseling to WIC participants following Professional, State and Federal requirements. Provide in-service training for Program staff regarding nutrition. Follow all WIC Program Regulations and Agency policies to accomplish Program and Agency goals and objectives. Travel to clinic sites within Lake County, out of area conferences and training.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Client Services (60%)

  • Assesses initial participant information, screen for eligibility, create a file, schedule appointments, assess paperwork for completeness, issues benefits, and educate participants on the appropriate foods package.
  • Collects and evaluate anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, and dietary data to determine nutrition and / or health risks.
  • Determines eligibility, complete certification process following federal and state program regulations.
  • Assesses need for and provide referrals and follow up to health care providers, public health nurses and other agencies as needed.
  • Assesses need for and issues benefits for medically indicated formula and foods according to State and local policies and procedures. Support medical nutrition therapy provided to the participant.
  • Acts as a resource for other staff and conduct quality monitoring activities for appropriate and accurate nutrition assessment, counseling, and referrals.
  • Travels to satellite WIC clinics to provide full scope of WIC services to eligible Lake County residents.
  • Supports the Agency Safety Program.
  • Other duties as assigned within the scope of position classification.

Nutrition Education (20%)

  • Conducts health, nutrition and breastfeeding contacts for prenatal and postpartum women, infants, and children.
  • Provides moderate-risk level nutrition counseling, documentation in participant file with indication of future follow-up.
  • Follows high-risk care plans and agency protocols in counseling high-risk participants.
  • Plans and provides participant-centered individual and group nutrition and breastfeeding education contacts.
  • Attends various meetings, trainings, committees, and conferences related to program goals and objectives.
  • Provides staff nutrition or participant-centered training.
  • Other duties as assigned within the scope of position classification.

Breast Feeding Education and Support (20%)

  • Provides breastfeeding support, education, and counseling to WIC participants and families.
  • Regularly works in a manner that protects, promotes, and supports breastfeeding. Encourages breastfeeding as the norm for infant feeding.
  • Provides individual breastfeeding consultations in person or on the telephone as appropriate.
  • Networks with other health professionals and community organizations to promote and support breastfeeding in the community.
  • Attends conferences and professional educational trainings as authorized. Encouraged to become a Certified Lactation Education or Counselor.
  • Other duties as assigned within the scope of position classification.

SECONDARY FUNCTIONS:

  • Attends staff meetings, State sponsored conferences and professional educational trainings as authorized.
  • Participates in outreach activities.
  • Researches, prepares and presents nutrition education training for staff or special projects as requested.
  • Communicates with community organization to promote healthy eating, ensure access to healthy food, and provide healthy living activities for WIC participants.
  • Other duties as assigned within the scope of position classification.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelors of Science in Nutrition and Dietetics or related field.
  • Prefer two years of experience in community nutrition including services to pregnant, breastfeeding, postpartum women and children 0-5 years.
  • Shall complete 50 continuing education units that are equivalent to those allowable for and RD or DTR.
  • Bilingual, bi-literate, English/Spanish, English/Punjabi, English/Hmong, and/ or other language ability based on program needs preferred.
  • State regulations require a physical examination, current tuberculosis test, and verified fingerprint and criminal records clearance before beginning work.
  • Possession of a valid drivers’ license; current personal vehicle insurance or safe driving record sufficient to ensure insurability through Agency policy.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of participants, employees of the organization, and the general public.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
  • Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent.
  • Ability to understand and use a variety of computer applications and appropriate software, spreadsheets and word processing, such as Microsoft Office and workplace electronic technology, including access, networking, and e-mail.
  • Advanced personal computer skills including ability to design and develop data bases; create computerized presentation/ training materials; and use advanced graphics design applications is desired.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions, and solve problems effectively and efficiently.
  • Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in various forms and deal with several abstract and concrete variables where on limited standardization exists.

title: Senior Leave of Absence Associate
location: Salt Lake City, UT United States
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.

About the Role

As Verkada continues to scale globally, we are building a world-class People Operations team to support our employees through every stage of their journey. We are looking for a Senior Leave of Absence Associate to own and elevate our global leave programs, ensuring employees receive a seamless and empathetic experience during some of their most important life moments.

In this role, you will be the SME for leave administration and accommodations while partnering closely with People Partners, Payroll, and Benefits. You will bring operational rigor to our leave processes by improving workflows, leveraging technology and automation, strengthening reporting and analytics, and building scalable programs that can support Verkada’s continued global growth.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at one of our offices in San Mateo, CA, Salt Lake City, UT, or Tempe, AZ, five days a week.

What You'll Do

Leave Administration & Case Management

  • Administer the full portfolio of leave programs globally: parental, medical, military, workers' compensation, unpaid/personal leave, and statutory leaves (FMLA, CFRA, PDL, PFL, ADA, and other state- or country-specific programs), in compliance with federal, state, local, and international requirements.
  • Own the full leave lifecycle from intake through return-to-work.
  • Develop and scale international leave processes, working with local People Partners, legal counsel, and vendors as Verkada expands into new markets.
  • Support workplace accommodations, partnering with People Partners, Legal, and managers on the interactive process and complex cases.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with disability carriers (STD/LTD), coordinating claims, escalations, and benefits continuation.
  • Guide employees through state benefit programs (e.g., SDI, PFL) and how they interact with company policies.
  • Deliver an outstanding, empathetic employee experience, responding promptly and accurately to leave questions and keeping employees, managers, and stakeholders informed throughout.

Leave Pay, Top-Up & Payroll Audits

  • Own company top-up/salary continuation calculations, including complex variable-comp scenarios (sales commissions, quota, draws) and offsets from state benefits and disability payments.
  • Perform pay audits each payroll cycle for employees on leave, partnering with Payroll.

Program Development, Analytics & Partnership

  • Standardize Verkada's leave processes with documented policies, workflows, and data governance, and scale international leave programs as we expand.
  • Partner with HRIS/People Tech to enhance Workday leave functionality; leverage AI and automation to streamline operations.
  • Build LOA reports and dashboards, analyze trends and anomalies, and translate data into clear recommendations for the People team leadership.
  • Act as the single point of contact on leave for Payroll, Benefits, Legal, People Partners, and Finance, driving complex cases to resolution.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in global leave administration, benefits operations, or HR operations with hands-on leave ownership; 8+ years strongly preferred.
  • Direct experience calculating leave top-ups for variable-compensation employees (commissions, quota, draws), which is central to this role.
  • Strong knowledge of FMLA, CFRA, ADA, PDL, PFL, workers' comp, STD/LTD, and state benefit offsets; international/multi-jurisdiction leave exposure.
  • Proven pay audit accuracy and attention to detail; strong analytical skills and advanced Excel.
  • Independent, end-to-end ownership of multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment, with excellent judgment and discretion handling sensitive information.

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

  • Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans
  • Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage
  • Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options
  • Expanded mental health support
  • Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits
  • Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time
  • Professional development stipend
  • Wellness/fitness benefits
  • Healthy lunches provided daily
  • Commuter benefits

Additional Information

  • You must be independently authorized to work in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role, at this time.

Annual Pay Range

At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. description:

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. The Role_

Technical Leadership & Delivery

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in Toledo, Ohio.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the Toledo area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near Toledo requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: Discovery Engineer (Modeling & Simulation)
location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States; Waltham, Massachusetts, United States
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Discovery is Anduril's team for the hard concepts: the ones that are not yet proven or built. We take the newest and hardest problems across space, missiles, air, sensors, autonomy, and cyber, decide what is worth building, and prove it out: we build the models, break the assumptions, run the tests, and carry what works to the point where a program can pick it up. We work with hardware and software engineering teams across the company, driving cross-functional collaboration across different business lines.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are building an expeditionary force: a small group of engineers who want to do big, new, hard things and who move into unfamiliar territory as a matter of course. As a Discovery Engineer you pick up a concept nobody has proven, learn whatever domain it lives in, build the analysis or prototype that tests it, and get to an answer. The problems change; the approach does not: reason from first principles, do the work, check it, and reach a solution.

You are not hired for a particular skill set. You are hired for a record of getting engaged in problems across different areas, being analytic, testing new concepts, and getting to solutions. You are also the adversary to our own ideas. The rigor that validates a good concept is the same rigor that kills a bad one early, while it is still cheap, and you apply it to your own work first.

This is a hands-on technical role on both internally and externally funded programs within Anduril's Discovery Business Line, on operationally relevant timelines.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own new concepts from first idea through analysis, prototype, and test, and drive them to a validated answer
  • Learn new domains fast enough to do real work in them: read the references, build the model, check it against known results, then extend it
  • Build or adapt the models, simulations, and test setups the question needs, using existing tools where they fit and building where they do not
  • Pressure-test your own and others' work: hunt failure modes, surface hidden assumptions, and stress trade studies before decisions are locked in
  • Use AI tools as a force multiplier for research, code, and analysis, and know when their output has to be checked against a reference
  • Work shoulder to shoulder with Hardware, Software, GNC, and the other teams at Anduril, and translate results into decisions that change the design
  • Communicate results to engineers, leadership, and customers, including strong visual presentation of complex data

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance
  • Demonstrated experience working in more than one technical area
  • You have done things: designed, built, tested, or fielded something real, in any field
  • Proficiency in at least one physics-math scripting environment (Python with numpy/scipy, MATLAB/Simulink, Julia, or similar)
  • Strong written, verbal, and visual communication

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years in a relevant science/engineering field
  • Math, physics, or engineering degree, or similar
  • Proficiency with AI tools (coding assistants, agents, model-driven research) in day-to-day engineering work, and judgment about when to trust their output
  • Experience in several of: space systems, missiles and missile defense, air vehicles, GNC, sensors and sensor fusion, radar, EW, acoustics, autonomy, or similar. Breadth across these counts for more than depth in any one
  • Familiarity with domain analysis tools as relevant (STK/Astrogator, AFSIM, HFSS, Fluent, or similar)
US Salary Range
$166,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Senior Software Engineer — AI-First Full-Stack
description:
At Vitec Tietomitta, we're looking for a senior software engineer. The role is deliberately broad — architecture, product decisions, and hands-on delivery — on a small senior team where AI agents do a large share of the implementation and your judgment does the rest. Judgment is what we're really hiring for — it's the part we can't teach. We also require genuine hands‑on fluency in Python and TypeScript/React: the agent won't always get it right, and you need to recognize when it hasn't.

Must-have

  • Senior-level (10+ years) shipping production software end-to-end, backend and frontend — you've owned systems, not tickets
  • Genuine experience delivering multi-tenant SaaS at scale — you've run software in production for many customers and lived with what that brings: releases and migrations without downtime, performance under real load, per-customer configuration, and monitoring
  • Fluent, daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) — you delegate implementation, review the output critically, and recognize when the agent is confidently wrong
  • Strong architectural understanding — system boundaries, data flow, integration patterns, and the trade-offs between them; able to justify a design, make the call independently, and revisit it when reality disagrees. This is not a ticket‑factory role.
  • Proactive, customer-driven product behavior — you engage directly with stakeholders and end users if needed, challenge requirements that don't hold up, and optimize for the outcome rather than the ticket
  • Hands-on proficiency in Python and TypeScript/React — this is our stack. When the agent stalls or produces something subtly wrong, you need to read and fix the code yourself.
  • Fluent English — the working language of the engineering team; codebase and documentation are in English

Things we'd like, but are not a must

  • Depth in our specific frameworks — FastAPI, Next.js (app router, server components), PostgreSQL.
  • Disciplined separation of data access from business logic — data sources sit behind a clean interface (repository pattern or equivalent), so code can be tested and data sources swapped without a rewrite
  • Relational database and data‑modelling skills — complex SQL, performance tuning, sensible schema design
  • Experience with data‑heavy application UX — grids, filters, aggregations, export
  • Domain experience in a regulated, reporting‑heavy industry — environmental, energy, logistics or similar
  • Finnish — a strong plus, but not required; the wider company still operates largely in Finnish, so it helps with domain terminology and stakeholder conversations

Why This Is an Interesting Job

  • Breadth of real engineering problems — the work spans product features, data plumbing, and architecture across an established SaaS platform. Expect variety rather than one narrow lane.
  • Real impact — you work on software that paying customers use every day, close enough to the business to see what your decisions actually change.
  • Domain depth — you go deep on a real business domain instead of skimming a series of tickets. If you like understanding how a business actually works before writing code, that's the mode here.
  • AI-first workflow — AI writes most of the implementation. Your job is architecture, domain decisions, context/prompt design, and rigorous review — not typing boilerplate. If you already work this way, you'll be at home; if you don't, this isn't the job.

Why Join

  • Circular-economy impact — software that keeps real operational systems running for waste and recycling customers
  • Pragmatic engineering culture — long‑term quality over short‑term delivery pressure
  • Senior team — a small group of experienced engineers who value ownership and practical solutions

Working Model

  • Direct access to the CTO — for architectural decisions and domain questions
  • Proactive by default — you're expected to surface risks early, propose alternatives, talk to customers where it speeds up a decision, and take calls rather than wait for them
  • Established engineering practice — existing CI/CD pipeline, code review process, and branching conventions
  • Hybrid — approximately 3 days per week at the office
  • Office in Pasila, Helsinki — about a 10‑minute walk from Pasila train station
  • Start immediately — onboarding is ready as soon as you are

About the Business Unit: Vitec Tietomitta

Tietomitta delivers innovative software solutions for the waste management and circular economy industry. Our systems provide customers with tools to improve efficiency and meet regulatory requirements—helping them work smarter and more sustainably.

About Vitec Software Group

Vitec is a leading provider of Vertical Software and has its origin and headquarters in Umeå, Sweden. Our products have been developed to meet specific needs within various niche markets in society. The expertise of our employees, combined with our shared corporate culture and business model, enable continuous improvement and innovation. We grow through the successes of our business units, as well as through acquisitions. Everything we do is based on a long‑term perspective. Because we are to rely on – today and tomorrow. Vitec has 1,870 employees, is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and had net sales of SEK 3,633 million in 2025. Read more at vitecsoftware.com.

title: Principal Economy Designer | New Games
description:
Craft:

Games Design & Production

Job Description:

Principal Economy and System Designer

Unannounced Merge 2 Game

Join our team and help shape an unannounced Merge 2 game from the ground up. We are looking for a Principal Economy and System Designer who can turn a compelling merge fantasy into a clear, generous, and sustainable player journey. You will own the economic and systemic foundations that connect core merging, progression, events, monetisation, and long-term engagement.

This is a senior, hands-on design role for someone with proven economy design experience in successful merge games. You will partner with creative leadership and a multidisciplinary team to build an economy that feels intuitive to players, performs against product goals, and can evolve confidently through development and live operation.

Your role within the Kingdom

You will be the principal owner and champion of economy design for the game, setting a high bar for systemic clarity, player value, and commercial sustainability. Specifically, you will:

  • Own the design, modelling, balancing, and ongoing health of the game economy across the full player lifecycle, from first-session experience through long-term progression and live events.

  • Define the Merge 2 economy: merge chains, generators, energy and action loops, currencies, rewards, inventories, orders, unlocks, progression gates, and the relationships between them.

  • Design progression systems and content pacing that create clear short-, mid-, and long-term goals while preserving meaningful player choice and satisfying merge moments.

  • Build and maintain economy models, simulations, and tools that forecast progression, currency flows, resource pressure, feature impact, and balancing changes.

  • Establish healthy sources and sinks for currencies and resources, ensuring the economy is understandable, resilient, and appropriately tuned for both engaged and paying players.

  • Partner with Creative, Product, Data, Design, Art, Engineering, and UX to translate the game vision into coherent systems, features, and player experiences.

  • Design and balance meta, social, event, and monetisation systems that support retention, engagement, and revenue without compromising player trust or the core merge experience.

  • Use quantitative analysis, player research, playtests, and qualitative feedback to identify opportunities, diagnose issues, and make clear, evidence-led recommendations.

  • Lead economy reviews and communicate complex system behaviour, trade-offs, and decisions clearly to senior stakeholders and the wider game team.

  • Set standards for economy craft, documentation, and review practices; mentor other designers and contribute to the broader design community.

Skills to create thrills

  • Demonstrable, hands-on experience designing and balancing economies for merge games. Experience on Merge 2 titles is strongly preferred, with a clear understanding of generators, merge chains, board pressure, energy loops, order systems, and progression pacing.

  • A record of owning or materially shaping economies on games in development and live operation, ideally in free-to-play mobile games with meaningful scale.

  • Deep understanding of how merge-game economy decisions affect player motivation, retention, session frequency, monetisation, content cadence, and the perceived fairness of the game.

  • Strong analytical capability and confidence building spreadsheet models, simulations, and practical tools to test assumptions and communicate outcomes.

  • Experience using product data and experimentation to balance systems, assess feature performance, and improve player journeys.

  • Excellent systems thinking: able to connect individual mechanics into a coherent whole, anticipate second-order effects, and simplify complexity for players and teammates.

  • Strong design judgement, written communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to create clear specifications and align varied senior perspectives.

  • A collaborative leadership style. You are comfortable working across disciplines, giving constructive feedback, and creating momentum in an evolving development environment.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for free-to-play games, merge games, and the craft of building player-first economies.

Nice to Have

  • Experience taking a merge game from concept or soft launch through live operation.

  • Experience with economy telemetry, SQL, BI tools, or scripting used to investigate player behaviour and validate economy hypotheses.

  • Experience designing live events, offers, segmentation strategies, or content frameworks for a merge title.

  • Experience mentoring designers or leading economy design across multiple features or teams.

Why This Role

You will have the opportunity to establish the economic DNA of a new game and influence its direction at every level. This role is ideal for a principal designer who wants to combine deep merge-game expertise with creative leadership, rigorous analysis, and close collaboration to build an experience players will return to for years.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Principal Engineer, cUAS Lead, Omen
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. Omen is Anduril’s hover-to-cruise autonomous air vehicle (AAV) that packs the endurance, payload, and mission flexibility of much larger airplanes into a novel runway-independent Group 3 platform. Omen can operate from ship decks, beaches, or remote island clearings, providing true runway independence and freedom of maneuver across defense and civilian domains. Omen is the first tail-sitter aircraft with a mass-production contract, with an order of 50 systems representing a decisive investment that anchors production and accelerates the development of future systems.

ABOUT THE JOB

Small drones are hard to hit. Hitting them from a moving aircraft is harder. We need a Principal Engineer to own Omen’s airborne counter-UAS effector payload end to end, and to build the team around it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the counter-UAS effector payload end to end, from first prototype to qualified production hardware.
  • Design the effector and firing system. Mounting structure, recoil and impulse management, feed and cycling, safe and arm interlocks.
  • Own the steering hardware. Size the actuators, gearing, and drives, and design the isolation that protects the airframe from firing loads and the effector from rotor wash.
  • Hold the pointing error budget and know where every part of it goes.
  • Select and evaluate the sensors that range and locate the target. Bench and flight characterization for range accuracy, latency, and track quality against small targets in clutter.
  • Build and lead the team. Hire across mechanical, electrical, firmware, and test, set the technical bar, and establish how the team works.
  • Set the payload roadmap, balancing near-term demonstrations against the architecture that has to carry into production.
  • Own payload interface control with the vehicle and mission system teams. Mounting and alignment, power and signal definitions, harnessing, time sync.
  • Plan and run ground and flight test campaigns, including live range events, and lead the root-cause work when results do not match prediction.
  • Take it to production. Design for manufacturability, tolerance and reliability analysis, supplier selection, first article, acceptance test.
  • Work safety and compliance on safe and arm architecture, range safety, and export control.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years designing electromechanical hardware, including at least one product you carried from concept to production
  • Strong engineering background, ideally in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace, or Electrical Engineering
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams, including hiring
  • Deep mechanical design capability: structures under high transient loads, precision mechanisms, tolerance stack-ups, and joint design
  • Experience sizing actuators for precision pointing, and a working grasp of the control bandwidth tradeoffs that come with it
  • Experience with vibration and shock isolation, including isolator selection and the dynamic analysis behind it
  • Experience selecting and characterizing ranging sensors. Radar, lidar, EO/IR, or laser rangefinders
  • Hands-on test experience, from rig design and instrumentation through the data analysis that closes a design question
  • Experience taking hardware to production: DFM, supplier engagement, first article inspection, acceptance test
  • Proficiency in CAD (NX, SolidWorks, or equivalent)
  • Ability to travel about 25% with potential surges for test and demonstration events
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience with weapon, effector, launcher, or ordnance-adjacent systems, including safe and arm design
  • Counter-UAS experience, whether engagement chains, fire control, or targeting small unmanned aircraft
  • VTOL, tail-sitter, or rotorcraft experience, and familiarity with the payload environment they create (vibration, EMI, rotor wash)
  • Experience with stabilized pointing, gimbals, boresighting, or targeting chains
  • Familiarity with fire control, including lead and ballistic solutions and sensor-to-effector latency
  • Environmental qualification testing (MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461)
  • Airworthiness experience with external stores
  • MATLAB/Simulink, multibody dynamics, or FEA for transient structural loads
  • Familiarity with ITAR/EAR as it applies to effector development
  • C++ or Python for test automation and data analysis

description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Mobile QA to join the App Infra team within the Consumer & Business group. The team is leading the greenfield native rewrite of Coinbase's retail mobile app in Swift and Kotlin, replacing the existing React Native codebase to deliver a significantly faster experience for millions of customers. You'll own the test infrastructure and processes that ensure every native release meets an uncompromising quality bar. You’ll build automated regression frameworks directly into the AI-assisted code generation loop so defects are caught at commit time, not after.

  • Architect the QA strategy for the greenfield rollout, solving high-complexity problems around catching regressions while supporting urgent last-minute changes from product teams.
  • Establish quality dashboards and SLOs that give the team real-time visibility into app stability, dropped frames, stall counts, and cold start times — turning release-by-release firefighting into durable, ever-increasing quality.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on mobile test automation, including hands-on experience with XCTest, Espresso, or equivalent native testing frameworks for iOS and Android.

  • Proficiency in Swift and Kotlin sufficient to read, debug, and write test code against native mobile codebases, with demonstrated ability to architect robust technical solutions through trade-off analysis.
