title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Solutions (Gracenote Division)
description:
This opportunity is for Nielsen’s Gracenote division - the premier entertainment metadata company in the world, powering the search, discovery, and navigation systems for the globe's biggest tech, automotive, and media giants.

As entertainment becomes more fragmented and AI reshapes the way people discover and engage with content, trusted data and technology are powering the future and are the foundation for better experiences. In partnership with our clients and by fully embracing AI, we are reinventing the business, products and teams to capture a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity which will significantly impact the media and entertainment ecosystem as a whole.

We are seeking a highly technical, customer-focused Product Solutions Architect (PSA) to lead technical pre-sales and implementation for our suite of API and AI products, with a primary focus on creating agents that solve customer problems with our newly launched and forthcoming Gracenote Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers. You will serve as the technical bridge between our customers and our product/engineering teams, enabling B2B clients to successfully integrate our authoritative metadata into their LLM-powered discovery experiences, and highlight the value of AI-first approaches to their business problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Pre-Sales & Consultation: Partner with Sales to apply Gracenote’s GTM strategy, demonstrate the value of AI solutions to a variety of customer stakeholders (Product, Technology, or Marketing -oriented profiles). Lead discovery sessions, understand customer use-cases, AI -based architecture and identify tangible value propositions for how Gracenote metadata can improve customer’s discovery experience using AI. Elaborate and run proof of concepts. Own and secure customer engagement and adoption through contract signature.

  • Develop Agentic Solutions: Design, build, and maintain a portfolio of focused, single-purpose AI agents that demonstrate specific technical capabilities of the Gracenote Video MCP Server — translating complex, multi-step entertainment workflows (such as conversational search, catalog enrichment, and personalized recommendations) into tangible, hands-on prototypes

  • Deploy on Frameworks: Possess experience deploying these agents on various agentic frameworks, such as those provided by Google or AWS, to prove their efficacy

  • Solution Architecture: Analyze complex, siloed customer environments to recommend optimal integration patterns and map Gracenote tools/resources to customer-specific AI -based workflows. Act as "Customer Zero" to familiarize with, test and validate new MCP tools and features before they roll out to clients.

  • Implementation Excellence: Guide developers through the technical adoption process, providing code-level guidance, documenting integration use cases, and helping customers leverage JSON-RPC 2.0 standards for seamless API/server interaction.

  • Product Advocacy: Function as the "voice of the customer" to influence product roadmaps, translating customer requirements into actionable product inquiries (PIs) and technical documentation.

  • Strategic Engagement: Establish standardized SLAs and best practices for implementation, ensuring consistent delivery across Tier 1 and Tier 2 global accounts.

  • Technical Mastery: Solid grasp of agent creation and agentic deployment frameworks and MCP tooling, specifically how LLMs utilize MCP primitives (Tools, Resources, Prompts), JSON-RPC 2.0, and AWS ecosystem with specific, practical experience leveraging AWS Cognito for identity management, user authentication, and secure API access control.

  • Agentic AI & Orchestration: Experience designing, deploying, or observing multi-step AI agents using one or more of the following frameworks: Google ADK, AWS Bedrock Agents, LangChain, or LlamaIndex preferred. Deep understanding of tool chaining (MCP), system prompt engineering, function calling across major LLMs (Gemini, Claude, GPT), and step-level tracing or response evaluation.

  • Consultative Expertise: Proven ability to navigate complex enterprise security (OAuth/OIDC) and data privacy requirements while effectively communicating technical solutions to diverse audiences, from C-level executives to engineering teams.

  • Experience: Strong experience in Python or TypeScript/Node.js to support PoCs and integration with B2B enterprise APIs. Experience connecting MCP clients and servers to managed enterprise foundation models via AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, Microsoft Azure AI / Foundry, etc. Familiarity with large-scale structured datasets, content discovery architectures, and search & recommendations engine mechanics. Familiarity with the CTV/Streaming and the entertainment ecosystem is extremely welcome but not required.

  • Customer interaction skills: Proven ability to bridge the gap between complex LLM/MCP architectures and business objectives, leveraging strong consultative leadership and stakeholder management skills to guide discovery, execute Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and effectively communicate technical strategy to audiences ranging from C-suite executives to engineering teams.

  • Travel: Ability to travel to customer sites globally up to 40% of the time to conduct workshops, discovery sessions, and on-site technical support.

BRT acts as a research and development flywheel, building not only new products but new platforms that reliably create value for both Deere and its customers. From fully autonomous machines to highly precise farming equipment, BRT & Deere are partnering to create technical breakthroughs across industries like agriculture construction, and commercial mowing.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. Through cross-discipline collaboration, this mission-driven team is eager to define the new frontier of robotics. We are always asking hard questions, rapidly iterating, and getting our boots in the field to figure it out.

Our office is located in Santa Clara, CA, but the team is distributed & therefore we are open to remote candidates.

Large scale construction is the next huge industry to be revolutionized by autonomous machines. At John Deere, we’re positioned to be a key player in creating that future.

We are seeking an experienced product manager to partner with our engineering leaders & the GTM teams on this zero to one journey. To succeed in this role, you’ll need to love making sense out of ambiguous problems, thrive when charting a new course, and possess the cultural athleticism to work effectively in both the worlds of hard iron and Silicon Valley. If you’re excited about building enormous robots that help shape the earth, this role is for you.

• Collaborate with the Deere Product & Engineering teams to define the right early target customer, ODD, and MVP.

• Drive rapid customer facing experimentation in order to validate / invalidate early concepts.

• Core Autonomy System - Define requirements for perception, SLAM, ODD, collision hazard detection, and adherence to safety systems

• Precision Tech & Guidance - Define requirements for in-field machine behavior: path planning, guidance, machine controls, etc.

• System Performance & Monitoring - Define system performance criteria, ensuring product meets customer expectations as they change throughout the adoption curve.

• Data Collection & Model Development: Define and execute our data collection strategy to support model development. You own the test set.

• Collaborate with leadership on the long-term product vision and roadmap.

• Whatever it takes to make this product successful!


Requirements

• 5 or more years of experience as a product manager in a technology company.

• Strong technical competency, specifically in Robotics, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) systems.

• The ability to collaboratively solve unstructured, ambiguous problems with curiosity.

• Proven ability to influence, collaborate, and engage with others from diverse backgrounds.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to communicate technical product information in a clear, concise, and creative manner.

• The ability to galvanize a team around a mission.

title: Solution Consultant -  (Boston - Hybrid)
description:
With the continued growth of our business, we are looking to add a Solution Consultant to support our commercial/small enterprise sales team of Client Specialists.

This role is ideally suited to someone who has been in pre-sales for 2-3 years and looking for their next challenge. As a fast-growing company, Nexthink offers many growth and career opportunities for the right candidate.

The focus of the Solution Consulting organization is to excite our prospects/customers by creating and delivering innovative presentations and value propositions that showcase the Nexthink platform by matching technical capabilities to required business outcomes for executive and technical audiences.

Working as the technical expert for the sales team, the Inside Solution Consultant will support 4-6 Client Specialists. You will work collaboratively with sales, professional services, customer success and partners to understand business priorities and provide the technical sales support necessary in pursuit of fast moving sales engagements.

This role reports to the Solution Consulting Leadership team but works hand in hand with the initiatives set by the regional sales directors across the United States

Key elements and responsibilities are described below:

The role:

  • Provide day-to-day technical support on sales opportunities, including discovery meetings, technical presentations, product demonstrations, and other relevant activities to gain a technical close/win.
  • Engage with customers and prospects to demonstrate our solutions, effectively communicating our core value proposition and key differentiators in the market.
  • Demonstrate how the Nexthink platform can support overall customer initiatives and how this provides positive business outcomes and overall value.
  • Partner and collaborate with the sales team to help qualify sales opportunities and align to Nexthink business outcomes.
  • Work with multiple customer stakeholders in different functions such as End User Computing, IT Operations and IT Service Management to illustrate use cases where Nexthink can add value. This requires a passion and enthusiasm for introducing disruptive technology in a fast-growing market.
  • Complete the technical sections of security questionnaires, RFI’s and RFP’s.
  • Run and facilitate different types of technical validations with prospects to enable them to fully understand how Nexthink can address their challenges, including but not limited to POC/POV.
  • Participate in webinars/marketing events.
  • The role will be based out of our Boston office, with the requirement to be in our Boston office 3 days per week (2 days work from home).
  • Occasional travel will be required within the US and internationally.
  • 3+ years of experience in a presales or technical consulting role, ideally selling End User Computing SaaS/cloud-based solutions to mid-to-large sized businesses
  • Proven track record partnering with a sales organization to meet or exceed assigned revenue goals in a high-velocity, transactional sales motion
  • Experience serving as a key technical resource introducing new technology into a new market
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Workplace, End User, or Desktop Services and their management
    • Digital Experience Monitoring or similar end-user experience functions
    • Cloud, Windows 10, O365, or other migration-, release-, or change-related projects
    • ITIL framework, Service Lifecycle, or related quality-of-service disciplines
    • Security, Governance, Risk, or Compliance disciplines
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex solutions environments
  • Strong business acumen — able to translate business context into creative, pragmatic solutions
  • An entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable working independently with minimal guidance, with the judgment to know when to escalate
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to quickly learn Nexthink's products, services, and business
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the presence to engage business owners and IT leaders
  • A team player who thrives on finding solutions in a dynamic, fast-moving environment

The base salary for this role is $142,500 - $168,750 gross per year, with a total on-target earnings (OTE) range of $190,000 - $225,000 with additional opportunity to earn commissions above this range.

This is an exceptional opportunity to join a fast-growing, successful and innovative company.
Nexthink allows you to thrive in a unique work environment where the emphasis is on excellence, innovation, openness and collaboration.

Total Rewards @ Nexthink

At Nexthink, we offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans. Your total rewards compensation package includes base salary and may also include a commission or performance bonus plan. We provide our US employees with 100% covered company benefits that consist of health, dental, vision as well as access to life insurance, long-term disability, and accidental death/personal loss coverage.

In addition, we offer:

  • 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 15 days of holidays we offer), 11 company-paid holidays, and 3 extra days for volunteering.
  • 🏡 Hybrid work model that balances office and remote work, with structured onboarding to foster connections and team integration.
  • 📚 Free access to professional training platforms to explore your interests and enhance your skills.
  • 🍼 Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents/primary caregivers, 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.
  • 💰 Plan for the future with a 401(k) plan featuring up to 4% company matching contributions, vesting immediately, to grow your retirement savings.
  • 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

Base salary ranges are determined by country, role, level, experience, and skills. The range displayed on each job posting reflects Nexthink’s good faith determination of the minimum and maximum targets for new hire salaries across all US locations. Individual pay is determined by related factors, including job skills, experience, and relevant education or training, which may impact a final offer. Your Talent Acquisition Partner can share more about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

title: Senior Hardware Test Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Team

Anduril Cyber is hiring a Hardware Test Engineer with strong test-design and automated-validation discipline across software, hardware, and RF lab environments. The role is for an engineer who can turn requirements into repeatable evidence, scale regression coverage, and improve confidence in increasingly complex integrated systems.

What You'll Do

  • Design test approaches, fixtures/harnesses, and automated validation workflows that exercise hardware/software systems in lab and pre-field environments.
  • Build requirement-traceable test coverage spanning functional validation, regression, qualification, and environmental test readiness.
  • Develop Python, Bash, Robot Framework, or equivalent automation used to configure systems, drive equipment, collect evidence, and flag regressions.
  • Operate across RF test equipment, networking, infrastructure, and system-control surfaces to validate integrated behavior end to end.
  • Partner with software, FPGA, DSP, hardware, and systems engineers to reproduce issues, isolate failures, and improve release confidence.
  • Help establish disciplined test plans, defect triage loops, and evidence packages that support productization and field readiness.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in automated test and validation using Python, Bash, Robot Framework, or comparable tooling.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD-backed regression systems, preferably with GitLab CI/CD or similar platforms.
  • Hands-on familiarity with RF and hardware test equipment such as signal generators, analyzers, switch matrices, power systems, or environmental chambers.
  • Ability to translate requirements into concrete test procedures, fixture/harness designs, coverage maps, and objective pass/fail evidence.
  • Comfort working across Linux systems, networking, infrastructure, and hardware interfaces while debugging integrated failures.
  • Strong defect-triage instincts and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly communicate technical issues.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail in evidence capture, traceability, and release readiness.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with qualification testing, environmental testing, or standards-driven validation in defense, aerospace, or similarly rigorous domains.
  • Background leading or coordinating small validation teams and establishing scalable engineering workflows.
  • Familiarity with lab automation that spans both software control and physical instrumentation.
  • Experience supporting field events, acceptance testing, or high-visibility readiness reviews.
  • Working knowledge of mixed hardware/software/RF systems beyond pure software test automation.
US Salary Range
$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Traveling General Superintendent - Mission Critical
description:
Overview

At Shawmut Design and Construction, we take pride in the culture we’ve built as a 100% employee-owned company—one that’s been recognized with more than 100 Best Place to Work awards. We’ve been honored as a National Fortune Best Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace for Women, Millennials, and Parents, and one of America’s Best Employers by Forbes—along with numerous regional recognitions across our 15 offices nationwide.

Here’s a glimpse into what we offer:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance.
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – Be an employee-owner!
  • 401(K) with Company Match – Receive a company match up to 4% of your eligible pay.
  • Generous Paid Time Off – vacation and sick time, 12 holidays, summer Fridays, and a yearly volunteer day.
  • The Extras – Cell phone, laptop, tuition reimbursement, pet insurance, financial planning services, and more.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Operational Oversight

  • Provide senior leadership across all phases of large, complex mission‑critical projects, ensuring alignment with business and field operations standards.
  • Lead multidisciplinary field teams with clear communication and consistent direction.
  • Support talent development, retention, and performance of field staff.

Mission Critical Execution

  • Lead fast‑track project delivery with a focus on safety, quality, schedule, cost control, and reliability.
  • Apply advanced technical expertise in electrical and mechanical systems, redundancy strategies, BMS/EPMS, and mission‑critical infrastructure.
  • Oversee BIM coordination, site logistics, crane operations, and constrained‑site execution.
  • Enforce LOTO and FOD protocols and uphold mission‑critical safety practices.

Planning, Scheduling & Risk Management

  • Lead pull planning, P6 scheduling, sequencing, phasing, and logistics strategy.
  • Identify risks early and develop recovery plans to protect schedule, profitability, and client satisfaction.
  • Ensure compliance with local/state regulations, AHJ requirements, and commissioning standards.

Financial & Contract Management

  • Partner with leadership to develop project strategies that secure work and drive financial performance.
  • Support budgeting, subcontractor selection, and project setup to align with mission‑critical goals.
  • Oversee financial controls, reporting, change management, and recovery of underperforming work.

Client, Industry & Team Development

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, representing Shawmut’s mission‑critical capabilities.
  • Promote collaborative relationships with designers, consultants, subcontractors, and vendors.
  • Mentor and develop field teams through coaching, performance management, and goal setting.
  • Represent Shawmut at mission‑critical industry events.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 15+ years of construction experience with a strong operational background.
  • 5+ years of mission-critical/data center construction experience, with proven success delivering fast-track, MEP-intensive hyperscale projects valued at $100M–$500M+.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field; equivalent experience considered.

Technical & Leadership Skills

  • Advanced understanding of electrical/mechanical systems, power infrastructure, BIM, redundancy strategies, and mission‑critical platforms.
  • Strong skills in sequencing, P6 scheduling, pull planning, and complex logistics.
  • Ability to lead large teams, solve problems quickly, and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Excellent communication, relationship‑building, and executive‑level client engagement skills.

EEO Information

Eligible candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship or restriction, now and in the future.

Shawmut prohibits discrimination against any staff member or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, religion, national origin, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, genetic information, disability, creed, citizenship status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Salary Range Information

Boston Base Salary Range: $175,000- $320,000 The range stated is specific to Boston. Placement within the listed range depends on many factors including, but not limited to years of experience, project size capability (for Construction & Field roles) and internal company equity.

Candidates in other geographic markets will also be considered; compensation ranges for those locations may vary based on local market conditions and cost of labor.

title: Night Shift Technician III, Facilities
description:
We awaken the world with energy.

LG Energy Solution is the global leader in lithium-ion battery technology for electric vehicles and energy storage solutions. Located in Queen Creek, Arizona, LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. is LG Group's first cylindrical battery manufacturer in North America, leading the widespread distribution of electric vehicles with the most advanced battery technology in the world.

Join us as we inspire our talent with growth, challenge, action and collaboration to Empower Every Possibility!

Job Summary:

LG Energy Solutions is seeking a Facilities Technician III, someone with deep experience in industrial or manufacturing settings to support the site facility and utility operations at our factory in Queen Creek, AZ. The Facilities Technician III plays an essential role, ensuring the factory operates safely and efficiently. The ideal candidate will be hands-on, proactive, and committed to maintaining LG Energy Solution's high standards for safety, reliability, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities:

Lead the monitoring, maintenance and repair of a wide variety of Facility Systems and supporting equipment including but not limited to: HVAC system, chillers, cooling towers, pumps, boilers, air compressors, exhaust fans, collectors, substations, electrical panels, VFD’s, and production skids.

Maintain proficiency with the Building Automation System (BAS) and makes recommendations to the Facility supervisor on upgrades, program or setpoint changes to maintain efficient operations

Provide coaching, training and direction to other technicians to resolve maintenance problems and coordinate services.

Manage relations and coordinate with vendors on maintenance, job walks, LOTO confirmation, warranty service, scope of work reviews for any complex issues.

Order parts, tools, materials for routine projects.

Facilitate inventory of parts, tools, etc. that are kept in stock.

Properly maintain areas with Clean and Dry Room ratings.

Ensure work is completed in a safe manner and maintain a safe work environment.

Check and monitor equipment regularly to ensure normal operating factory conditions.

Maintain cleanliness at worksite in accordance with 5S/3R standards and lean manufacturing practices.

Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

Minimum of 7 years of maintenance experience in industrial facility and process systems.

High School Diploma or GED required.

Vocational Certificate, associate's degree preferred.

Considerable knowledge of tools and techniques used in maintenance and repair in industrial facilities.

Must be able to properly and regularly utilize the following Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for a period of up to 12 hours:

  • Safety glasses
  • Steel-toed shoes
  • Protective respirator, as required

Must be able to preform the following over the course of up to 12 hours per day:

  • Lift/push/pull up to 50 pounds
  • Stoop, twist, bend
  • Reach overhead
  • Stand for lengthy periods

Must be able to work overnight on 12 hour shifts.

Must be able to work an alternating, compressed week schedule, including standard weekend shifts (Saturdays and/or Sundays) as required by the schedule.

Skills:

Advanced troubleshooting and repair skills in Facility and process systems.

Problem solving and critical thinking skills.

Ability to analyze entire building needs via design evaluations, trending data and schematic reading.

Ability to work well with individuals and teams across the company to ensure the team meets or exceeds expectations.

Ability to prioritize work schedules, identify and correct problems and communicate effectively with staff and the public.

Microsoft Office Suite and CMMS experience.

Technical communication skills to relay information to Energy engineers and suppliers.

Advanced mechanical and electrical knowledge.

Comprehensive understanding of production and processing equipment.

Why should you work here?

1. Growth - You are a self-driven individual who seeks and captures the opportunities for growth we offer by acquiring and solving tasks.

2. Challenge - You reach beyond expectations and strive for innovative methods beyond the traditional.

3. Action - You are driven, take initiative, can execute decisions with agility and fulfill tasks to completion.

4. Collaboration - You are enthusiastic about teamwork while respecting the different backgrounds and experience of colleagues.

EEO Statement

LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Recruitment Fraud Alert Notice

We have recently become aware of fraudulent recruiting activities in which individuals falsely claiming to represent LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. contact job seekers, advertise fictitious employment opportunities, request personal information, or seek payment in connection with an application or job offer.

LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. will never request payment, fees, gift cards, banking transfers, or purchases from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. We also do not request sensitive personal information, such as a Social Security number or date of birth, during the initial application or interview process. Certain information may be required only after a legitimate offer has been accepted and as part of the formal onboarding, payroll, background-screening, or employment-verification process.

Authorized LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc. representatives conducting recruiting business by email will use an official “@lgensol.com” email address. Candidates should be cautious of communications originating from personal email accounts or requests to communicate exclusively through platforms such as Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook/Live.com, WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Discord, or iMessage.

If you receive a suspicious communication or believe someone is fraudulently representing LG Energy Solution Arizona, Inc., do not respond or provide personal information, send money, or click any links or attachments.

We take recruitment fraud seriously and encourage all candidates to remain vigilant. Our goal is to help protect job seekers from fraudulent activity and identity theft.

title: CT Technologist Supervisor
description:
CT X-ray Technologist

About White Rock Medical Center

White Rock Medical Center is a community-based hospital located near the historic White Rock Lake community, that serves the Dallas, Garland, Mesquite and surrounding areas. We specialize in a wide range of services including comprehensive medical/surgical care, bariatric, cardiology, outpatient and emergency medicine.

Our mission is to deliver exceptional healthcare with compassion and excellence.

White Rock Medical Center is seeking compassionate, care-minded individuals to join our company and make a difference. As a member of the White Rock Medical Center team, you can advance your skills while working in a supportive and patient focused environment.


Job Summary

The CT Technologist Supervisor, under the direction of the Director of Medical Imaging, performs a variety of technical procedures utilizing computed tomography and radiographic imaging to demonstrate cross-sectional anatomy and to detect pathology. Performs procedures utilizing CT scanners, X-ray equipment, patient positioning devices, and computer console systems. Functions using independent judgment, initiative and ingenuity when performing technical procedures. Under direction of the Radiologist, manages and monitors equipment used to obtain images. Organizes diagnostic quality images prior to sending them to the radiologist for interpretation. Requires the ability to work with several groups of patients and physical conditions, to include adolescents, adults and geriatrics. Responsible for delivering high quality service, and to interact appropriately with patients and their representatives, physicians, and co-workers. Will safely manage the environment of care while providing services. Completes any task assigned by management for the improvement of the Imaging Department.


Essential Functions

  • Verifies requisition, orders (initial order), patient history, consents, and verifies the correct exam is ordered.
  • If needed verifies with Radiologist.
  • Good working knowledge of RIS (Radiology Information System).
  • Orders/completes exam and supply charges.
  • Sends images to PACS and reviews images.
  • Scans all necessary paperwork prior to review in PACS.
  • Properly assembles exam images in PACS, requisitions, and previous images before submission to Radiologist for interpretation.
  • Has appropriate information before consulting Radiologist.
  • Able to adapt techniques to various imaging situations.
  • Produces diagnostic quality images.
  • Does not turn in suboptimal images.
  • Requests assistance when needed.
  • Consistently positions correctly with minimal repeats.
  • Able to get quality images in challenging situations and patients.
  • Uses correct lifting techniques and obtains assistance when needed to prevent injuries when moving patients to/from bed, wheelchair and imaging tables.
  • Takes appropriate precautions to prevent patient falls or injury.
  • Ensures that unstable patients are not left alone.
  • Transporting patients: look for tubes, catheters, wires, restraints, IVs and other medical devices before attempting to move or transport patients.
  • Know hospital bed controls.
  • Returning patients to rooms: bed rails up, restraints in place, IV pumps plugged in, catheter bags are hung, patient is covered and nurse call button is within reach.
  • Carefully observes contrast injections and contrast injector to prevent infiltrations and recognize reactions; follows contrast dosage guidelines exactly.
  • Understands the hospital patient restraint policy.
  • Understands that patients may be restrained without their permission during imaging procedures to ensure patient safety and image quality.
  • Verifies DOB, name and exam with patients.
  • Patients are not left alone during procedure.
  • Respects and protects the patient's privacy and dignity while undressing/dressing for procedures and by keeping them appropriately covered during procedures.
  • Warm up equipment before use as needed.
  • Moves portable equipment with caution to minimize damage.
  • Carefully explains CT and X-ray procedures to gain patient confidence and cooperation and to reduce patient anxiety.
  • Keeps patient informed of progress during the procedure.
  • Remains at the control station during the scan keeping the patient under constant observation.
  • Wears gloves, masks, eye shield, and gowns when appropriate.
  • Disposes of sharps, body fluids, contaminated supplies and linens in the proper manner.
  • Cleans the equipment after each patient.


Behavioral Standards

Treats everyone as their customer; utilizes scripting and other tools to ensure consistency in customer service; expresses recognition and shows appreciation to others; fully utilizes AIDET principles; responds quickly to handle requests, complaints and questions; displays a positive attitude.


Communication/Knowledge

Attends staff meetings; follows HIPAA guidelines; follows patient rights policy; complies with the compliance program; demonstrates knowledge of role in a disaster; demonstrates knowledge of fire and fire drill procedures; working knowledge of hospital emergency codes; always utilizes standard precautions in the clinical setting; safely manages the environment of care by demonstrating a working knowledge of the requirements of the: Life Safety program, Utilities Management program, Hazardous Materials program, Emergency Preparedness program, Safety Management program, Medical Equipment Management program, Security Management program.

White Rock Medical Center is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior Credit Controller
description:

  • Maintain accurate collection notes, forecasts, and account action plans.
  • Extensive hands-on Cash Collection experience (circa 5+ years) with broader Accounts Receivable knowledge.
  • Proven success managing complex commercial or enterprise accounts.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent account reconciliation and analytical skills.
  • Outstanding telephone, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills.
  • Self-motivated, highly organized, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive issues to conclusion and deliver measurable results.
  • Proficient with ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.

What success looks like:

  • Delivers consistent cash collection results.
  • Takes ownership rather than waiting for direction.
  • Resolves complex issues through persistence and collaboration.
  • Builds strong relationships while holding customers and stakeholders accountable.
  • Thinks beyond collections to identify root causes and drive continuous improvement.

This is an opportunity for a self-led collections professional who thrives on solving problems, influencing outcomes, and making a measurable impact on cash flow.

title: Nike - BOH Lead - Market Mall
description:
Who are we?



Retailors is a leading and rapidly expanding retailer, specializing in the sports and athleisure segment. We are proud to be a global partner of choice for operating Nike retail locations in Canada, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and Israel. Additionally, Fox Group Canada is significantly expanding its business portfolio in Canada, and the role of the Store Director is pivotal in leading the future of Nike Retail Stores within the company.

Are you Ready?

As a Lead, working for Retailors Sports Inc. - the official operating partner of Nike in Canada.

What You will do:

  • Utilize exceptional customer service skills, sales techniques, and product knowledge to connect customers with the right product and drive sales.
  • Maintain knowledge of all store departments and be able to perform all activities of associates in addition to handling more complex transactions or customer service situations.
  • Provide expertise in one or more areas or functions Shipping and Receiving, Cashier duties, and visual merchandise.
  • Setting priorities for employees to meet daily deadlines; developing plans to meet short-term objectives
  • Performing work in support of brand plans; demonstrates link between daily work and company mission; participates in initiatives, and programs

  • 2 years retail experience.

Primary Function of Position

The Research Analyst will report to the Manager of Global Evidence Management team and will play a key role in executing scientific research projects focused on evidence synthesis, meta-analysis, and real-world evidence. The main responsibility of this position is to conduct high-quality systematic literature reviews, meta-analyses, and outcomes research, contributing to evidence generation for clinical, regulatory, policy, and commercialization strategies. The Research Analyst will collaborate with broader Global Access, Value and Economics, Market Access and Customers Analytics, Clinical and Regulatory Affairs.

Essential Job Duties

  • Execute systematic literature reviews according to PRISMA methods and Cochrane guidelines using designated systematic review tools (e.g. EndNote, RevMan, RefWorks, Nested Knowledge)

  • Perform meta-analyses using statistical analysis tools such as R software.

  • Conduct real-world evidence studies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate research findings into actionable insights

  • Present data and findings clearly and effectively to internal and external stakeholders

  • Prepare scientific manuscripts, abstracts, posters, and presentations for peer-reviewed journals and conferences, ensuring compliance with relevant publication standards

  • Maintain awareness of emerging methodologies and advancements in health outcomes research

  • Demonstrated expertise in conducting systematic literature reviews according to PRISMA and Cochrane guidelines, including use of review management tools (e.g. EndNote, RevMan, RefWorks, Nested Knowledge)

  • Intermediate proficiency in statistical analysis software (e.g. R, SAS, Python) and strong statistical analysis skills

title: Head of Deployments
description:
Machines learned to understand language. We’re teaching them to understand matter.

Forty percent of global manufacturing happens through physical and chemical processes inside pipes, tanks, and reactors. Despite decades of industrial automation, much of what happens inside them remains remarkably invisible. Manufacturing is the most ubiquitous and foundational sector in global economy, yet the way factories are fundamentally run have used the same control philosophies, manual operations, and legacy software for the past 60 years.

Laminar deploys state-of-the-art patented sensors and edge hardware directly into live production environments, generating data that didn’t previously exist to build foundation models deployed in factory floors that understand chemistry, composition, quality, and material state in real time. We use that understanding to run autonomy and rethink how things are made.

The last generation of industrial automation taught machines to execute instructions reliably. The next will teach them to understand the processes they control and run autonomously, adaptively, and agentically: higher quality, safety, more efficiently, sustainably, and productively.

That future is already taking shape. Today, Laminar works with 7 of the world’s 10 largest food and beverage manufacturers and operates across hundreds of factories globally across six continents. Our systems have materially reduced waste, cut manufacturing downtime, saved water, chemicals, energy, and helped prevent safety and quality failures. Our technology has gained international recognition, from being selected as a 2026 World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer, Gold 2026 Edison Award, Unilever Startup of the Year, to Innovator Awards by both Coca-Cola and AB InBev, and more.

We are backed by tier-one investors in physical AI to make intelligent, self-improving production the new standard for industry.

Join us to build what makes matter intelligible, and the intelligible controllable.

The Role

We're hiring a Head of Deployments to build and run the organization and operating system that takes every Laminar deployment from signed commitment to successful completion against the agreed account success criteria — predictably, repeatably, and at increasing scale. You own the deployment portfolio, the team that delivers it, and the speed and quality of execution across customers, plants, and geographies.

You will build the people, leaders, processes, playbooks, partners, KPIs, resource model, and operating cadence that allow the team to manage many deployments in parallel without bottlenecks. You will set goals, forecast capacity, allocate resources, review project portfolio health, remove systemic blockers, and step into strategic customer situations or escalations when your involvement materially changes the outcome.

You bring plant-floor credibility and executive presence, with a practical understanding of how industrial technology gets installed, integrated, validated, and adopted in complex manufacturing environments. You will use that experience to make Laminar's deployment model increasingly standardized, partner-enabled, efficient, and ready to scale from individual lines to global enterprise rollouts. You will partner closely with the Value Realization team so each deployment is delivered in a way that enables the agreed customer outcomes to be measured and validated.

What You Will Do

  • Build and develop the deployment organization. Recruit, coach, and develop FDEs, Program Managers, and future team leaders. Define roles, ownership, performance expectations, and career paths so the organization becomes stronger as it grows.
  • Own the deployment portfolio. Manage priorities, timelines, dependencies, risks, and escalations across active deployments. Establish a consistent cadence for portfolio reviews, risk management, retrospectives, and executive reporting.
  • Build the Laminar Deployment System. Create repeatable processes, stage gates, customer-readiness requirements, checklists, templates, acceptance criteria, escalation paths, tooling, and playbooks that make deployment quality consistent across customers and geographies.
  • Set goals and run the business by KPIs. Define the deployment scorecard — including cycle time, milestone and schedule adherence, backlog, quality, productivity, and attainment of agreed success criteria — and use it to identify bottlenecks and continuously improve execution.
  • Own capacity and resource planning. Forecast deployment demand, team capacity, skills coverage, geographic needs, and hiring requirements. Allocate resources across projects, balance utilization, and determine where partners should extend Laminar capacity.
  • Build a scalable partner model. Operationalize system integrators and mechanical/electrical implementers with clear ownership, qualification standards, handoffs, training, and quality controls so external capacity accelerates delivery without compromising outcomes.
  • Lead strategic governance and escalations. Engage plant leaders and senior executives where needed to align on rollout plans, resolve major blockers, and defend results — while keeping day-to-day execution owned by the team. Work with Product and Engineering to eliminate deployment friction at the source.
  • Partner with Value Realization. Ensure each deployment is configured, instrumented, and executed to meet the success criteria established for the account and to enable the Value Realization team to measure, validate, and communicate customer impact. Deployments owns delivery against the criteria; Value Realization owns the value methodology and customer value narrative.

About You

Must-haves

  • You've built and led a deployment, professional-services, field-engineering, implementation, or similar organization — not just managed projects yourself.
  • You have hired, coached, and developed teams that can run multiple complex deployments in parallel without depending on you for every decision.
  • You have direct experience deploying technology on the shop floor of large enterprise manufacturers and understand plant operations, engineering, quality, IT/OT, installation, validation, and adoption.
  • You have managed a portfolio of complex, multi-site or global deployments with committed timelines, competing resource demands, and executive visibility.
  • You have created repeatable deployment processes, playbooks, metrics, and operating cadences that improved speed, predictability, and quality as volume increased.
  • You are strong at resource and capacity planning and can translate pipeline and rollout demand into staffing, partner, and hiring requirements.
  • You can translate account success criteria into clear deployment requirements and communicate credibly with plant leaders, VPs of Operations, and C-level sponsors.
  • You are willing to travel internationally to customer sites, particularly for major rollouts, operating reviews, and escalations.

Strong pluses

  • Experience in process manufacturing, food & beverage, brewing, CPG, chemicals, pharma, or similar continuous/batch environments.
  • Background at an industrial IoT, automation, manufacturing software, or operational technology company, or as an operator in continuous improvement / operational excellence / digital manufacturing.
  • Experience building partner-enabled delivery models using system integrators, installers, or other third-party implementation capacity.
  • Fluency in plant-floor metrics such as OEE, yield, throughput, first-pass quality, capacity, utility consumption, material loss, and downtime.

Why This Matters

Laminar is already deploying across six continents. The next constraint on growth is whether we can deploy faster, more predictably, and at far greater scale. The Head of Deployments will turn deployment from a collection of successful projects into a repeatable global capability. Success means more deployments completed on time, consistent attainment of agreed success criteria, greater team capacity, and a model that scales without requiring the Head of Deployments in every project.

Benefits

  • Direct impact on product and culture.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability, Transportation benefit, Health and Wellness benefit, and more.
  • 401k plan with employer matching
  • Equity
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities.
  • Dynamic and inclusive work environment.
  • Opportunities for growth and professional development.
  • Access to Greentown Labs' extensive network of cleantech startups.
  • Transportation benefit for your commute
  • A team that celebrates together from rooftop lunches, ping pong matches, Lunch & Learns, and regular team events

Learn How We Think

  • Learn about our startup journey: Our Journey
  • How we're combating climate change: AI-Powered Climate Tech
  • A customer story: Unilever uses Laminar precision automation to cut time & water usage
There are many easier places to work on AI. Laminar is for people who want the hardest version of their discipline. Models here must survive contact with physics. Hardware must survive years of continuous industrial operation. Software must integrate with machinery built decades ago. Everything we build ultimately has to work on a factory floor.
We believe exceptional people should be given exceptional amounts of ownership. At Laminar, you will have the context to form your own view, the permission to challenge ours, and the resources to pursue the right answers, whatever technical or organizational boundaries stand in the way. There are few layers between identifying something important and changing it.
We’re fortunate to work with a small polymathic team of hardware and software engineers, chemists, AI researchers, factory operators, and go-to-market wizards who are unusually capable, curious, rigorous, ambitious, and low-ego. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

Our Interview Process
1. Phone screen with Laminar HR/Recruiter (15-20 minutes)
2. Intro call with Hiring Manager (30 minutes)
3. On-site interview, overview of tech, and interview/presentation with the Hiring Manager and a few team members. Depending on the role, a skills exercise that should take no longer than an hour to prep, would be sent ahead of time. We record your skills exercise to share with any team members who could not join the interview and/or with Founder's ahead of their Founder's Interview. If you are not local, we can conduct this virtually.
4. Finalists for Full-Time positions will have a Founder’s Interview in-person
Final steps:
Two professional references are requested, ideally one from your current organization and one who served as your Manager
If an Offer Letter is extended, a Background check is conducted
Laminar is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. Even if you are unsure you are a perfect fit, we strongly encourage you to apply! If you're ready to play a key role in scaling a game-changing company that’s transforming the industrial sector and advancing sustainability, we want to hear from you.
* Please ensure you add the domain to your safe senders list to ensure you receive our communications.

title: Senior Principal, Technology Consulting (m/f/x)
description:
About The Role

We are building a technology consulting practice focused on private-equity-backed companies and technology-enabled value creation. Founded in 2026 by our CEO and COO – both former BCG consultants – the practice is growing rapidly. You will join at a stage where the operating model, methodologies, team structure, propositions, and client portfolio are still being built, giving you the opportunity to help shape them alongside us.

Typical engagements in this practice include:

  • Identifying and prioritising tech-enabled value creation levers for portfolio companies
  • Building data platforms and AI-driven analytics capabilities
  • Delivering KPI dashboards and reporting for senior management and investors
  • Developing AI-enabled applications and automation
  • Overseeing large transformation programs (e.g. ERP migrations)

You will combine the strategic outlook of a trusted advisor to senior executives and investors with the hands-on discipline of owning technical implementation and delivery oversight – a role that shapes a client's digital agenda from the boardroom to the build.

Building this practice also means growing it from within, developing ambitious young tech professionals from our locations in Ghana and Rwanda into capable consultants and future leaders of our consulting practice. Every engagement we deliver contributes directly to building globally competitive tech ecosystems and career opportunities in our African locations.

What You'll Own

You are not expected to have done all of this independently before. We expect you to grow into this level of responsibility quickly, initially with close support from our CEO and COO.

  • Client relationships: You will quickly grow into primary ownership of selected client relationships, initially working closely alongside our CEO and COO.
  • Engagement leadership: You will run engagements end to end, including scope, timeline, budget, and risk.
  • Escalations: You will manage escalations directly, including situations where a vendor or workstream is underperforming.
  • Commercial ownership: You will help turn successful delivery into lasting client relationships – identifying follow-on opportunities, shaping proposals and scopes, and protecting engagement economics.
  • Practice development: You will help build the technology consulting practice itself, including developing junior and mid-level consultants from our Ghana and Rwanda hubs into future members of the practice.
  • Technical translation: You will translate business requirements into scoped, deliverable work for our engineering teams, and translate technical constraints back into terms clients can act on.
  • AI-forward delivery: You will help clients identify where AI and automation genuinely create value, then ensure our delivery teams build toward it.
  • Team leadership: You will lead cross-functional delivery teams – including engineers, business analysts, and data specialists – based in our African delivery centres.

What We're Looking For

The common denominator we are looking for is not a particular employer or technology stack: you have combined structured problem-solving with real technology delivery and are ready to grow from leading major workstreams into owning engagements and client relationships.

  • 3-7 years of relevant experience, although trajectory matters more to us than years served. Typically, you will have built your foundation in:
    • Technology consulting
    • Digital transformation
    • Technology-enabled delivery
    • IT program management / ERP transformation
    • Or adjacent fields
  • Demonstrated project management rigour, including experience running structured PMO processes on complex, multi-workstream engagements.
  • A demonstrated bias for ownership: comfort taking on ambiguous problems and running toward them rather than waiting for a framework or someone else's sign-off.
  • Genuine appetite for delivery, not only advisory work: you want to be there at go-live, not just at the recommendation stage.
  • Comfort translating between business and technical stakeholders: you do not need to be an engineer, but you need to have sat close enough to technical delivery to speak the language credibly.
  • Stakeholder management: evidence that you can independently manage senior client stakeholders, with the judgment and presence to grow into primary ownership of C-level relationships.
  • Evidence of commercial instinct: you understand that good delivery must also create client value and sustainable engagement economics, and can spot opportunities, manage scope, and contribute to shaping follow-on work.
  • A passion for team development and intercultural teaming: you are excited to work with international delivery teams and to develop talented colleagues from Ghana and Rwanda into strong consultants and future practice leaders.

Strong plusses (not all required):

  • Prior exposure to private equity portfolio companies: value creation planning, 100-day plans, due diligence, or investor/deal-team reporting.
  • Experience on an ERP or major enterprise systems of record implementation
  • German language fluency, given our client base.
  • Experience directing distributed or offshore/nearshore delivery teams.
  • Exposure to applied AI or automation initiatives inside enterprise settings.

Location & Travel

  • Hybrid, based in Germany or the US.
  • Regular presence at one of our office locations (Cologne, Germany, or Houston, US)
  • Occasional travel to client sites.
  • Occasional travel to your teams in Ghana and Rwanda.

How To Apply

Click on "I'm interested" to apply. Documents required for applying:

  • Current CV
  • Certifications
  • References (minimum 2)

Hiring Process

  • Application
  • Online Interviews
  • Job offer

For any enquiries, reach out via nina.gebauer@amalitech.com or richard.botchway@amalitech.com.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Native Mobile
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

We're hiring a Senior Staff Software Engineer, Native Mobile to join the App Infra team within the Consumer & Business group as a technical architect for Coinbase's native mobile future. This is the most significant client platform shift in the company's history, replacing the React Native app with native Swift and Kotlin builds for millions of customers. Coinbase mobile engineers will be expected to support both iOS and Android on their teams using AI-driven agentic translation at unprecedented scale. You'll own outcomes spanning the App Infra team and our ~30 product teams, set our architectural patterns, and relentlessly drive Coinbase towards a novel, world-class mobile development experience.

What you'll do:

  • Define the technical strategy to make the native app development future at Coinbase a reality.
  • Lead the AI-assisted migration approach, designing reusable AI-automation paradigms such as agent swarms, automated dual-repo synchronization, and continuous improvement of translation efficiency using automated feedback loops.
  • Architect a paved-road native framework in Swift and Kotlin that sets the architectural bar across teams, unlocking the ability for a single mobile contributor to be productive in both iOS and Android codebases simultaneously.
  • Drive organizational readiness as a trusted cross-functional partner with product, design, and engineering leadership, resolving cross-team blockers, de-escalating conflict during the dual-app straddle period, and holding peer leaders to a high bar so their patterns spread across teams.
  • Mentor L5-L6 engineers, develop the technical leadership pipeline for native mobile, and recruit actively through reputation, ensuring the team excels in your absence and your successor is developing.
  • Become a leader throughout the entire mobile community at Coinbase, defining best practices and fostering connection and support between all mobile engineers.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience with deep expertise in iOS or Android native mobile development (Swift/iOS or Kotlin/Android) and strong working proficiency in the other platform, operating at depth across your own and adjacent team codebases.
  • Track record of owning outcomes spanning 2-3+ teams that drive business impact, including multi-phase platform migrations or rewrites at scale where you shaped strategy and made trade-offs that raised ROI across teams.
  • Deep mobile performance expertise across iOS and Android, including cold start optimization, frame stability, scroll jank elimination, and device-tier profiling, with experience setting the architectural bar and defining ownership boundaries other teams build against.
  • Proven influence without authority at senior levels, with experience changing the technical direction of teams outside your own, securing leadership alignment on ambiguous high-stakes decisions, and resolving cross-team blockers using all tools at your disposal.
  • Experience designing AI-native engineering workflows adopted across teams, including LLM-driven code generation, agent-based automation, or reusable automation patterns that re-implement existing workflows.
  • Uses generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and measurable gains in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Development Engineer II
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

ABOUT ENGINEERING AT ROCKET LAB:

Engineering is the heart of Rocket Lab. We build world-class rockets and spacecraft and we launch them, often.

As a Development Engineer for Electron Propulsion, you'll design, test and refine the systems that get Electron to orbit. That means engines, turbopumps, valves, injectors and the fluid systems that feed them.

First sketch to flight-ready hardware. You'll define the requirements, iterate in NX with analysis and manufacturing engineers, own the EBOM, and release the drawings that get parts built, then plan and run the test campaign, from component rigs to hot fire, that proves your hardware is ready to fly. And once it's flying, you'll define how it's operated and maintained.

It's hands-on, fast-paced problem solving where rapid innovation meets the highest safety standards and your hardware launches.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

  • Design and specification ownership
  • EBOM and workflow
  • Design for manufacturing
  • Test planning and execution
  • Product lifecycle support
  • Cross-functional reviews

Some days you're deep in a dynamic dataset, other days you're on the production floor refining designs with critical feedback sessions from technicians or in the development lab testing concepts or flight ready designs. Both days are good days. This is not just a desk job.

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • An engineering degree and 2+ years' industry experience in a manufacturing environment
  • High-volume production experience
  • A project you owned end to end concept through design, build and test, into operation. Not one you contributed to but one you carried
  • Skills that transfer. You don't need to have built a rocket. You need to have solved hard engineering problems well enough that the domain is the only new thing

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Master's or PhD
  • Rocket, aerospace or automotive background
  • Applied analysis - structural, modal, CFD, thermal, fatigue, DFMEA/PFMEA or DMAIC
  • Experience with our toolset - NX, Teamcenter, JAMA and Jira. If you've used the equivalents, you'll pick these up fast

If the above sounds like you apply now!

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

title: Equity Ambassador, Student Equity & Retention
company: The University of Notre Dame Australia
description:
EOI - Equity Ambassadors
Fremantle and Sydney campuses
Casual opportunities

  • Casual opportunities on offer for enrolled students who have completed at least one semester of study at Notre Dame.
  • We pride ourselves on our high rate of student satisfaction.
  • (HEW Level 2) – NSW/WA casual hourly rate + 15% superannuation

About the university

We believe in the power of education to transform lives, strengthen communities and help people become the best version of themselves. The University of Notre Dame Australia is a modern, national Catholic university that serves more than 12,000 students across its campuses in Fremantle, Broome and Sydney.

With a community of over 1,000 academic and professional staff, Notre Dame is recognised for its personalised learning environment, strong graduate outcomes and holistic educational philosophy rooted in critical thinking, ethics and the Catholic intellectual tradition.

About the role

Equity Student Ambassadors play an important role at Notre Dame. As representatives of the University, they assist with the delivery of the Future You program and other outreach activities including, on-campus days, and mentoring. These activities offer opportunities for future students to identify their strengths and see university as a viable and exciting pathway!

Student Ambassadors are employed as casual staff at Notre Dame, provided with induction and training for the role, and offered work on an ad hoc basis throughout the year based on their availability and skill set.

Student Ambassadors are paid at the applicable HEW 2.1 casual hourly rate for New South Wales or Western Australia, based on the successful candidate’s location. The role may require travel to and from high schools and other venues across either Greater Sydney or Perth.

Student Ambassadors regularly engage with students from groups that have traditionally been underrepresented in university education, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students, students from low socio-economic backgrounds, students from regional and remote areas, and those who would be the first in their family to attend university. We strongly encourage students from these backgrounds to apply and bring their unique perspectives and experiences to the role.

Student Ambassadors may undertake work with one or more of the following teams.

  • Prospective Students Office
  • Student Equity

Key Responsibilities

  • Represent the University in a positive and professional manner at events including on campus days for high school students, and events on high school campuses.
  • Proactively engage high school students and other stakeholders (for example, parents/ carers, careers advisors, school principals and teachers) and share your experiences of university with diverse audiences.
  • Lead campus tours for groups of high school students.
  • Deliver workshops and presentations to groups of high school students and parents about pathways, scholarships, transition into university and what university is like.
  • Undertake tasks such as organising merchandise, data entry, event preparation.
  • Attend training, team meetings, and other development opportunities as scheduled during the year.
  • Other duties depending on whether you are working for the Prospective Students Office or Student Equity.

Qualifications, skills & experience

  • Have completed at least one semester of study at the University of Notre Dame by the end of 2026 and have at least one year of study remaining.
  • Hold, or be willing and eligible to obtain, the applicable Working with Children Check required for the state in which you will work.
  • Have excellent communication and people skills.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to share your experiences of the university with diverse audiences.
  • Build skills across a wide range of areas.
  • Friendly and collaborative working environment.
  • Network with other University students and staff.

Please apply online with a resume and cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.

For further information on how to apply, please visit: How to apply | Notre Dame

High school attended

title: Senior UI Artist | New Games
description:
Craft:

Job Description:

We are looking for a Senior UI Artist to help shape and produce the visual interface for our a new IP centred mobile game

This role sits between Art Direction, Game Design, UX, and Tech. Your goal is to create clear, polished, playful, and production-ready UI assets that support the game experience and match the project’s cute, quirky, and high-quality visual tone.

The ideal candidate has strong graphic design foundations, excellent iconography and illustration skills, and a good understanding of how UI is implemented in Unity. Knowledge of 3D workflows is important, and Blender experience is a plus.

Your role within the Kingdom

  • Design and produce high-quality UI assets for mobile gameplay, menus, HUDs, events, and live features.

  • Create clear, readable, and polished icons, buttons, panels, badges, frames, and interface elements.

  • Develop illustrative UI elements that support the game’s visual identity.

  • Work from wireframes, UX flows, and art direction to create final UI visuals.

  • Maintain consistency across UI screens, systems, and feature updates.

  • Prepare assets for Unity implementation with correct formats, naming, slicing, and optimization.

  • Support the creation of UI style guides, templates, and documentation.

  • Collaborate with UX, Design, Tech, and Art Direction to ensure UI is beautiful, functional, and production-ready.

  • Review in-game implementation and help polish final results.

  • Contribute ideas to improve readability, usability, and visual quality.

Collaboration and Integration

  • Work closely with Art Direction to maintain the project’s visual style.

  • Collaborate with Game Designers and UX Designers to support clear player flows.

  • Work with Unity developers to ensure UI assets integrate correctly.

  • Coordinate with 2D, 3D, VFX, and animation teams when UI requires cross-discipline support.

  • Communicate clearly with internal teams and respond well to feedback.

  • Support production priorities while keeping a strong eye on quality and consistency.

Skills to create thrills

  • Strong portfolio showing high-quality UI art for games or mobile products.

  • Excellent iconography skills with strong readability at small sizes.

  • Strong illustration skills, especially for stylized, playful, or polished game visuals.

  • Solid understanding of layout, composition, typography, color, hierarchy, and visual clarity.

  • Experience with Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or equivalent tools.

  • Experience creating UI assets for Unity.

  • Good knowledge of 3D principles and how 3D assets can support UI presentation.

  • Ability to prepare clean, optimized, implementation-ready assets.

  • Good understanding of mobile UI constraints and readability.

  • Experience working with art direction and established visual styles.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to take feedback constructively.

  • Good sense of polish, consistency, and quality control.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on casual, mobile, or family-friendly games.

  • Experience with Blender.

  • Experience creating UI mockups, style guides, and asset libraries.

  • Knowledge of UI animation or motion design.

  • Comfort working with both 2D and 3D pipelines.

  • Experience supporting live game features, events, or seasonal content.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to help shape the UI visual quality of a major global IP on mobile.

  • A collaborative art team focused on craft, clarity, and polish.

  • The chance to contribute to a playful and highly visible game experience.

  • A healthy work culture that values trust, ownership, and teamwork.

Success in this role means UI assets are clear, beautiful, consistent with the art direction, and smoothly integrated into the game.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Director of Feasibility
