title: Senior Hardware Systems Engineer
description:
General Dynamics UK is looking for a Senior Hardware Systems Engineer to make a significant contribution to the system design of complex C4I systems across a variety of defence programmes. This role sits within the Systems Engineering discipline and will support the development and delivery of hardware-focused solutions, including Communications Systems, military computers and networking electronics.

Working as part of a multi-disciplined engineering team, you will support activity across the full engineering lifecycle — from requirements capture, development, test and acceptance through to in-service support and obsolescence management. The role will involve working across MoD development and delivery programmes, Customer Research and Development, and Internal Research and Development.

As a Senior Hardware Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping hardware aspects of system solutions, with responsibilities including:

  • Supporting requirements elicitation, development and interface definition
  • Contributing to design analysis, including functional and physical analysis, alternative solution development and trade studies
  • Supporting the specification of sub-systems, components and cabling
  • Applying open and military standards to the design and development of hardware solutions
  • Supporting the development and delivery of system integration and test activities
  • Working with safety, security, Integrated Logistics Support and system integration teams to deliver a coherent system solution
  • Supporting technical subcontractor and supplier management where required
  • Producing well-structured technical documentation in line with agreed schedules
  • Presenting at progress reviews and contributing effectively in meetings with internal and external stakeholders

We’re looking for someone with broad systems engineering capability and a strong understanding of military hardware environments. You’ll be confident working across technical teams, resolving design challenges and supporting the delivery of practical, robust engineering solutions.

You will bring:

  • Broad competence in systems engineering
  • Experience resolving design challenges
  • Understanding of military hardware, particularly in relation to networking electronics
  • Knowledge and application of open and military standards
  • Understanding of climatic and induced environments
  • Experience engaging specialist engineering disciplines such as Safety, Security and ILS to deliver complete system solutions
  • Methodical analytical fault-finding skills, with confidence working in a technical laboratory environment and following lab rules such as PPE and safe handling requirements
  • Experience with structured design methods
  • Strong teamwork skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multi-disciplined teams
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation and interpersonal communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio
  • Cable specification and design experience is desirable
  • Good understanding of the OSI model is desirable
  • Experience using engineering tools for requirements management and system design is desirable
  • Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models is preferred.

Salary for this position is £45,600 to £60,000 depending on experience plus our excellent flexible benefits package.

We offer hybrid working - for this role ideally we are looking for an average of 2 days per week per month on site.

We pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose, offering impressive benefits:

  • A compressed nine-day fortnight and compressed hours - which means every other Friday off.
  • A personalised career development plan, alongside regular progress reviews - supporting and valuing your progression within the Company.
  • A flexible working environment where your contributions are recognised and rewarded with flexible benefits

We believe in maintaining a diverse workplace - inclusive of beliefs, cultural background, job experiences, thoughts and ideas. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we welcome you to join our inclusive team!

Our success is fuelled by our colleagues and the wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills they bring to the Company.

We are a Disability Confident Employer, as such we offer an interview to disabled people who meet the minimum criteria for the job.
Please email disabilityconfident@gd-ms.uk if you would like your application to be considered under the DC Scheme.

All successful/appointed applicants must be able to obtain a level of UK Security clearance that is appropriate for the role and undertake suitable Right to work checks

Every application matters to us. We want you to know that each application we receive is reviewed by a real person—not just an algorithm. Our screening questions are also carefully considered to help us understand your experience and fit for the role.

We appreciate the time you take to apply.

title: Private Lacrosse Coach
description:
Coach lacrosse on your own schedule in New Orleans, Louisiana.

STXZ Lacrosse has 1 opening(s) for independent lacrosse coaches in the New Orleans area, to cover client requests for private lessons we can't currently fill. We bring you the clients. You run the sessions.

About STXZ

STXZ is a technology platform that connects families with independent lacrosse coaches across the United States. We send you clients in your area, handle the administrative work, and get out of your way so you can coach. If you have lacrosse experience and want coaching work on a flexible schedule, this is for you.

How it works

When a family near New Orleans requests lessons through STXZ, we send you a client offer with the details. You review it and decide whether to take it. No quotas, no pressure, no penalty for declining.

When you accept:

  • You contact the client directly within 24 hours
  • You and the client agree on schedule and location: their home, a local field, a park, your call
  • You run the session your way. Drills, pacing, and structure are your professional judgment
  • You submit a quick lesson briefing on the platform after the session
  • You get paid

STXZ never tells you how to coach, what drills to use, or how to structure your lessons.

What you earn

  • $35 to $50 per one-hour session, paid as a flat per-lesson rate. Rates are set by STXZ, vary by market and demand, and are confirmed in writing before your first lesson.
  • Payout within 24 to 48 hours after you submit your lesson briefing, via PayPal
  • 1099-NEC issued at year end if you earn $2,000 or more through the platform
  • Paid per completed session. Lesson volume depends on client demand in your area, and STXZ does not guarantee a minimum number of lessons.
  • No fee to apply, and nothing to pay up front

Schedule

Most lessons run weekday afternoons and evenings and on weekends. Work when you want and pause your availability anytime.

What you control

  • Your schedule. Accept or decline every offer without penalty or impact on your standing.
  • Your methods. Drills, lesson plans, teaching style, all yours.
  • Your territory. Set your own travel radius, from a few miles to 35 or more.
  • Your approach. You decide what equipment to bring to each session.

What STXZ handles

  • Client acquisition. We market the platform and bring families to you.
  • Matching. We send you local client offers that fit your profile.
  • Payment processing. We collect from clients and pay you after each session.
  • Billing, refunds, and disputes. Our support team handles all of it. You coach.
  • Liability coverage. Active coaches are enrolled in STXZ's platform liability coverage program for sessions booked through STXZ. The program fee is $30 per year, and it is $0 down: nothing is due to get started or to begin receiving client offers. The fee is recovered from your first lesson payout once you start coaching. This is limited coverage for platform-booked sessions only; independent coaches may also choose to carry their own personal insurance.

Who this is for

  • Coaching experience at the youth, high school, club, or college level, or playing experience at the high school varsity, club, college, or professional level
  • 18 or older
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Willing to complete a third-party background check, arranged by STXZ, before receiving full client details
  • Reliable transportation to training locations in your area
  • Your own stick and basic training equipment: cones, balls, training aids
  • Strong communication with parents, players, and the STXZ team
  • Professionalism and confidence working independently with families and youth athletes

How to apply

Apply here (about 2 minutes). If your background fits, we send a short coaching profile questionnaire: playing history, coaching experience, positions, availability. After review and background screening, approved coaches start receiving local client offers.

STXZ is a technology platform that connects clients with independent lacrosse coaches. STXZ does not employ, supervise, manage, or control coaches or their training sessions. Coaches are engaged as independent contractors and are responsible for their own coaching methods, taxes, and scheduling. STXZ considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

title: School Site Director (Redwood City - Kennedy)
company: Boys & Girls Clubs of the Peninsula
description:
POSITION
School Site Director

OUR MISSION
To empower the youth in our community with equitable access to social, academic, and career opportunities to thrive

OUR VISION
All youth grow up to lead fulfilling lives fueled by their passions, talents, and a love of learning

OUR CORE VALUES
Curiosity, Respect, Ownership, Ganas, Unity, Equity

ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW
Boys & Girls Clubs of the Peninsula (BGCP) proudly stands as the largest expanded learning provider in San Mateo County, dedicated to empowering 7,000 TK-College students across 31 sites from East Palo Alto to Daly City. We believe that talent is equally distributed across Silicon Valley, but opportunity is not, so we are committed to ensuring that socio-economically disadvantaged students have equitable access to the opportunities that will help them thrive in school and beyond. Students benefit from high-quality academic programs, captivating enrichment activities, and access to critical mental health services. With support from our staff, Board, and broader Team BGCP community, we strive to make our community a great place for all kids to grow up.

POSITION OVERVIEW
The School Site Director is the senior leader of a school-based expanded learning program and is responsible for overall program quality, staff performance, student outcomes, and strong alignment with school partners. Serving as a “second shift school principal,” the Site Director ensures the delivery of a safe, structured, and engaging extended learning environment that supports academic growth, social development, and school success.

This role leads across program quality and fidelity, staff leadership and development, operational systems, and school and community partnerships. Through strong leadership, clear accountability, and collaboration, the Site Director ensures alignment with BGCP standards and district priorities while fostering a positive culture for both students and staff. The School Site Director reports to the Regional Director.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Ensure Program Implementation & Fidelity

  • Create and publish daily "deliverables" or tasks for staff to complete each day that contribute to the overall success of program
  • Conduct weekly or bi-weekly observation of staff during programming
  • Create and publish site calendar and quarterly program schedules
  • Create and enforce clear written expectations and standards of excellence for students and staff

Manage & Develop Site Team

  • Facilitate weekly or bi-weekly 1v1 meetings with direct reports and instructional support staff (ISS) for assessing and evaluating performance, providing constructive feedback, and implementing performance improvement plans when necessary
  • Advocate and find solutions for the needs and interests of the program students and staff
  • Collaborate with instructional coach and associate director to determine weekly program goals and focuses
  • Exemplify both professionalism and youth development behaviors to cultivate a positive culture for both staff and students.

Manage & Develop Site Systems

  • Create and facilitate weekly staff meetings to ensure effective communication, collaborative problem-solving, and alignment with organizational goals, fostering a positive team culture and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and train staff on the Site Plans (Safety Plan, Emergency Plan, etc.), aligned with partners
  • Create and ensure the maintenance of site data management systems to maintain important student rosters – including Remind emergency contacts, authorized pick–up lists, unauthorized pick–up lists, student walker lists, etc.
  • Complete monthly audits of data systems to ensure that the ASES & ELOP data is accurate across BGCP and District platforms (Rosters, Food/Snack Distribution etc.) etc.
  • Create and maintain systems for budget management, materials inventories, emergency supplies, program materials purchases, and happyfox (internal) requests

title: Supply Chain Engineering Internship (Summer 2027)
description:
Amca is building America’s new industrial base. Since the 1990s, our ability to build new aviation and military systems and maintain the ones we already have has eroded. Today, the gap between what the nation needs to produce and what it is capable of producing is the largest it has been in generations.

To help close that gap, Amca rapidly develops and manufactures new critical components and subsystems required to build and sustain the planes, military vehicles, and core infrastructure America needs. Today, we operate seven factories nationwide, including our advanced prototyping and testing headquarters in El Segundo, and deliver avionics, hydraulic, and electrical components for platforms such as the F-35, F-16, F/A-18, 737MAX, 787, A320neo, A321, Mk-48, and M1 Abrams.

Overview:

The Supply Chain Engineer role at Amca has two parts. You are accountable for the reliability of the hardware Amca sources externally by qualifying suppliers, containing and dispositioning defects, and driving corrective action to root cause. You are also the product owner for build-to-print customer contracts. When a customer hands us a technical data package and a delivery date, you own reviewing the contract, building the schedule, driving engineering, procurement, and production against it, and answering to the customer for the result. At Amca, product ownership sits with the engineer closest to the hardware, because the person who understands a product is best positioned to execute on it.

We are looking for engineers with strong understanding of manufacturing and quality methods, a bias toward action, the ability to hold suppliers to requirements, and the judgment to make and keep commitments to customers.

Responsibilities:

Product Ownership — Build-to-Print

  • Serve as product owner for assigned build-to-print contracts, accountable from award through first article to rate production
  • Decompose the customer technical data package and contract into a requirements matrix (drawing notes, specifications, quality clauses, test, inspection, marking, packaging, and delivery) and flow each requirement to the teams and suppliers who must satisfy it
  • Build and own the program schedule (long lead procurement, tooling, first article, qualification, delivery), drive the cross-functional team to hold it, and escalate early and specifically when a commitment is at risk
  • Act as the primary technical interface to the customer, communicating status, manufacturability questions, deviations and waivers, and source inspection

Nonconformance and Defect Resolution

  • Own supplier-caused defects end to end: containment, scope identification, removal of affected parts from production, disposition, return to vendor, and closure
  • Run material review and nonconformance processes in coordination with quality, engineering, and production, including issues found at the supplier, at incoming inspection, and on the floor
  • Issue supplier corrective and preventive action requests, evaluate responses on technical merit, and verify effectiveness rather than accepting a closed form
  • Lead failure investigations and root cause analysis on dimensional, material, and process escapes
  • Reduce the total volume of vendor-caused defects reaching Amca factories over time

Source Qualification and Supplier Development

  • Evaluate and onboard new suppliers through capability assessment, quality system review, and onsite audit against AS9100, NADCAP, and program requirements
  • Own first article inspection (AS9102) and production readiness for new and transitioning parts
  • Define and communicate product technical requirements to suppliers, and confirm compliance before production release
  • Provide technical support onsite at suppliers, including feedback on manufacturing methods, tooling, fixturing, and inspection approach across the life of the part
  • Build supplier improvement plans where performance falls short and drive them to measurable outcomes

Analysis, Risk, and Cross-Functional Work

  • Analyze supplier quality and delivery data to isolate systemic gaps and convert them into targeted projects at specific suppliers
  • Identify and mitigate supply chain risk: single-source exposure, capacity constraints, long lead time items, and obsolescence
  • Work with design, test, and build engineers to understand design intent and translate it into supplier requirements; read and interpret drawings, GD&T, and military and aerospace specifications
  • Develop the standards and documentation that make supplier quality and program execution repeatable as Amca scales

Expectations:

In your first year, you demonstrate full ownership of your hardware: contractual first article and delivery milestones met, no customer escapes, no avoidable schedule slips the customer heard about after the fact, reduction in supplier-caused defects, and corrective actions closed with objective evidence.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in an engineering or STEM discipline
  • 2+ years of professional or internship experience in a quality, manufacturing, process, or supply chain engineering role
  • Demonstrated ability to read engineering drawings, including GD&T
  • Demonstrated ownership of a project or program with a hard external commitment (you built the schedule, drove people who did not report to you, and were accountable for the outcome)
  • Comfortable communicating directly with customers and suppliers on technical, quality, and schedule commitments

Preferred

  • 4+ years in a quality, manufacturing, process, program, or supply chain engineering role in aerospace, defense, or another regulated hardware industry background
  • Technical program management, product owner, or NPI experience in a hardware environment
  • Deep technical experience in one or more commodities, such as machined parts, avionics and PCBAs, or injection molding
  • AS9100 or a comparable quality management system, and supplier quality processes such as first article and supplier approval
  • Experience owning schedules in a formal tool and reporting program status to leadership and external customers

Additional Requirements

  • This position is based in El Segundo, CA and is onsite five days a week. Remote work is not considered.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% to supplier facilities, Amca factories, and customer sites
  • Willing to work extended hours as needed to support production and resolve critical issues
  • Valid driver's license
Hourly Pay Range
$30—$50 USD

title: Youth Peer Leader
description:
Company Overview:

Improve Your Tomorrow (IYT) was founded in 2013 with the mission to increase the number of young men of color (YMOC) to attend and graduate from colleges and universities. We envision a world where men of color are overrepresented in higher education, underrepresented in the criminal justice system, and become leaders in their communities. By embodying our Core Values of Teamwork, Character, Service and Liberation we work to combat academic inequities and build a college-to-community pipeline.

Position Overview:

The Position will serve as one of our IYT Peer Leaders for our West Sacramento Futures Grant. This West Sacramento Futures Grant is a community violence prevention initiative coordinated by PRO Youth & Families, funded through the Byrne State Crisis Intervention Program (Byrne SCIP), and administered through the City of West Sacramento.

The project brings together five community-based organizations, ten Youth Peer Leaders, PRO Youth, the West Sacramento Police Department, and local families and community members to build community-driven strategies that raise awareness of gun violence prevention resources, promote community safety, educate youth and caregivers about Extreme Risk Protection Orders (ERPOs), and strengthen community connection.

Project Goals

• Increase community awareness of gun violence prevention strategies.

• Increase awareness of Extreme Risk Protection Orders (ERPOs).

• Engage youth and young adults in leadership and community problem-solving.

• Strengthen collaboration among community-based organizations.

• Develop culturally responsive outreach and educational materials.

• Reach at least 500 youth through community outreach activities, with extended reach to caregivers and community members.

• Host a community-wide West Sacramento Futures Summit in Spring 2027.

Peer Leaders participate alongside partner organization staff in a Community of Practice (CoP) that meets approximately twice per month. The CoP is where the group learns about violence prevention and safety strategies, shares resources, develops outreach materials, plans community engagement activities, and coordinates the West Sacramento Futures Summit.

Responsibilities include:

  • Attending Community of Practice meetings, training, and project activities, and contributing youth perspective and ideas.
  • Helping create youth-friendly educational materials and messaging about gun violence prevention.
  • Sharing information and resources with peers, families, and community members.
  • Helping plan and support the West Sacramento Futures Summit - providing input on content, helping promote the event, and supporting it on the day.
  • Keeping required project records, such as activity logs, attendance records, and surveys.
  • Attend Youth Peer Sessions

title: Technical Artist | New Games
description:
Craft:

Job Description:

As a Technical Artist on this Unannounced Project, you will help define how our visual ambitions become performant, polished, in-engine experiences.

You will work closely with artists, designers, engineers, and production to turn concepts, mockups, and visual targets into scalable Unity implementations. This role sits at the intersection of art and engineering: part visual problem solver, part pipeline builder, part hands-on implementer.

We are looking for someone who can raise the quality of the game’s visuals while helping the team move faster. You should be comfortable working directly in Unity, building shaders and materials, improving workflows, identifying bottlenecks, and supporting content creators with practical, production-ready solutions.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who leads by example, communicates well across crafts, and helps the team make strong technical and artistic decisions.

Your role within our Kingdom


You will:

  • Turn concepts and visual targets into polished, performant in-engine experiences

  • Build and support shaders, materials, VFX, lighting, and visual systems in Unity

  • Improve pipelines, workflows, tooling, and content integration across disciplines

  • Partner with artists, designers, engineers, and production teams to solve visual and technical challenges

  • Help define best practices for scalable, performance-aware content creation

  • Mentor teammates and support knowledge sharing across technical art workflows

Skills to create thrills

You are curious, collaborative, and technically minded, with experience translating visual direction into practical in-engine solutions. You enjoy solving visual and workflow challenges, improving how teams create content, and balancing quality with performance.

We are looking for experience with:

  • Technical art workflows in game development and hands-on Unity development

  • Shaders, rendering workflows, lighting, optimization, and performance-aware content creation

  • Asset pipelines, tooling, scripting, or workflow automation in Unity or DCC tools such as Blender, Maya, or Houdini

  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration

  • A proactive mindset and the confidence to take ownership of ambiguous technical art problems.


Bonus skills

  • C# scripting, tooling, or editor extensions in Unity

  • Mobile game development and performance optimization

  • Procedural workflows, VFX Graph, Shader Graph, rigging, animation systems, or customization pipelines

  • Profiling, import pipelines, validators, automation tools, or version control systems such as Git or Perforce

  • Mentorship experience or experience helping define technical art standards for a team.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! At King, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.


About King

With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

description:
Position Description

POSITION: REGISTERED DIETITIAN

REPORTS TO: PROGRAM DIRECTOR

PAY RANGE LEVEL: 11.0

FLSA STATUS: NON-EXEMPT

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: NONE

SCHEDULE: FULL-TIME OR Part-Time

Revision date: 9/29/2026

GENERAL POSITION SUMMARY:

Provides nutritional counseling to High Risk WIC participants following Professional, State and Federal Requirements. Provides in-service training for Program staff regarding nutrition. Follows all WIC Program Regulations and Agency policies to accomplish Program and Agency goals and objectives. Travels to clinic sites within Lake County, along with out of area conferences and training. The Registered Dietitian shall complete the number of continuing education units required to maintain their professional registration with the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Client Services (50%)

  • Accurately determine applicant or participant eligibility for WIC services based on State WIC policies and procedures.
  • Oversees the development, implementation, and evaluation of nutrition protocols for participant education by non-RD staff.
  • Collect and evaluate anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, and dietary data to determine nutrition and /or health risks.
  • Assess need for and provide referrals and follow up to health care providers, public health nurses and other agencies as needed.
  • Assess need for, issue, and track medically indicated formula and foods according to State and local policies and procedures. Support medical nutrition therapy provided to the participant.
  • Develop initial individual nutrition education plans for high-risk participants and determine appropriate follow-up.
  • Acts as a resource for other staff and conduct quality monitoring activities for appropriate and accurate

nutrition assessment, counseling, and referrals.

  • Responsible for the WIC Nutrition Assistant (WNA) training and certification process for staff.
  • Travels to satellite WIC clinics to provide full scope of WIC services to eligible Lake County

residents.

  • Supports the Agency Safety Program.
  • Other duties as assigned within the scope of position classification.

Nutrition Education (20%)

  • Conducts health, nutrition and breastfeeding contacts for prenatal and postpartum women, infants, and children.
  • Assures that any locally developed nutrition education materials for participants contain accurate, reliable, science-based, culturally appropriate information.
  • Assists the Program Director develop, implement, and evaluate the annual WIC Nutrition Services Plan.
  • Plans and implements nutrition education classes for groups of WIC participants.
  • Attends various meetings, trainings, committees, and conferences related to program goals and objectives.
  • Other duties as assigned within the scope of position classification.

Breastfeeding Education and Support (30%)

  • Provides breastfeeding support, education, and counseling to WIC participants and families.
  • Regularly works in a manner that protects, promotes, and supports breastfeeding. Encourages breastfeeding as the norm for infant feeding.
  • Oversees the development, staff training, delivery and evaluation of group and individual breastfeeding education, policies, and practices.
  • Assists the WIC Lactation Coordinator with the breastfeeding promotion component of the annual WIC Nutrition Services Plan.
  • Provides individual breastfeeding consultations in person or on the telephone as appropriate
  • Networks with other health professionals and community organizations to promote and support breastfeeding in the community.
  • Conducts or arrange required breastfeeding training and updates for staff.
  • Other duties as assigned within the scope of position classification.

SECONDARY FUNCTIONS:

  • Communicates with community organizations to promote healthy eating, ensure access to

healthy food and provide healthy living activities for WIC participants.

  • Participates in outreach activities.
  • Maintains a list of referral agency contacts.
  • Attends staff meetings, State sponsored conferences and professional educational trainings as authorized.
  • Prepares and presents reports as required, attends WRAD training for report development and data retrieval.
  • Communicates with State Consultants as necessary.
  • Assists with the development of special projects.
  • Monitor participant records according to LA developed Continuous Quality Improvement (QA/CQI) plan.
  • Other duties as assigned within the scope of position classification.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Registered Dietitian or Registered Dietitian eligible and prefer two years of experience in community nutrition including services to pregnant, breastfeeding, postpartum women and children 0-5 years.
  • Holds current membership in good standing with the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics.
  • Bilingual, bi-literate, English/Spanish, English/Punjabi, English/Hmong, and/or other language

ability based on program needs preferred. (Bilingual preferred English/Spanish)

  • State regulations require a physical examination, current tuberculosis test, and verified fingerprint and criminal records clearance before beginning work.
  • Possession of a valid drivers' license; current personal vehicle insurance or safe driving record. sufficient to ensure insurability through Agency policy.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of participants, employees of the organization, and the general public.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals.
  • Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent.
  • Ability to understand and use a variety of computer applications and appropriate software, spreadsheets and word processing, such as Microsoft Office and workplace electronic technology, including access, networking, and e-mail.
  • Advanced personal computer skills including ability to design and develop data bases; create computerized presentation/training materials; and use advanced graphics design applications is desired.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions, and solve problems effectively and efficiently.
  • Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in various forms and deal with several abstract and concrete variables where on limited standardization exists.

title: Senior Test Analyst/Lead Test Analyst (Automation, Playwright, Appium)
description:
Job Description – Test Automation

Designation - Senior Test Analyst (5-8 years) / Lead Test Analyst (9 -12+ years)

Using a suite of modern tools, the Automation Tester will play a pivotal role in helping us to automate our move towards a truly continuous integration and continuous deployment environment. You will work with our product and development teams to ensure that we are constantly analysing the automated tests that we design and execute for each of our products.

You will report to the QA Manager, work alongside the Test Lead, product and development teams to ensure a high standard of quality in our products. You will carry out automated functional testing on our products. You will have the chance to test modern products based on Microsoft .NET technology.

You will design, maintain and execute suites automated tests using modern languages and tools such as C#, Visual Studio, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha, JavaScript, TypeScript and Microsoft Azure DevOps.

You will be responsible for working through and developing our backlog to make constant improvements and additions to our existing automated tests. You will review and automate existing manual test cases. You will also be responsible for creating and reviewing defects, tracking their progress from their discovery through to their resolution, ensuring that they are adequately documented and tested.

Over time your role will grow and become more varied as you begin to test a larger variety of products across the NEC SWS. We are constantly developing new and cutting edge, scalable solutions and we need a highly skilled QA expert who embraces problem solving on products built with new, well-structured code as well as elements of legacy code.

You will be someone who likes to push boundaries and enjoys rising to a challenge. We are a committed and supportive team with a ‘can do’ mindset.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the implementation of modern test automation frameworks and tools.
  • Oversee test architecture, ensuring scalability and maintainability of automation solutions.
  • Promote shift-left testing practices and support developers in embedding quality.
  • Implementation of automation frameworks for middleware and backend service-based applications in critical infrastructure design.
  • Designing and executing automated tests on the latest revisions of the software.
  • Participating in the development of our automated testing framework, assisting our move towards automated testing in a CI/CD environment.
  • Interpreting requirements from existing manual test cases and specification documents.
    Liaising with Manual Testers and / or Business Analysts to understand the requirements.
  • Liaising with the product and development teams to ensure that our backlog is up to date
  • Providing estimates regarding the test effort required to complete work.
  • Raising bugs and liaising with the development team from discovery through to resolution
  • Setting up and configuring the testing environment and associated database(s)
  • Preparing the test execution report and sharing it with stakeholders.

Required technical skills and experience

  • Experience with C# / Java Script/ Type Script
  • 6 to 10 years of experience in Test Automation using various tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha etc
  • Experience developing and executing automated test cases for User Interfaces
  • Knowledge of software development in a web and desktop environment

Required soft skills and experience

  • Clear and concise communicator
  • Able to prioritise between several tasks at any one time
  • Able to work independently and as part of a team
  • Detailed and effective written communication skills for documenting the features tested and bugs found
  • Highly organized, detail oriented, extremely responsive
  • Be comfortable discussing technical aspects of projects with other testers, developers & business owners.

Desirable skills and experience

  • Experience using Azure DevOps
  • Experience using Selenium and Playwright or equivalent tools
  • Experience using BrowserStack or equivalent cloud-based tools
  • Experience with various reporting libraries such as Extent, Allure etc
  • Usage of latest AI tools.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience testing User Interfaces and databases
  • You'll have ISTQB/ISEB Foundation certifications or equivalent certifications or be working towards achieving them.
  • Experience coordinating with external/Offshore QA resources

Graduate

Good Communication Skills required.

title: QA Lead
description:
We're looking for a QA Lead to join Gameloft Australia, based in Brisbane. Working closely with the QA Director, you'll help coordinate the day-to-day activities of the QA team across multiple projects. You'll be responsible for managing priorities, delegating tasks, tracking QA deliverables and acting as a key link between QA, Development and other studio teams. This role is ideal for an experienced QA professional looking to take the next step into leadership, combining strong QA knowledge with project coordination, communication and team development.

What it means on a daily basis

  • Coordinate QA activities, priorities and deliverables across multiple projects and milestones.
  • Delegate and track QA tasks based on project priorities, timelines and team capacity.
  • Act as a key link between QA and Development, helping communicate bugs, priorities, requirements and project risks.
  • Monitor QA progress and provide clear updates on testing, critical issues, blockers and delivery risks.
  • Coordinate with external QA teams to ensure testing activities align with project requirements and schedules.
  • Maintain bug tracking, QA plans, test documentation and supporting processes across projects.
  • Support the QA Director with team management, mentoring, performance development and day-to-day team coordination.
  • Identify opportunities to improve QA workflows, communication and team efficiency.
  • Help ensure QA is effectively integrated into the wider game development and production process.


What success will look like

Success in this role means keeping QA organised, proactive and aligned with the wider development process across multiple projects. The successful candidate will effectively manage priorities and deliverables, ensure critical issues and risks are clearly communicated, coordinate internal and external testing, and support the QA team through mentoring and day-to-day leadership. They will also contribute to improving QA processes and help ensure the team consistently delivers thorough, timely testing that supports successful project milestones and releases.

Your Recruitment Journey

  • First stage: A call with our Talent Acquisition Team
  • Second stage: Interview with our QA Director
  • Third stage: Interview with our QA Team

    What you need to succeed

    • Demonstrated professional experience in Quality Assurance, preferably within the video game industry.
    • 5+ years’ experience progressing through QA roles, with a strong understanding of the QA lifecycle and what is required at junior, mid and senior levels.
    • 2+ years’ experience taking on leadership, coordination or mentoring responsibilities within a QA team.
    • Experience coordinating QA activities across projects, milestones or releases.
    • Strong understanding of Agile development and software/game development processes.
    • Experience managing and prioritising tasks across multiple projects or workstreams.
    • Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly communicate issues between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Experience working closely with Development, Production and other interdisciplinary teams.
    • Experience with project management and task-tracking tools such as Jira, Hansoft or similar.
    • Experience managing and prioritising bugs, including understanding severity, priority and release impact.
    • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and changing deadlines.
    • Ability to identify risks, blockers and resourcing concerns and escalate them appropriately.
    • A proactive approach to problem solving and communication.
    • Passion for games and a genuine interest in the video game industry.


    Desirable:

    • Previous experience in a QA Lead, QA Coordinator, Senior QA or similar leadership role.
    • Experience coordinating internal QA teams.
    • Experience working across multiple platforms and release cycles.
    • Familiarity with First Party Submission requirements across platforms such as PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Apple or similar.
    • Experience with live service games or ongoing content releases.
    • Experience with QA tools, test management systems or automation.
    • Experience with programming or scripting languages such as C++, C#, Python or similar.
    • Formal project management or Agile certification.
    • Experience working with game development tools such as Unreal Engine, Unity, Perforce or similar.

    What's in it for you


    Perks & benefits:

    • A flexible work model that supports work–life balance
    • Subsidised car parking
    • Ongoing learning and development opportunities to support career growth
    • An employee referral program with generous bonuses
    • Private health insurance and fitness subsidies
    • Access to employee mental health and wellbeing support
    • Paid parental leave
    • Childcare assistance
    • A dedicated relaxation space, including a massage chair
    • Additional paid leave, including: Birthday leave, Christmas shutdown leave, Volunteer leave, Women’s health leave
    • Free coffee from a commercial espresso machine, plus daily snacks and a light breakfast
    • Friday social drinks with friendly game tournaments
    • A stunning rooftop terrace with river views and a games room
    • Exclusive Gameloft-branded merchandise


    Life at Gameloft

    Gameloft Brisbane, part of the global Gameloft family, opened its doors in 2014 and has since delivered hit titles such as Zombie Anarchy, Ballistic Baseball, My Little Pony: Mane Merge, the multi-award-winning The Oregon Trail™, and Carmen Sandiego.

    Today, we are the largest video game studio in Queensland, employing more than 130 talented professionals across programming, art, design, production, QA, audio, marketing, administration and management. Together, we create immersive gaming experiences enjoyed by millions of players around the world.

    We are proud to be developing Bluey’s Happy Snaps, bringing one of Australia’s most iconic IPs to life in a brand-new interactive experience. As we continue to grow, we’re also working on a range of exciting unannounced projects that will help shape the future of our studio.

    At Gameloft Brisbane, people are at the heart of everything we do. Our studio fosters a collaborative, creative and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to contribute, learn and grow. We are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified for 2025–2026, recognising our strong culture, inclusive practices and ongoing commitment to employee well-being.

    Employee well-being is a top priority, supported by flexible work arrangements, wellness initiatives, career development opportunities and world-class facilities. We actively invest in our people’s growth through mentorship, training programs, industry events and speaking opportunities that encourage everyone to develop their skills and make an impact.

    As pioneers in Brisbane’s game development industry, we continue to push the boundaries of cross-platform game development while creating unforgettable experiences for players around the world. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, you’ll find a supportive environment where creativity, collaboration and innovation thrive.

    Gameloft Brisbane is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering diversity and inclusivity within our work environment.

    Driven by a strong studio culture and a passion for creating meaningful experiences, we build games that resonate with players around the world.

title: Dynamics Engineer
description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

To help achieve these efforts, Stratolaunch is seeking a Dynamics Engineer to contribute to the development of an air-launched, hypersonic flight vehicle. This position includes owning the aeroelastic analysis, ground vibration testing, model correlation, and aeroelastic flight test of the hypersonic vehicle. This position also includes contributing to the vehicle’s structural and GNC technical performance, including meeting design and mission requirements, resolving technical challenges, and implementing technology upgrades that improve the competitive basis of the vehicle’s architecture.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the aeroelastic development of a hypersonic vehicle (analysis, ground test, and flight test)
  • Perform aeroelastic analysis and report flutter margins against program requirements
  • Perform aeroservoelastic analysis of hypersonic vehicle, as required, to support the GNC team
  • Create and maintain models required to support other teams, such as a structural flex model for the GNC team
  • Lead and perform ground tests, as required, to anchor the flutter model and perform other structural dynamic tests

title: Senior Principal AI Solutions Engineer
description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

We are looking for a Senior Principal AI Solutions Engineer: a hands-on technical leader who sets the technical direction for our solutions portfolio and still builds. This is someone who can go from a customer problem to a polished, working, agentic application in days, and then harden it for production. You will work across the whole modern AI stack: open-weight models, agent frameworks and tool use, self-improving evaluation loops, multimodal and voice pipelines, and the front end that makes it all usable by knowledge workers. You will lead hands-on engagements with our most strategic customers, mentor and raise the bar for the wider solutions team, and feed what you learn back into the platform.

Responsibilities

Build agentic and self-improving systems

  • Agentic AI Architecture: Design and build single- and multi-agent systems with planning, tool and function calling, MCP, memory, and long-running workflows that are reliable enough for production • Self-Improving Systems: Build feedback loops that make agents better over time, including automated evals, LLM-as-judge, trace-driven prompt and program optimization (e.g. DSPy-style), synthetic data generation, and fine-tuning from production signals
  • Evaluation and Observability: Set up eval harnesses, tracing and guardrails so customers can measure quality, cost and latency, and trust what they deploy

Get the most from open models

  • Open-Weight Model Expertise: Choose, adapt and combine open models (e.g. Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Gemma, GLM) for customer use cases, including LoRA/PEFT fine-tuning, distillation and model routing
  • Performance and Benchmarking: Benchmark end-to-end solutions, not just tokens per second, and show where fast inference changes what an application can do
  • Model Integration: Validate new models and capabilities on SambaNova's platform stack and report gaps to Product and Engineering

Ship full-stack vertical solutions

  • Front-End and Product Build: Build polished, usable web applications (e.g. React/Next.js, TypeScript) that non-technical knowledge workers can adopt, not just notebooks and APIs
  • Vertical Knowledge Work: Build domain solutions for areas such as financial services, legal, healthcare, public sector and research: document analysis, research agents, RAG and knowledge assistants, report generation and workflow automation
  • Multimodal Solutions: Build vision-language and document-understanding pipelines (OCR, charts, forms, images, video) combined with agentic reasoning
  • Audio and Voice: Build real-time voice agents and audio pipelines (ASR, TTS, speech-to-speech, streaming and turn-taking) where low latency is the product

Lead with customers and shape the platform

  • Solutions Technical Strategy: Set the technical direction for the solutions portfolio: which agentic, multimodal and vertical patterns we invest in, the shared frameworks and components we build, and the engineering standards they meet
  • Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Act as the senior technical authority across solutions engineering; review designs, mentor engineers and lift the quality of everything the team ships
  • Executive Engagement: Act as the trusted technical advisor to customer CTOs and AI leaders on architecture, build-versus-buy and scaling AI across the enterprise
  • Customer Engagement: Lead technical discovery, workshops, hackathons and hands-on co-builds with strategic customers, from prototype to production
  • Reference Architectures: Publish reference architectures, starter kits, open-source examples and best-practice guides that scale beyond each engagement
  • SambaStack Tooling: Develop tooling and automation for SambaStack deployment, management and integration
  • Product Feedback: Feed what you learn in the field (model requests, feature gaps, developer experience) into the model roadmap and platform priorities
  • Thought Leadership: Represent SambaNova through demos, talks, blogs and community contributions

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Statistics or a related field
  • 8+ years (IC5) or 10+ years (IC6) of industry experience in software, ML or solutions engineering, including 3+ years building LLM-based applications that reached production
  • Proven experience building agentic systems: tool and function calling, multi-agent orchestration and frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK or equivalent • Hands-on experience with open-weight models: serving, prompting, fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT) and evaluation • Strong full-stack skills: expert Python plus modern front-end development (TypeScript, React/Next.js), APIs and cloud deployment
  • Experience designing evals and benchmarks for LLM applications, covering quality, latency and cost • Excellent customer communication, with the ability to lead workshops and explain architecture to both executives and engineers
  • A track record of technical leadership across teams: setting architecture direction, mentoring senior engineers and owning outcomes for strategic accounts

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building self-improving or learning systems: prompt/program optimization, RL from feedback, synthetic data pipelines or continual fine-tuning
  • Experience building real-time voice agents (e.g. LiveKit, Pipecat, WebRTC) and working with speech models (ASR/TTS)
  • Experience with multimodal and vision-language models and document-understanding pipelines • Domain experience in one or more knowledge-work verticals (financial services, legal, healthcare, public sector, scientific research)
  • Familiarity with inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) and hardware-aware performance tuning
  • Experience with MCP, RAG at enterprise scale, and agent security and guardrails • Open-source contributions, public demos or technical content in the AI community

Base Salary Range:

Base Pay Range
$234,000—$286,000 USD

Submission Guidelines
Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.

EEO Policy
SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Benefits Summary for US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions
SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

쿠팡페이의 핀테크 사업은 금융 서비스의 재정의를 통해 쿠팡 고객과 판매자들이 동일한 비용으로 더 많은 가치를 누리도록 지원합니다. 쿠팡페이는 쿠팡 앱 및 홈페이지에서 상품을 구매하는 소비자와 쿠팡 마켓플레이스에서 사업을 영위하는 판매자, 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 음식점주 등에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 솔루션을 제공하는 데 최선을 다합니다. 쿠팡페이의 최신 핀테크 혁신 기술은 원터치 결제 서비스가 탑재된 자체 결제 시스템 쿠페이를 기반으로 한국과 대만 소비자들의 니즈에 부응하고 있습니다.대표적으로 쿠팡페이는 고객 가치 지향 차원에서 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 쿠팡와우카드(쿠팡 전용 제휴 카드)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 또 마켓플레이스 판매자들을 위해 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 모델을 접목하고 다양한 유동성 강화 솔루션을 제공함으로써 소상공인들의 사업 성장을 적극 지원합니다. 보유하고 계신 다양한 경험을 핀테크 분야에서 최대한 살리고 싶다면 쿠팡페이와 함께 하세요. 쿠팡페이는 고객들의 결제 시간을 최대한 아껴주고 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 쇼핑할 시간을 벌어드립니다.

직무소개

서울에 본사를 둔 쿠팡페이 제품 엔지니어링 팀은 제품 개발, 출시 및 관리를 진행하고 있으며 매일 고객을 열광시키고 있습니다. 혁신적인 고객 경험을 제공하는 소프트웨어를 만들고 확장시킨 경험이 풍부한 숙련된 소프트웨어 설계자를 찾고 있습니다.

업무 내용

  • 쿠팡페이 Product 앱들의 설계를 리드하고 구현합니다.
  • 시니어/주니어 개발자들과 함께 시스템 디자인 논의에 참여하고 리드합니다.
  • 미션 크리티컬 프로젝트에서 엔지니어를 이끌고 복잡한 비즈니스 문제를 빠르게 해결합니다.
  • 시니어/주니어 개발자들의 멘토로서 성장을 이끕니다.
  • 혁신적인 소비자용 모바일 프로덕트 개발을 위한 최고의 프로그래밍 기술을 제공합니다.

자격 요건

  • 팀 플레이어
  • Java 또는 Kotlin으로 Android 코딩 개발 경력 최소 6년 이상
  • 고품질의 대규모 소비자 앱 개발 경험이 있는 분
  • 미션 크리티컬 시스템 제공에 대한 입증된 실적.
  • B2C 비지니스 도메인에 대한 경험.
  • 컴퓨터 공학 또는 관련 기술 분야의 학사 학위를 소지한 자

우대 사항

  • Payment 도메인에서 근무 경력.
  • Cross-Platform(Flutter) 기반의 모바일 개발 경험
  • 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 여러 경쟁 우선 순위를 처리 할 수있는 능력
  • Product을 구현하는 것에 대한 강한 열정.
  • 애자일 소프트웨어 방법론이 익숙하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - Focus Interview – Job Fit Interview – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangpay.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

쿠팡은 모두에게 공평한 기회를 제공합니다

쿠팡은 어느 누구에게나 열려 있는 회사입니다. 다양한 국가 출신 임직원이 함께 일하는 글로벌팀이 없었더라면 전례없는 성공을 이루기 어려웠을 겁니다.

title: Owner Succes Associate
description:
Owner Success Associate - English Speaker

Brazil-Based | Freelance / Independent Contractor | European Working Hours

About GuestReady

GuestReady is a leading short-term rental and hospitality management company operating across multiple markets, including the UK, France, Portugal, Spain, and the UAE.

Since 2016, we have been combining technology with high-quality hospitality services to help property owners successfully manage their properties and deliver excellent guest experiences.

We are currently looking for an English-speaking Owner Success Associate based in Brazil to join our international team on a freelance / independent contractor basis.

Please note that this position requires availability to work according to European business hours.

Role Overview

As an Owner Success Associate, you will be a key point of contact for property owners, ensuring clear and professional communication, effective coordination with internal teams, and a consistently high level of service.

Beyond day-to-day owner support, you will take a proactive approach to monitoring property performance, identifying opportunities for improvement, and working with owners to help maximise occupancy, revenue, and overall property performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage owner inquiries professionally and efficiently, providing accurate information regarding bookings, property performance, operational processes, and other relevant topics.

  • Proactively monitor property performance and revenue, regularly reviewing financial and operational results, identifying trends and opportunities, and recommending actions to improve revenue, occupancy, and overall performance.

  • Discuss performance and commercial strategy with owners, using data and insights to clearly explain results, manage expectations, and align on actions needed to improve performance.

  • Coordinate communication between property owners and internal teams, acting as a bridge between owners and departments such as Operations, Guest Experience, and Finance when required.

  • Take ownership of owner requests and issues, investigating concerns, identifying appropriate solutions, and escalating cases when necessary.

  • Maintain accurate records of interactions and cases, ensuring conversations, requests, actions, and resolutions are properly documented in our internal systems and CRM.

  • Ensure timely follow-up and resolution, keeping owners informed throughout the process and maintaining a high standard of communication.

  • Identify recurring challenges and opportunities for improvement, proactively sharing feedback and insights that can improve both the owner experience and property performance.

  • Adapt to evolving processes, systems, and tools in a dynamic and fast-growing international environment.

What We’re Looking For

  • Fluency in English.

  • Currently based in Brazil.

  • Availability to work European business hours.

  • Previous experience in customer service, account management, hospitality, property management, or a similar client-facing role.

  • Strong commercial awareness and confidence working with performance and revenue-related data.

  • Comfortable having challenging or commercially sensitive conversations with owners, particularly around occupancy, revenue performance, pricing strategy, and actions required to improve results.

  • Ability to communicate data and recommendations clearly, manage expectations, and constructively challenge owners when needed.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Excellent organisational and multitasking abilities.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a high level of ownership and accountability.

  • Confidence working with digital tools, CRM platforms, and online communication systems.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with an international team.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

Contract

This opportunity is offered on a freelance / independent contractor basis and is open to candidates based in Brazil.

The successful candidate will provide services to GuestReady as an independent contractor rather than as an employee and must be available to work according to European working hours.

Further details regarding the working schedule, compensation, and collaboration model will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Why Work With GuestReady?

  • Join an international and multicultural team in the travel and hospitality industry.

  • Work in a dynamic, technology-driven environment.

  • Collaborate with teams across different countries and markets.

  • Develop your experience in owner relations, hospitality, and property management.

  • Be part of a growing company where initiative, ownership, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Join Us

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We value potential, adaptability, and a willingness to learn alongside relevant experience.

GuestReady is committed to creating an inclusive environment and welcomes applications from people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

title: Estimator IV (MEP)
description:
About Vanir

Vanir is a proud minority- and woman-owned company, recognized as a national leader in program, project and construction management (PMCM) and real estate development. Since 1964, we have consistently exceeded client expectations. Ranked as a top PMCM firm by Engineering News-Record (ENR) for more than three decades, our award-winning team provides a full range of services to public and private sector clients in the aviation; healthcare; education (K-12 and higher); justice and essential services; science and technology; state and local government; transportation; water and wastewater; energy; and commercial, residential and nonprofit markets.

Job Description

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Senior level estimator who specializes in Mechanical, Electrical, and Pluming (MEP) trades to report to PMO Program Controls Manager and Lead Estimator.
  • Plan and participate in the preparation of construction cost estimates of buildings or other structures from drawings, outlines, and specifications.
  • Prepare estimates per design based on scope and building type.
  • Evaluate cost-estimating deliverables prepared by consultants for cost containment, accuracy, uniformity and completeness.
  • Prepare fair cost estimates for cost proposals from Contractors for extra work.
  • Perform special studies and prepare reports when contractors’ bids vary from the construction cost estimate.
  • Conduct construction/project site visits gathering relevant information and determine what information to be used to produce project estimates.
  • Conduct material takeoffs and quantity surveys for MEP systems, including mechanical, electrical, and plumbing components.
  • Evaluate pricing documents, historical and vendor cost data for the development of cost estimates and price recommendations.
  • Evaluate quotes, bids, change orders, value engineering reports, and claims for accuracy and completeness of estimates.
  • Compile and analyze data on all factors that influence costs such as material, labor, equipment and profit.
  • Prepare technical evaluations, cost estimating draft report, memos, letters, and present recommendation to management.
  • Collaborate with project managers, engineers, and architects to identify value engineering opportunities and cost-savings measures.
  • Perform other related estimating duties as assigned.
  • Ability to compare cost estimates with contractors’ proposal to identify discrepancies.
  • Ability to develop scope of work based on RFI/RFC, answers and estimates the detailed costs of those scopes of work independent of the contractor proposal.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to perform basic calculations in Excel.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Ten (10) years minimum of recent professional experience in the preparation of complete cost estimates for type I, II, or III, and V building construction as defined by the State building code including 5 - 7 years of MEP estimating.
  • BS/BA Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or other related degree. Additional qualifying experience in excess to the minimum stated above may be substituted for the required education on a year for year basis.
  • Expert in theories, principles, and practices of cost estimating and contract pricing.
  • Expert in Design Build, Design Bid Build and Job Order Contracting forms of contracting.
  • Full knowledge of construction methods for buildings and structures.
  • Full knowledge of current local construction labor and material costs.
  • Full knowledge of MEP systems, construction methods, and industry standards.
  • Extensive experience in developing and estimating the scope of work for change orders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Prevailing Wage/Union Labor rates.
  • Knowledge and use of NECA and MCAA labor productivity.
  • Knowledge and use of RS Means, Accubid, Trimble MEP, or Bluebeam Revu.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and thoroughness.
  • Excellent mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Benefits

Vanir offers a comprehensive, competitive benefits package that includes 401(k) Savings with employer matching contributions, medical, dental, vision, health savings account (HSA) with employer contributions, life, AD&D and disability benefits, flexible spending account (FSA), voluntary benefits, Teladoc, pet insurance, paid time off, national employee assistance program (EAP) and employee referral program.

How to Apply

If you're interested in working for Vanir please visit our website to learn more and to apply online at www.vanir.com.

VEVRAA Federal Contractor

Request Priority Protected Veteran Referrals

EOE Minorities/Females/Protected Veterans/Disabled

Contact Email: careers@vanir.com

Persons with medical limitations may, with reasonable accommodations, be capable of performing the duties of this position. Such a determination must be made on an individual basis considering the person's limitations, the requirements of the position, and the company's ability to make reasonable accommodations to the person's limitations.

We Participate in E-Verify

title: Senior AI / Data Engineer: Data Platforms, Machine Learning & Applied AI
description:
Key Role:

Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as a Senior AI / Data Engineer supporting federal agencies and other clients. Lead the design and delivery of the data platforms, machine learning systems, and AI applications that turn client data into decisions, and set the engineering standards other engineers follow.

Strong client or customer engagement is required in this role. You will work directly with client program leadership, architects, data scientists, and governance teams, advise on technical direction, and represent Intertwine Associates and the client with professionalism, responsiveness, and sound judgment at every touchpoint. This is a remote position with occasional travel. Assignments are matched to client needs and to each candidate's expertise and eligibility.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect and lead the delivery of enterprise data platforms and pipelines on Azure (Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric / Foundry) or equivalent cloud services.
  • Set standards for ETL design, schema enforcement, data validation, quality checks, and lineage, and review other engineers' work against them.
  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and AI solutions, including applications built on large language models such as retrieval-augmented generation, document understanding, and agentic workflows, with evaluation and guardrails.
  • Build secure API endpoints and microservices that make data and models available to analytics and ML platforms.
  • Establish MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registries, CI/CD, containers, monitoring, and cost and performance tuning.
  • Apply data and AI governance for compliance, reproducibility, auditability, and responsible AI, including federal frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Translate mission and business needs into technical roadmaps, estimates, and briefings for client leadership.
  • Mentor engineers and data scientists and lead technical work across multidisciplinary teams.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience building data pipelines, machine learning systems, or AI applications in production, including 2+ years leading technical work.
  • Expert Python (including Pandas and NumPy) and advanced SQL, with experience integrating relational and unstructured sources.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Azure data services, or equivalent depth in AWS or Google Cloud.
  • Production experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
  • Experience with data validation, schema enforcement, quality assurance, and governance in regulated environments.
  • Experience designing APIs and microservices for analytics and ML platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including briefing senior, non-technical audiences.
  • U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residency may be required per contract.
  • Ability to obtain a federal government Public Trust or security clearance where the assignment requires one.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience building applications on large language models: retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings and vector databases, evaluation, and guardrails.
  • Microsoft certifications such as Azure Data Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, Fabric Data Engineer, or Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent AWS or Google Cloud certifications.
  • Experience with Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or similar modern data platforms at enterprise scale.
  • Familiarity with FedRAMP, FISMA, and federal data security requirements.
  • Experience supporting a federal agency, or health, scientific, or research data.
  • An active federal Public Trust or security clearance.

title: Assistant Boutique Leader
description:
Role Purpose

The Assistant Boutique Leader plays a key role in supporting the Boutique Leader to deliver exceptional customer experiences, strong commercial outcomes and a positive, values-led team culture.

title: Graduate Management Programme 2026 - Italy
description:
Our Graduate Programme is LIVE for 2026, and we are looking for ambitious, curious, and driven graduates to join our innovative global company.

This 12-month rotational programme offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience across multiple business functions while developing a deep understanding of our Fuel and Telematics divisions.

Successful candidates will join one of the following pathways:

Pathway 1: Commercial & Sales Graduate Programme (Milan)

Location: Milan

You will complete four rotations across our commercial teams, gaining exposure to the full sales cycle and customer growth strategies within both Fuel and Telematics.

Rotations include:

  • Inside Sales Inbound – Fuel
  • Inside Sales Outbound – Fuel
  • Inside Sales – Telematics
  • Account Management – Telematics

Pathway 2: Customer Operations Graduate Programme (Vimercate)

Location: Vimercate

You will complete four rotations across key customer-focused operational functions, building expertise in customer experience, service delivery, and business operations across Fuel and Telematics.

Rotations include:

  • Customer Onboarding
  • Account Management

description:

title: Space Systems Engineer, Space Operations
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

The Space Operations team is crucial to Planet's success, responsible for maintaining and optimizing the health and productivity of the world's largest Earth Observation satellite constellation. Our team spans North America and Berlin. Given the scale of our fleet, automation is at the heart of our operations. You'll develop and maintain critical software, transforming large datasets into actionable metrics.

As a Space Systems Engineer, you'll support daily satellite operations, analyze data, triage and resolve anomalies, run on-orbit experiments, test and deploy software both on the ground and in orbit, and commission satellites. We are looking for a data-driven self-starter with effective communication skills that collaborates well within a technical team and adapts quickly to changing tasks and contexts. You'll work closely with hardware and software experts across teams to debug anomalies, enhance or create services, and provide operational insights to shape our next-generation satellites.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

  • Conduct daily fleet checks and support On-Call shifts
  • Test and deploy flight software upgrades, debug satellite anomalies, and perform on-orbit experiments
  • Develop and maintain real-time, mission-critical software solutions for satellite operations
  • Write scripts to aggregate satellite data and generate system monitoring metrics
  • Analyze data to identify issues and inefficiencies in the full stack of services and propose solutions
  • Create and maintain operational procedures
  • Drive improvements to fleet capacity and productivity through process enhancements
  • Provide feedback to launch, manufacturing, and spacecraft engineering teams based on on-orbit performance, technical demonstrations, and forecasting models
  • Shape operational strategies for next-generation spacecraft

What You Bring:

  • 2+ years of relevant work experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent
  • Experience in software development, particularly in Python or similar languages
  • Familiarity with the space environment and its challenges
  • Data-driven mindset with experience in statistical analysis
  • Proactive approach to engineering and problem-solving
  • Effective interpersonal and collaboration skills within a technical team

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Hands-on experience operating spacecraft or remote systems
  • Experience and understanding of spacecraft propulsion and guidance, navigation, and control systems
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing infrastructures
  • Experience with Agile software development
  • Experience in DevOps tools and practices (e.g., Git, GitLab, Docker, Jenkins, Bash, Linux, CI/CD, Sentry, Datadog)
  • Practical experience in data analysis for problem-solving
  • Familiarity with automation and optimization tools
  • Contributions to open-source software projects

We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.
