description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other lice applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

Due to the length of this recruitment campaign, we will endeavour to inform you of your outcome following the interview. Successful candidates will be placed on a reserve list and will be allocated or offered roles once the campaign has fully concluded.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

title: Avionics - Vehicle Components Team Lead
description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Avionics - Vehicle Electronics Team Lead

As the Team Lead for the Avionics - Vehicle Electronics Engineering Team you will play a critical role in building and leading a team of engineers that own the compute, networking, and power distribution systems within our spacecraft. You’ll support the team in pushing the boundary of what is possible in a geo-synchronous spacecraft design and enable performance in space that has not been realized to date.


Role

  • Directly manage and grow a team of junior and senior electrical engineers
  • Collaborate with a broad and multidisciplinary team to define the spacecraft compute, networking, and power distribution requirements and architectures
  • Oversee the design, build, and implementation of our in-house hardware and systems
  • Manage a detailed schedule to ensure that our hardware development is in sync with the overall program schedule
  • Drive hardware design, specification, component selection, circuit board design, implementation, verification, board bring-up, and debugging
  • Own the technical relationship with third-party component suppliers to ensure our vendors provide robust and performant solutions
  • Support in recruiting, interviewing, and hiring additional teammates to our rapidly-growing team
  • Support the production and mission operations teams on the build and in-flight use of our component hardware
  • Drive the growth of the avionics components team through recruiting, interviewing, and hiring additional teammates to our rapidly-expanding team


Requirements

  • B.S. or higher in electrical or computer engineering, or similar technical degree
  • 5+ years of professional experience with fast-paced product design cycles
  • 5+ years of board level experience designing electronics hardware from concept through to production
  • A passion for hardware development & fostering teamwork in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to design, build, and test hardware, hands-on, from scratch
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage teams of engineers and communicate clearly with other disciplines
  • Strong analog/mixed-signal circuit design skills
  • US Citizenship or Green Card


Bonus

  • 5+ years of experience with designing and implementing signal conditioning, sensors, electro-mechanical actuators, power switches, embedded computers, or such hardware.
  • Experience with FPGAs, Microcontrollers, and communication schemes (RS-485, SPI, Ethernet, I2C)
  • Strong understanding of C, C++, or Python
  • Radiation effects knowledge
  • Environmental test experience
What we offer:
All our positions offer a compensation package that includes equity and robust benefits.

Base pay is just one component of Astranis’s total rewards package. Your compensation also includes a significant equity package via incentive stock options, high-quality company-subsidized healthcare, disability and life insurance, 401(k) retirement planning, flexible PTO, and free on-site catered meals.

Astranis pay ranges are informed and defined through professional-grade salary surveys and compensation data sources. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, and the level and scope of the position.
Base Salary
$160,000—$210,000 USD
U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required
(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))
Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

title: Senior Product Manager | Chef.fe de produit Senior.e
description:
DESCRIPTION DE L'ENTREPRISE

Ludia est un studio innovant et dynamique, spécialisé dans le développement de jeux mobiles. Basé à Montréal depuis 2007, chaque mois, plus de 3,5 millions de joueurs à travers le monde plongent dans nos univers. Notre portfolio combine des franchises mondiales emblématiques et des créations originales, incluant Jurassic World™ Alive, Jurassic World™: The Game, Dragons: Rise of Berk, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Legends, et bien d’autres.

Avec plus de 500 millions de téléchargements depuis notre fondation, nous entamons un chapitre exaltant en tant que studio indépendant, où la croissance est portée par la passion de notre équipe et de nos joueurs.



DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Êtes-vous prêt.e à créer la prochaine grande révolution dans le jeu mobile ? Nous recherchons un.e Chef.fe de produit Senior.e talentueux.se pour rejoindre notre équipe et nous aider à innover, développer et affiner des fonctionnalités qui propulseront nos jeux à un niveau supérieur ! En tant que Chef.fe de produit Senior.e, vous porterez deux casquettes : orchestrer un calendrier LiveOps passionnant pour booster l'engagement et la monétisation, et gérer le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités pour garantir le succès à long terme de notre jeu. Vous serez le lien essentiel entre les données, la conception, l’ingénierie et la stratégie, assurant que notre jeu évolue pour répondre aux besoins des joueurs et aux objectifs business.



🎯 RESPONSABILITÉS

Stratégie produit et identité

  • Soyez un(e) leader dans la définition de l'identité et de la stratégie produit, en parfaite collaboration avec la direction produit et le marketing.
  • Participez à l’analyse des opportunités et du marché (public cible, analyse des concurrents, benchmarks, KPIs, etc.).
  • Assurez-vous que l’identité produit, les piliers stratégiques et le positionnement concurrentiel soient bien alignés.
  • Identifiez les besoins en recherche utilisateur et recueillez des informations sur le public cible (tests de concepts, sondages, playtests, tests d’icônes, etc.).
  • Apportez un point de vue externe en réalisant des benchmarks sur des jeux pertinents et en identifiant les meilleures pratiques et tendances sur des fonctionnalités ou systèmes spécifiques.

LiveOps et Monétisation

  • Définissez et ajustez constamment la stratégie de monétisation et l’économie du jeu.
  • Planifiez, analysez, optimisez et gérez les LiveOps (événements en jeu, promotions, ventes).
  • Menez des tests A/B pour maximiser les revenus.
  • Gérez les plans de segmentation des utilisateurs et de personnalisation pour améliorer l’expérience de jeu.
  • Surveillez la performance produit et la croissance, en collaboration avec la direction produit et le marketing.
  • Développez, maintenez et gérez des modèles quantitatifs pour mesurer l’engagement des joueurs et la performance du produit (KPI Framework/Modèle soutenant les prévisions de revenus et le suivi hebdomadaire des performances).

Croissance produit et reporting

  • Définissez les objectifs de KPIs du jeu et collaborez avec l’équipe pour établir la stratégie de leur réalisation.
  • Créez et gérez des rapports et des analyses sur la performance produit pour les responsables produit, le marketing et autres parties prenantes, afin d’identifier les leviers d’optimisation et soutenir la prise de décision.
  • Collaborez avec le marketing pour stimuler la croissance du produit (plateformes, ASO, UA, créatifs).

Développement des fonctionnalités et feuille de route

  • Gérez le processus de mise à jour de la feuille de route du jeu.
  • Priorisez le backlog de contenu en équilibrant les besoins de l’équipe, des parties prenantes et des joueurs, et assurez un processus transparent et collaboratif pour la gestion de la feuille de route, en partenariat avec le design du jeu et la production.
  • Coordonnez les équipes et les parties prenantes pour définir les priorités des fonctionnalités à l’aide de données et d’analyses de marché.

Gestion d’équipe et collaboration

title: AI Testing Engineer, Amazon Bedrock
company: NTT DATA, Europe & LATAM, Branch in USA, Inc.
description:
Location: 100% remote, seeking candidates located in LATAM.

Contract Length: 1 year, with potential for extension.

Contract Rate: $20-25 per hour in USD. Final rate will be determined based on relevant experience and overall fit for the position.

NTT DATA is seeking an AI Testing Engineer, Amazon Bedrock to define and execute the quality strategy for Generative AI applications and AI agents used in Customer Service and Contact Center scenarios. This role will evaluate AI outputs across deterministic and non-deterministic scenarios using automation, semantic and statistical analysis, human review, and adversarial testing while partnering with AI engineers and functional QA teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Define the testing and evaluation strategy for Generative AI applications and AI agents.
  • Create and maintain evaluation datasets, golden datasets, and regression suites covering representative business scenarios.
  • Design single-turn and multi-turn conversational test cases, including context retention and workflow transitions.
  • Evaluate AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, completeness, groundedness, faithfulness, consistency, tone, safety, and compliance.
  • Build automated evaluation pipelines and integrate AI-quality checks into CI/CD and release processes.
  • Detect regressions introduced by changes to prompts, models, knowledge sources, retrieval strategies, tools, or guardrails.
  • Design negative and adversarial test scenarios covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, hallucinations, PII leakage, unsafe responses, and out-of-scope requests.
  • Validate fallback behavior, uncertainty handling, tool execution, error handling, and escalation to human agents.
  • Perform root-cause analysis for incorrect or undesirable AI outputs and collaborate with AI engineers on remediation.
  • Define measurable quality thresholds and release acceptance criteria for AI-agent capabilities.
  • Produce quality metrics, evaluation reports, dashboards, and trend analysis for project and product stakeholders.
  • Support UAT preparation, defect triage, production monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI behavior.

Required Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, or test automation with hands-on automation capabilities.
  • 2+ years of experience with Amazon Bedrock.
  • Practical understanding of Generative AI / LLM behavior and the challenges of testing non-deterministic systems.
  • Experience designing test scenarios for conversational applications, chatbots, virtual assistants, or AI agents.
  • Experience with Python and/or JavaScript / TypeScript for test automation and data processing.
  • Experience testing REST APIs and backend services.
  • Experience working with structured test data in formats such as JSON and CSV.
  • Understanding of evaluation concepts such as groundedness, faithfulness, relevance, hallucination detection, semantic similarity, and human evaluation.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated regression testing, and defect-management workflows.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to investigate why an AI output failed rather than only identifying that it failed.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience with AI evaluation frameworks such as RAGAS, DeepEval, Promptfoo, LangSmith, TruLens, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience evaluating RAG systems, retrieval quality, or enterprise knowledge assistants.
  • Experience with Amazon Bedrock and AWS services.
  • Experience testing Amazon Connect, Contact Center, agent-assist, or Customer Service applications.

Education & Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

Required Equipment: This role requires the use of a personal laptop. Candidates must be comfortable with company security software and device management tools being installed on their laptop as part of the onboarding process and for the duration of the engagement.

title: System Engineering - Platforms
description:
We are seeking a Platforms Systems Engineer to provide technical leadership for the development, integration, and validation of vehicle-level communications systems. The Platforms Team works on designing installations for Communication Systems within ground combat vehicles and other mobile structures. Communication Systems have become some of the most complicated subsystems that are installed with vehicle platforms. These systems require specialized knowledge and skillsets to design and qualify. The Platforms Team works closely with end customers as well as OEMs in order to ensure the systems are installed in accordance with our strict requirements and function as intended.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development of system requirements, architectures, interfaces, and technical solutions for vehicle communications systems.
  • Lead trade studies and technical assessments, balancing performance, weight, power, volume, reliability, and EMI/EMC considerations.
  • Provide technical direction for system integration, testing, troubleshooting, and validation on testbeds and prototype vehicles.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to establish and maintain necessary lab resources – including specialized equipment, testing infrastructure and workspace - specific to integration and testing of the platform’s installation design.
  • Lead and mentor junior members providing direction with tasks and fostering a collaborative team environment.
  • Develops and maintains relationships up to managerial levels, representing the team’s technical needs and advocating for resources.
  • Lead technical reviews and provide guidance and mentoring to engineering team members.
  • Develop and review technical documentation, including ICDs, engineering reports, risk assessments, and technical briefings.
  • Drive requirements traceability, configuration management, lessons learned, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure designs and engineering activities comply with applicable MIL-STD, ISO 9001, DoD, and EMI/EMC requirements.
  • Support vehicle inspections, retrofit activities, field modifications, and customer technical engagements.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 6+ years of relevant systems engineering experience, preferably with vehicle-mounted communications or electronic systems.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership and experience working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience with system architecture, requirements management, integration, testing, and technical documentation.
  • Familiarity with tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, DOORS/Jama, and cable/harness design software.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer-facing skills.

title: Bioconjugation Process Development & Manufacturing Lead
description:
Telix Pharmaceuticals is a dynamic, fast-growing radiopharmaceutical company with offices in Australia (HQ), Belgium, Japan, Switzerland, and the United States. Our mission is to deliver on the promise of precision medicine through targeted radiation. At our core, we exist to create products that seek to improve the quality of life for people living with cancer and rare diseases. You will be supporting the international roll-out of our approved prostate cancer imaging agent and helping us to advance our portfolio of late clinical-stage products that address significant unmet need in oncology and rare diseases.

See Yourself at Telix

The Bioconjugation Process Development and Manufacturing Lead will provide technical leadership and hands-on execution for purification process development, technology transfer, process optimization, scale-up, and manufacturing support of bioconjugate programs. This role is responsible for developing and transferring purification and conjugation processes for proteins from development laboratories to GMP manufacturing environments.

The successful candidate will be an experienced process development and manufacturing scientist with expertise in chromatography-based purification platforms, process scale-up, and GMP manufacturing operations. The individual will independently design and execute laboratory studies, author development and technology transfer documentation, establish scalable manufacturing processes, and support manufacturing campaigns at internal facilities. This position requires significant hands-on experience operating, troubleshooting, and commissioning chromatography systems similar to ÄKTA Avant, ÄKTA Pure, and ÄKTA Pilot systems in both non-GMP and GMP environments.

Key Accountabilities

  • Design, execute, analyze, and document downstream process development studies, including chromatography, ultrafiltration/diafiltration, buffer exchange, impurity clearance purification activities.
  • Lead technology transfer, optimization, scale-up of purification processes for pre-conjugated and post-conjugated proteins from development laboratories to GMP manufacturing facilities.
  • Develop scalable purification processes from early-stage development through commercial manufacturing, leveraging Quality by Design (QbD) principles and process characterization approaches.
  • Provide hands-on operation, setup, troubleshooting, and execution of purification runs using ÄKTA Avant, ÄKTA Pure, and ÄKTA Pilot systems in both development and GMP manufacturing environments.
  • Support GMP manufacturing operations by performing or overseeing purification activities, troubleshooting process performance, investigating deviations, and implementing corrective actions.
  • Manage GMP bioconjugation activities while working with associated manufacturing and quality control teams.
  • Provide technical leadership for process scale-up activities including equipment fit assessments, process performance evaluation, facility readiness reviews, and manufacturing campaign support.

Education and Experience:

  • Science or engineering degree with minimum relevant experience as applicable: BS with 5 years of experience, MS with 3 years of experience, PhD with 2 years of experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in purification process development, purification process scale-up, or biologics manufacturing.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience developing, optimizing, and scaling chromatography-based purification processes for recombinant proteins, monoclonal antibodies, antibody fragments, fusion proteins, and/or bioconjugates.
  • Demonstrated experience transferring manufacturing processes from development laboratories into GMP manufacturing facilities.
  • Hands-on experience working in both non-GMP and GMP environments.
  • Experience supporting clinical and/or commercial biologics manufacturing campaigns.
  • Experience managing complex projects is a plus
  • Ability to work in radiation areas after appropriate safety training.

Technical Requirements

  • Extensive hands-on experience operating and configuring ÄKTA chromatography systems.
  • Strong understanding of purification process scale-up principles, control strategies, and manufacturing readiness.
  • Experience authoring development reports, technology transfer packages, protocols, manufacturing instructions.
  • Preferred: Knowledge of GMP requirements, quality systems, deviation management, change control, CAPA, and tech transfer best practices.
  • Preferred: Hands-on experience in bioconjugation process development, conjugation scale-up, conjugate purification, and manufacturing support.

Key Capabilities:

  • Inclusive mindset: Demonstrate an understanding and appreciation for diversity, and actively work to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected
  • Creativity and innovation: Possess a willingness to think outside the box and come up with unique and creative solutions to challenges
  • Commitment to excellence: Take pride in your work and consistently strive for excellence in everything you do
  • Results-oriented: Driven to achieve goals and objectives, with a strong focus on delivering measurable results
  • Ethical behavior: Act with integrity and demonstrate a commitment to ethical behavior in all interactions with colleagues and stakeholders
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment, able to adjust to changing priorities, and willing to take on new challenges
  • Strong communication skills: Able to communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at all levels, using clear and concise language
  • Collaboration: Work effectively as part of a team, actively sharing knowledge and expertise to achieve common goals
  • Resilience: Demonstrate the ability to bounce back from setbacks and persevere in the face of challenges

At Telix, we believe everyone counts, we strive to be extraordinary, and we pursue our goals with determination and integrity. You will be part of an engaged and supportive group of colleagues who all have a shared purpose: to help people with cancer and rare diseases live longer, better quality lives. Being a Telix employee means being a part of a unique, global, interdisciplinary team working to deliver what's next in precision medicine. We have hybrid and remote employees located all around the world. We offer competitive salaries, annual performance-based bonuses, an equity-based incentive program, generous vacation, paid wellness days and support for learning and development.

Telix Pharmaceuticals is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

title: Tooling Engineer
description:
SUMMARY:

The Tooling Engineer is responsible for interfacing between Spectrum Plastics, Minneapolis location and tooling suppliers to support a successful mold design, build, qualification, and release to production. This position will be accountable for tooling cost, quality, and delivery performance, and supplier management, and provide metrics to the management team on tool shop performance. In addition, this position will support the sales and engineering functions through Design for Manufacturability (DFM) analysis and technical tooling expertise. The ideal candidate possesses strong injection molding, tooling, material experience, and DFM knowledge to identify manufacturing risks to lead tool suppliers through tool design and build.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  1. Actively promote and drive a culture of safety within Spectrum Plastics Group.
  2. Responsible for tooling P&L, adherence to tool delivery dates and quality of work for all of Spectrum MN tooling transactions.
  3. Lead DFM reviews to optimize part designs for manufacturability, quality, cost, and tooling robustness. Provide technical guidance on gating strategy, venting, cooling, shrinkage, mold steel selection, and wear considerations.
  4. Ability to influence customer part designs through effective communication on recommendations.
  5. Lead tool design reviews and collaborate with suppliers, internal teams, and customers to resolve concerns and reduce tooling risk prior to tool build.
  6. Effectively measure and drive the reduction of tool lead times.
  7. Participate in and support the quoting and sales process. Responsible for tooling supplier selection and acquiring tooling quotes.
  8. Provide technical tooling expertise and support to all NPI and production sustaining teams.
  9. Identify continuous improvement efforts for outside tooling sources and provide feedback to management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Manage all facets of tool procurement including design and construction with tool suppliers, reducing the number of mold iterations and samples. Making sure the tooling is built correctly the first time to agreed upon standards. Take a lead position in driving new technologies with associate teams.
  2. Review customer CAD models and drawings to identify tooling and manufacturability risks and lead customer discussions regarding DFM recommendations and required part design modifications.
  3. Manage and report mold build and rework schedule to applicable internal team members, striving for on-time or early delivery.
  4. Provide engineering and manufacturing recommendations for new projects and quotations, improving quote capture rate.
  5. Provide technical support to Sales and both external and internal customers
  6. Collaborate on common tool design standards to be used across at Spectrum MN and other Spectrum injection molding locations.
  7. Establish and implement continuous improvements metrics for tooling suppliers and report to management.

description:

title: Exercise Coordinator
description:
RMC is seeking an Exercise Coordinator for a full-time hybrid position in Dahlgren, VA!

Are you ready to embark on a fulfilling and impactful career journey with RMC Global? We're in search of an exceptional Exercise Coordinator to become a part of our mission-driven team, dedicated to making a difference in the federal and commercial markets. At RMC, we're all about enhancing security for both our military and global commercial partners, offering an array of services such as Risk Management, Mission Assurance, and Cybersecurity.

Our team's well-being is paramount, and we reflect this commitment through our flexible work environment and exceptional company culture. By joining RMC, you become a key contributor to our mission – Assuring Tomorrow!

When you join RMC, you'll experience a range of benefits, including:

  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance plans fully covered for employees
    • Subsidized dependent health care coverage
  • Participation in our Annual Bonus Program
  • Life insurance policy equivalent to 1x your annual salary.
  • Company paid short and long-term disability
  • Cell phone reimbursement of $65 per month
  • 401(k) Plan with contributions
  • A 401(k) Safe Harbor Employer Contribution Program, which includes a 3% contribution

Position Summary:

The Exercise Coordinator supports NSWC, Dahlgren Division and U.S. Northern Command (NORTHCOM) by identifying military and federal exercises and wargames that allow Critical Infrastructure Defense Analytic Center (CIDAC) to advance its objectives and coordinate its planning and support for government-selected events. The Exercise Coordinator maintains an exercise support plan, contributes realistic critical infrastructure injects, highlights their dependencies, and includes mission assurance elements to scenarios and injects, recommends appropriate CIDAC participants for each event, and supports exercise execution and follow-up as directed by the government.


This position requires strong written and verbal skills and the ability to communicate technical and mission information across the NORTHCOM community and partner organizations. Strong project management, planning, evaluation, and risk management skills are essential to the identification, coordination, and integration of risk requirements into exercise scenarios. The Exercise Coordinator must support conferences, meetings, working groups, and exercises in-person and virtually at locations in the continental United States (CONUS) and outside the continental United States (OCONUS) in addition to travel to NSWC, Dahlgren Division two to three times per month.


Essential Functions:

  • Identify and assess NORTHCOM’s area of responsibility exercises and other Department of War (DoW) and federal agency exercises for alignment with CIDAC, Defense Critical Infrastructure (DCI), and mission assurance objectives.
  • Develop an exercise identification list with a clear rationale for recommended CIDAC participation; track Government decisions on which events CIDAC will support.
  • Prepare an exercise approach and maintain an integrated exercise support plan covering objectives, focus areas, scenarios, key participants, milestones, and selected support activities.
  • Maintain an up-to-date exercise calendar and points-of-contact list, including concept development, initial, mid, and final planning conferences; scenario and inject meetings; exercise dates; and after-action reviews.
  • Engage exercise planners and stakeholders while keeping government representatives informed of key events, decision points, schedule changes, and participation needs.
  • Support planning conferences and other planning activities for government-selected exercises; coordinate CIDAC inputs with the exercise planning team.
  • Develop technical inputs for scenarios and injects involving infrastructure, dependencies, threats, and risk that could realistically degrade or disrupt the exercise scenario, as directed.
  • Recommend which CIDAC personnel or capabilities should participate in each exercise based on its objectives, scenario, and planned activities.
  • Provide on-site or remote support during selected exercise events, as directed, and document observations and outcomes needed for follow-up.
  • Produce and update required support documents, meeting minutes, and after-action reports within applicable contract timelines and after government review.
  • Coordinate and conduct recurring travel to planning conferences, meetings, and selected exercises across CONUS as required.

Competencies:

  • Exercise and wargaming planning: Understands exercise life cycles, planning conferences, scenarios, injects, player roles, execution, and after-action processes.
  • Strategic judgment: Connects exercise objectives and scenarios to CIDAC priorities and provides a defensible rationale for participation.
  • Technical Translation: Can apply a working knowledge of critical infrastructure protection, infrastructure dependencies, risk, and mission assurance to realistic exercise content.
  • Coordination and relationships: Builds productive connections with exercise planners, Government stakeholders, and participating organizations.
  • Organization and follow-through: Maintains accurate schedules, updated contact lists, plans, records, and deliverables across multiple exercises.
  • Communication: Produces clear planning products and briefings, and communicates changes and recommendations promptly.

title: Director, Supplier Relations APAC
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Director, Supplier Relations APAC

About the job

Twilio is seeking an experienced Director, Supplier Relations to execute our supply strategy, manage regional vendor and carrier partnerships, and lead a team of supplier relations specialists across Asia-Pacific (APAC). In this role, you will translate regional connectivity strategy into operational execution, optimizing COGS, route quality, and direct supplier partnerships. Working closely with cross-functional partners in Sales, Product, Legal, and Operations, you will ensure Twilio's infrastructure reliably aligns with rapid enterprise growth across diverse APAC markets.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership & Development: Direct, mentor, and manage a team of supplier relations specialists and analysts, fostering operational excellence and regional alignment across APAC.
  • Supplier Procurement & Negotiations: Lead commercial negotiations with regional telecommunications carriers, messaging aggregators, and OTT suppliers to secure competitive unit economics (COGS) and expand direct connectivity.
  • GTM & Product Alignment: Partner with APAC Sales and Product teams to analyze market demand, forecast capacity needs, and support localized go-to-market strategies for key growth countries.
  • Route Quality & Analytics: Continuously monitor supplier performance, route latency, delivery success rates, and margins, using data-driven insights to optimize traffic allocation.
  • Regulatory & Compliance Execution: Operationalize regional telecommunications mandates, local sender ID registries, and anti-spam regulations across APAC markets in coordination with Legal and Regulatory teams.
  • Operational Escalations: Serve as the primary escalation point for supplier SLA breaches, network disruptions, and service degradations to maintain high platform uptime.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Minimum of 7 years in the telecommunications or CPaaS industry, with at least 3 years in a leadership or senior supplier/carrier management role.
  • Deep understanding of APAC telecommunications ecosystems, messaging aggregators, and regional market dynamics.
  • Proven track record of negotiating commercial supplier agreements and driving unit economics (COGS) optimization.
  • Experience collaborating with Sales, Product, and Operations to translate revenue demand into supplier capacity.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience leveraging performance metrics and data tools for route optimization.

Desired:

  • Professional fluency in English and an additional APAC language (e.g., Japanese, Mandarin, or Bahasa).
  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Business, or a related field.
  • Technical understanding of core communications protocols and standards (e.g., SMPP, SIP, REST APIs, A2P/P2P messaging).

Location

  1. This role will be remote based in key APAC locations (Australia or Japan).

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 20% to 25% regional travel anticipated for supplier engagements and internal team alignment.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. title: Sr. Enterprise Systems Engineer
description:
What You'll Do

Avalara's Marketing Technology team is looking for a senior engineer to own the backbone that turns every lead into a routed, enriched record: intake, validation, enrichment, and routing services, plus the Personalization Engine that powers sales collateral. Reporting into our Marketing technology IT teams, you'll be the technical authority for our leads engineering services team. Unlike backend roles buried in one product team, you'll own architecture end to end across AWS, giving you direct influence on design reviews and runway planning, not just ticket execution.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

Most days you're building and hardening AWS serverless services (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS/SNS) that validate, enrich, and route leads from forms, paid social, events, and list uploads into Salesforce and Marketo. You'll design and evolve data models in DynamoDB and Snowflake, tune conversion-tracking flows across Google, Floodlight, LinkedIn/Meta CAPI, and troubleshoot the Personalization Engine's webhook and draft-generation pipeline with Outreach/ALFA. Along with evaluation and integration of AI-powered capabilities into lead enrichment and personalization pipelines, partnering with the BSA and platform teams to define technical requirements, owning prompt versioning, token budgeting, and output validation. You'll also meet with Demand Gen, SDR leadership, and RevOps to translate technical trade-offs into decisions they can act on, and you'll write the Terraform, AWS infrastructure code and monitoring/alerting that keep the whole system secure and observable.


What You'll Need to be Successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years engineering in MarTech/enterprise systems, including hands-on AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, CloudWatch) and Terraform/IaC.
  • Proven database design across DynamoDB (keys/indexes/TTL/state) and analytics models in Snowflake; strong SQL.
  • Integration depth with Salesforce, Marketo, and identity/consent-aware data flows; resilient API patterns and error handling.
  • Experience owning high-throughput pipelines (validation, enrichment, dedupe, reprocessing) and operational SLIs/SLOs.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication; able to present trade-offs and lead technical breakdowns for non-engineering audiences.
  • Conversion tracking (Google/Floodlight/Meta/LinkedIn) and attribution data propagation across web, RMS/AvaForm, and backend.
  • Security-by-design in AWS (KMS, least-privilege IAM, secret rotation, privacy constraints).

AI

  • Experience building or integrating AI/ML-adjacent services (LLM APIs, vector pipelines, or AI-driven enrichment/personalization tools) into production serverless architectures.

  • Active use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) as a daily engineering practice, mentoring Junior developers in these tools.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.


What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Native Mobile
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Native Mobile to join the App Infra team within the Consumer & Business group. This team is executing a greenfield rewrite of Coinbase's retail mobile app from React Native to native Swift and Kotlin, using AI-assisted code generation to deliver a dramatically faster, higher-quality experience for millions of customers. You'll bring deep iOS or Android expertise to build core app surfaces, contribute to the design of Coinbase’s native mobile agentic workflow, and contribute to the foundation of Coinbase’s future mobile platform as product teams onboard to the native codebase.

What you'll do:

  • Own the development of core app surfaces in Swift and Kotlin, translating existing React Native flows into performant native implementations that meet strict performance budgets, and setting the project-level quality bar through code and design reviews.

Job# P78585

Required Skills and Experience:

title: PolySheet Sales Engineer
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The PolySheet Technical Sales Engineer supports distributors, dealers, fabricators/OEMs, and direct end-use manufacturers in the effective use of Tangent’s HDPE PolySheet product line, used across furniture, outdoor kitchens, marine components, playgrounds, and industrial food equipment applications. This role combines technical expertise, customer engagement, and training development, serving as a key bridge between the market and Tangent’s Engineering team — partnering with customers across the channel on design and fabrication solutions, identifying the best applications for Tangent’s materials, and delivering training that ensures customer success. This is a remote, field-based role requiring up to 75% travel.


ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Serve as the primary technical resource for distributors, dealers, fabricators/OEMs, and direct end-use manufacturers on PolySheet products.

• Act as the bridge between the market and Engineering, representing field feedback, performance challenges, and customer needs to Engineering, and communicating engineering and product decisions back out to the channel.

• Collaborate with customers on design and fabrication solutions, including design recommendations, fabrication and machining techniques, and material/grade selection for applications such as furniture, outdoor kitchens, marine components, playgrounds, and industrial food equipment.

• Support fabricators and OEMs with fabrication best practices, tooling and machining guidance, and jobsite or production troubleshooting.

• Support new product launches by training distributors, dealers, fabricators, and end-use manufacturers on what changed, why, and how it affects specification or fabrication.

• Investigate and help resolve field and production challenges in coordination with Engineering, Production, and Quality.

• Support code, regulatory, and industry compliance documentation relevant to PolySheet’s end markets (e.g., NSF/food-contact requirements, marine-grade standards, playground safety standards) for customers, specifiers, and regulatory contacts.

• Develop training documents, manuals, and technical resources to support distributor, dealer, fabricator, and end-user education.

• Create and deliver presentations, in person and virtual, to train distributor, dealer, and fabricator networks on best practices and product line differences.

• Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, technical support requests, and solutions provided.

• Gather field and channel feedback and communicate insights to Product, Engineering, and R&D teams to support continuous improvement.

• Represent the company at industry trade shows, dealer events, and technical workshops.

title: Senior Enterprise Sourcing Specialist
description:
About CharterUP. CharterUP is transforming the $450+ billion group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers to thousands of bus operators nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

About the Role

Title: Senior Enterprise Sourcing Specialist

Reports to: Director of Enterprise Sourcing

Location: Remote (must reside in one of CharterUP's approved states — see below)

CharterUP is seeking a data-driven, execution-focused Senior Enterprise Sourcing Specialist to support the design, sourcing, and costing of transportation solutions for some of our largest and most complex Enterprise opportunities.

Enterprise Sourcing serves as the procurement and supply strategy function supporting CharterUP’s Enterprise business. The team partners closely with Sales and Operations to understand customer requirements, assess operational feasibility, develop sourcing strategies, identify the right operator partners, and build accurate and competitive program costs.

This role goes well beyond collecting quotes. Enterprise opportunities can vary significantly in size, geography, complexity, and operating requirements. The Senior Enterprise Sourcing Specialist must be able to understand the full scope of an opportunity, identify potential challenges, evaluate different supply solutions, and make sound recommendations that balance cost, operational capability, service quality, and risk.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and commercial skills with operational thinking, negotiation ability, and relationship-building. Transportation or mobility experience is strongly preferred, but candidates with relevant strategic sourcing or procurement experience in complex service environments may also be successful.

What You’ll Do

  • Own sourcing for complex Enterprise opportunities across recurring shuttle programs, major events, transit programs, and other large-scale or time-sensitive transportation engagements.
  • Understand and evaluate transportation scopes to determine operational requirements, sourcing needs, potential constraints, and overall feasibility.
  • Develop accurate and comprehensive program cost models based on the full operational scope and requirements of each opportunity.
  • Develop sourcing strategies for complex opportunities, identifying solutions that balance cost, operational feasibility, service quality, capacity, and client requirements.
  • Identify and evaluate transportation operators based on pricing, geography, capabilities, capacity, service history, scalability, and overall fit for the opportunity.
  • Lead commercial negotiations with operator partners to secure competitive pricing and terms while protecting CharterUP’s operational and service requirements.
  • Solve complex supply challenges where traditional sourcing approaches may not be sufficient, using strong judgment and creative problem-solving to develop executable solutions.
  • Build and maintain strong operator relationships that strengthen CharterUP’s access to high-quality transportation supply and support long-term Enterprise growth.
  • Partner closely with Enterprise Sales throughout the sales and RFP process, providing sourcing strategy, program costs, feasibility assessments, market intelligence, and other inputs needed to develop competitive proposals.
  • Partner with Enterprise Operations to ensure effective handoffs when opportunities convert into active programs, clearly communicating operator commitments, pricing, assumptions, risks, and key requirements.
  • Support significant operator or commercial escalations after launch when additional sourcing expertise or operator relationship support is needed.
  • Maintain accurate sourcing, pricing, operator, and opportunity information within CharterUP’s systems and ensure sourcing activity is well documented.
  • Use data and market intelligence to improve sourcing effectiveness, turnaround time, cost competitiveness, operator selection, and capacity coverage.
  • Identify emerging supply needs, market constraints, and opportunities to strengthen CharterUP’s transportation network as the Enterprise business continues to grow.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in transportation, mobility, logistics, strategic sourcing, procurement, vendor management, or another relevant operational environment.
  • Transportation industry experience is strongly preferred, particularly within passenger transportation, shuttle, transit, motorcoach, mobility, or other complex transportation operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex business or operational requirements and translate them into sourcing strategies and accurate cost models.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets and comfort working with pricing, operational, and market data.
  • Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills with experience negotiating pricing, terms, or service agreements with suppliers or vendors.
  • Ability to evaluate suppliers based on a combination of cost, capability, quality, capacity, and operational fit rather than price alone.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and confidence working directly with operator partners, business owners, and senior leaders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to develop creative solutions when traditional sourcing options are limited.
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to independently manage multiple sourcing opportunities with competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where scopes may evolve, information may be incomplete, and timelines may be compressed.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate costs, assumptions, risks, and recommendations across Sales, Operations, and leadership.
  • High degree of ownership, urgency, judgment, and attention to detail.

Travel

  • Occasional travel to client locations to assist in project launches and operations.
  • Occasional travel for team onsite meetings.
  • Estimated Travel: 5%-10%

Travel needs may change based on company needs.



Recruiting Process

  • Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview
  • Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview
  • Step 3 - Video call: VP of Ent OPs interview
  • Step 4 - Casey Study - Case study presentation
  • Step 5 - Offer & Background Check
  • Welcome aboard!

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, Miami, and Denver as we grow our global team.

  • Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

title: Head of Data Management - Managing Director (NY)
description:
Position Title: Head of Data Management - Managing Director (NY)

Entity: KBRA Holdings, LLC

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: New York, New York, United States

Summary/Overview:

KBRA is seeking a senior leader to head our Data Management organization. Based in New York and reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this individual will be responsible for defining and executing KBRA's enterprise data management strategy, leading Data Operations, advancing data governance and quality, and helping unlock the commercial value of KBRA's data assets.

The role will work across analytical, business, product, and technology teams to establish how KBRA's data is organized, governed, curated, maintained, and made available for internal and external use. This is a highly visible leadership position requiring both strategic thinking and a willingness to engage directly in the details.

About the Job:

  • The Head of Data Management will establish the operating model, standards, and capabilities necessary to manage KBRA's data as a strategic enterprise asset.
  • You will lead the Data Operations organization and oversee disciplines including data stewardship, master and reference data management, taxonomy and ontology development, data quality, and data-provider management.
  • Working closely with Engineering and Product, you will help establish scalable data models, standards, processes, and technology capabilities that make KBRA's data easier to discover, integrate, govern, and use.
  • You will also partner with business leadership to identify opportunities to package and commercialize KBRA's proprietary data assets and to ensure those assets are supported by appropriate governance, quality, and operational processes.

What You'll Do:

  • Define and execute KBRA's enterprise data management strategy and operating model.
  • Lead and develop the Data Operations organization, including data stewardship, master/reference data management, data quality, taxonomy, and related disciplines.
  • Manage day-to-day operational delivery, service levels, controls, escalation and capacity planning.
  • Establish standards for the organization, classification, definition, ownership, and lifecycle management of KBRA data.
  • Continue to mature KBRA’s data governance and data quality programs by establishing measurable standards for accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and exception management.
  • Establish and maintain an enterprise data-domain model, including data owners, stewards, authoritative sources, definitions, quality and lifecycle. Lead the development of taxonomies, ontologies, common definitions, and canonical data concepts across KBRA.
  • Partner with Engineering and Product on data architecture, data catalog/glossary development, metadata management, lineage, integration standards, and platforms supporting enterprise data management.
  • Ensure ratings-related data management processes, controls, lineage, and documentation meet applicable regulatory and audit expectations.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact for regulators, auditors, and other stakeholders on matters related to ratings data management and operations.
  • Partner with business leaders to identify, evaluate, and develop opportunities to commercialize KBRA's proprietary data assets.
  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard third-party data providers that improve the quality, coverage, efficiency, or automation of KBRA's data processes.
  • Evaluate and implement technology that automates and augments data ingestion, curation, matching, enrichment, stewardship, and quality management.
  • Establish KPIs and operating metrics for data quality, operational performance, stewardship, and data-management effectiveness.
  • Ensure KBRA's data assets are discoverable, well-defined, governed, traceable, and of sufficient quality to support artificial intelligence, machine learning, semantic search, advanced analytics, and other emerging data-driven capabilities.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing data management organization capable of scaling with KBRA's growth.
  • Participate as a member of the Technology Leadership Team and contribute to KBRA's broader technology, product, and data strategy.
  • Establish and oversee change governance for critical data definitions, taxonomies, reference data, identifiers, and business rules, including impact assessment, review, approval, documentation, and communication of changes.
  • Lead data-governance forums and cross-functional data decisions/escalations.

About You:

  • You are an entrepreneurial and pragmatic leader who views data as both an operational capability and a strategic business asset.
  • You can establish a long-term vision while also working through complex implementation details. You are comfortable operating across business, analytical, product, engineering, and regulatory stakeholders and can translate between those audiences.
  • You are an effective communicator who can clearly articulate a data strategy, build organizational alignment around it, and lead teams through significant change.

You Will Be Successful in This Role If You Have:

  • Bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 15+ years of experience in data management, data strategy, data operations, data governance, or related disciplines.
  • Significant leadership experience building and managing data teams and capabilities.
  • Experience within financial services, capital markets, ratings, financial data, or another data-intensive industry.
  • Experience operating within a regulated environment and working with risk, compliance, audit, or regulatory stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience establishing enterprise data governance, stewardship, and data quality programs.
  • Experience with master data management, reference data, metadata management, taxonomy/ontology management, or data quality platforms.
  • Experience developing data operating models, standards, policies, and ownership frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of modern data platforms, integration patterns, data lineage, and data lifecycle management.
  • Experience evaluating and managing third-party data providers and data licensing relationships.
  • Experience identifying or developing opportunities to commercialize data products or proprietary datasets.
  • Demonstrated experience building or materially transforming an enterprise data-management capability.
  • Proven ability to build strong relationships with executives, analytical teams, product teams, engineers, customers, and external partners.
  • Ability to translate enterprise objectives into a clear, executable data strategy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor communication to senior executives, analytical professionals, regulators, and technical teams.
  • Experience preparing enterprise data for artificial intelligence, machine learning, semantic search, or other advanced analytical use cases is a plus.

Salary Range:

The anticipated annual base salary range for this full-time position is $225,000 to $300,000. Offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience, skills, geography, and other job-related factors.

Benefits:

  • A hybrid work schedule (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday in the office)
  • Competitive benefits and paid time off
  • Paid family and disability leave
  • 401(k) plan, including employer match (100% vested)
  • Educational and professional development financial assistance
  • Employee referral bonus program

title: Summer Internship 2026/27: Mānuka Honey and Modern Gut Health
description:
Please Note: This opportunity is open exclusively to students currently studying at, or have recently completed (within 12 months), a qualification at NZQA Level 6–10 from a New Zealand tertiary institution.



At Comvita we embrace the science of nature to support natural health and wellbeing, and to build global resilience. Our vision and aspiration to leave the world in a better place is captured in our Harmony Plan, and we are proud to be B-Corp accredited.


We believe in the power and wisdom of bees, and the idea of “One Hive”, where belonging makes each of us stronger. Our people are empowered to generate insight and take action on behalf of future generations and in the spirit of Kaitiakitanga. Paengaroa, where it all started, is the home of Comvita and our Market Support Centre. Our Apiaries team is based around New Zealand, and our hive extends to Australia, Greater China, Japan, Korea, South-east Asia, and the USA. We are proud to share our premium, immunity-supporting products with the world, and to help leave it in a better place.



About the Internship

This internship would suit 2nd- or 3rd-year students in biomedical science, health science, nutrition, microbiology, bioinformatics, data science, or a related discipline.


Modern health-maintenance and lifestyle medications are reshaping the gut-health category and are associated with a recognized cluster of gastrointestinal side effects affecting a rapidly growing user base. This project will investigate which disturbances may be mechanistically addressable by known Mānuka honey bioactivities, and where Mānuka honey could fit within the evolving category. This project will generate new knowledge through an integrated evidence synthesis, a computational cross-analysis of published gut datasets, and a consumer-facing category positioning framework.


The internship will be based in Paengaora.


Why choose our Internship?

  • We are a living wage employer and our internship pays $29.90 per hour.
  • Market leading, premium, global natural health brand founded in New Zealand
  • A proud BCorp accredited business
  • Excellent onboarding programme to experience different stages of our end-to-end supply chain.


Learn more about our Harmony Plan:

    Our internships are for 400 hours of work over your university summer break.

    Start/finish dates will be set to fit around your university semester dates, but typically start mid-late November through until the end of February. (NOTE: Our business shuts down for a couple of weeks over Christmas so there will be a break in the middle of your placement over Christmas/ New Year's).


    Ready to apply?

    If you are looking for an Internship opportunity with a global team who share a passion for health and nature, we would love to hear from you - please apply with your cover letter detailing why you are interested in and suitable for this project as well as your CV.


    Note: We kindly ask that you submit a cover letter written in your own words, as we are already quite familiar with the tone and structure of AI-generated letters. After all, we are looking to hire a person, not AI, and getting a sense of who you are really matters to us. Give us something only a real human (like you!) could write.

    Comvita is committed to upholding the rights of young workers and ensuring that child labour has no place in our operations or supply chain. We do not employ individuals under the age of 18 and strictly prohibit anyone under 18 from performing work that may involve hazardous conditions or materials.


    We do not tolerate the use of child labour or forced labour in any part of our business or among our suppliers. No child is to be involved in the production of our products or in the provision of materials or services to Comvita.

    This commitment reflects our core values and our responsibility to support safe, fair, and ethical working conditions across all aspects of our business.

We welcome diversity of people, ideas, talents and experiences. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us so we can support you through your recruitment journey.

title: Electrical Engineering Team Lead
description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world’s best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Electrical Engineering Team Lead

As the Team Lead for the Electrical Engineering Team, you will play a critical role in building and leading a team of engineers that own the compute, networking, and power distribution systems within our spacecraft. You’ll support the team in pushing the boundary of what is possible in a geo-synchronous spacecraft design and enable performance in space that has not been realized to date.
