  • Directly manage and grow a team of junior and senior electrical engineers
  • Collaborate with a broad and multidisciplinary team to define the spacecraft compute, networking, and power distribution requirements and architectures
  • Oversee the design, build, and implementation of our in-house hardware and systems
  • Manage a detailed schedule to ensure that our hardware development is in sync with the overall program schedule
  • Drive hardware design, specification, component selection, circuit board design, implementation, verification, board bring-up, and debugging
  • Own the technical relationship with third-party component suppliers to ensure our vendors provide robust and performant solutions
  • Support in recruiting, interviewing, and hiring additional teammates to our rapidly-growing team
  • Support the production and mission operations teams on the build and in-flight use of our component hardware
  • Drive the growth of the avionics components team through recruiting, interviewing, and hiring additional teammates to our rapidly-expanding team

Requirements

  • B.S. or higher in electrical or computer engineering, or similar technical degree
  • 5+ years of professional experience with fast-paced product design cycles
  • 5+ years of board level experience designing electronics hardware from concept through to production
  • A passion for hardware development & fostering teamwork in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to design, build, and test hardware, hands-on, from scratch
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage teams of engineers and communicate clearly with other disciplines
  • Strong analog/mixed-signal circuit design skills
  • US Citizenship or Green Card

Bonus

  • 5+ years of experience with designing and implementing signal conditioning, sensors, electro-mechanical actuators, power switches, embedded computers, or such hardware.
  • Experience with FPGAs, Microcontrollers, and communication schemes (RS-485, SPI, Ethernet, I2C)
  • Strong understanding of C, C++, or Python
  • Radiation effects knowledge
  • Environmental test experience

Base pay is just one component of Astranis’s total rewards package. Your compensation also includes a significant equity package via incentive stock options, high-quality company-subsidized healthcare, disability and life insurance, 401(k) retirement planning, flexible PTO, and free on-site catered meals.

title: Engineering Technician I/II/III
description:
CITY OF BISHOP
PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT
Engineering Technician I / II / III

The City of Bishop Public Works Department is recruiting for the position of Engineering Technician I / II / III.

This position supports the planning, development, and delivery of small- to medium-scale public works projects, with a focus on road maintenance, permit administration, procurement, and consultant coordination. The position performs both technical and administrative work, including infrastructure condition assessment, quantity takeoffs, cost estimating, construction bid document preparation, and coordination with consultants and contractors. This role increases the department’s capacity to deliver pavement maintenance and minor capital improvement projects with limited staff resources.


Assignment level and duties will vary depending on qualifications and departmental needs. Higher classifications may include greater independence in project delivery, grant management, or contract oversight.


Any questions regarding position or application process please contact, Jana Currie at jcurrie@cityofbishop.ca.gov. or 760-873-5863 ext. 122. EOE


Application Deadline:

November 2nd, 2026 @ 4:00pm

APPLICATION PROCESS:

  1. Submit Application.
  2. Application Review. Applicants who meet the minimum requirements may be asked to take a written test.
  3. Applicants who qualify will be notified via email for interview date & time.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

  • The annual salary range for this full-time non-exempt position is $56,700 to $94,680.
  • CalPERS Retirement:
    • 2% at 60 for Classic members. City pays both Employer and Employee contribution.
    • 2% at 62 for PEPRA members. City pays the employer contribution only.
  • Insurance: The City pays the insurance premium for employee and dependent health coverage up to a maximum of 90% of PERS Platinum Basic Plan.
  • Vision and Dental coverage are covered at 100% by employer.
  • A retiree health insurance benefit is available depending upon length of service.
  • The City provides both life insurance, as well as accidental death and disability coverage.
  • Deferred Compensation: The City will match employee contributions up to 2% of annual salary.
  • Vacation, Sick and Holiday Leave.


Job Description

DEFINITION

This position supports the planning, development, and delivery of small- to medium-scale public works projects, with a focus on road maintenance, permit administration, procurement, and consultant coordination. The position performs both technical and administrative work, including infrastructure condition assessment, quantity takeoffs, cost estimating, construction bid document preparation, and coordination with consultants and contractors. This role increases the department’s capacity to deliver pavement maintenance and minor capital improvement projects with limited staff resources.


Assignment level and duties will vary depending on qualifications and departmental needs. Higher classifications may include greater independence in project delivery, grant management, or contract oversight.


SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED

  • Receives general supervision from Public Works Director


EXAMPLE OF DUTIES

Duties may include, but are not limited to, the following:

Project Planning and Delivery

  • Use pavement condition data to prioritize road and sidewalk maintenance projects.
  • Conduct field reviews to verify conditions and define project scopes.
  • Prepare cost estimates, quantities, and budgets for maintenance-level construction projects (e.g., overlays, slurry, striping), under the direction of the Director.
  • Develop bid packages, including technical specifications, maps, and contract documents.
  • Support consultants by providing field data, record drawings, and project background; assist in preparing construction bid documents for Director review.

Permit and Right-of-Way Administration

  • Manage public works-related permits, including encroachment permits, water fill stem agreements, and grading permits.
  • Coordinate application intake, fee processing, plan review, field inspection, and closeout.
  • Coordinate with property owners to resolve private encroachments (e.g., fences, landscaping) within the public right-of-way.
  • Interpret right-of-way boundaries using maps or deeds and maintain related records.

Procurement and Contract Support

  • Prepare scopes and solicit quotes for materials, equipment, and services in accordance with City purchasing policies.
  • Assist with writing technical specifications and developing project-specific bid documents.
  • Maintain up-to-date field documentation, as-built markups, and technical files using Laserfiche and GIS platforms.

Capital Improvement and Grant Coordination

  • Support development of capital project documentation and updates at the direction of the Director.
  • Support grant applications, obligation tracking, and reimbursement requests for eligible projects.

Technical Program Support

  • Assist with planning and conducting pre-bid site visits to review project conditions and answer contractor questions
  • Review contractor work in the field for compliance with City standards.
  • Inspect completed concrete, asphalt, and drainage improvements; prepare punch lists and verify quantities.
  • Assist with field adjustments, plan clarifications, and construction documentation.
  • Respond to public inquiries and service complaints.
  • Updates and maintains Public Works website as needed.
  • Assist with maintaining Public Works records in compliance with the records retention policy.

QUALIFICATIONS

The Public Works Engineering Technician possesses the following qualifications or their equivalent:

Knowledge of:

  • Public works construction methods, materials, and field practices
  • Basic civil engineering concepts and terminology related to roadways, sidewalks, and utilities
  • Public agency contracting and procurement processes
  • Standard plans, specifications, and right-of-way documentation
  • Regulatory requirements related to encroachment, grading, and permitting
  • Standard construction specifications such as Caltrans Standard Plans and Greenbook standards

Skills in:

  • Preparing cost estimates, scopes of work, and bid packages
  • Organizing and maintaining permit and project records
  • Using software such as Microsoft Word, Excel, GIS, and document management platforms (e.g., Laserfiche)
  • Communicating clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing
  • Managing time and multiple tasks effectively under minimal supervision
  • Reviewing field conditions and verifying contractor compliance with specifications

Ability to:

  • Read and interpret engineering plans, technical drawings, and maps
  • Conduct field reviews and document infrastructure conditions accurately
  • Coordinate with contractors, consultants, property owners, and other departments
  • Understand and apply City policies, procedures, and applicable codes
  • Track project deadlines, deliverables, and financial information
  • Prepare clear staff reports, notices, correspondence, and summaries
  • Identify field conditions and recommend appropriate technical solutions
  • Apply engineering standards to field construction and document required changes

EXPERIENCE AND TRAINING GUIDELINES

Any combination of experience and training that would provide the required knowledge, skills, and abilities is qualifying. A typical way to obtain the knowledge, skills, and abilities would be:

Education and Experience

  • For Technician I: No work experience in field is required; Associate degree in civil engineering technology, construction management, public administration, or a related field required.
  • For Technician II: Requirements for Technician I plus, One (1) year of experience in public works, engineering, or construction support.
  • For Technician III: Requirements for Technician I and II plus, Two (2) or more years of experience in public works project delivery, including bid package preparation and field oversight.
  • Experience preparing cost estimates and bid packages is highly desirable.
  • Bachelor’s degree may substitute for one year of experience.

Licenses and Certifications

  • Valid California Class C Driver’s License required.
  • Certifications in public procurement, GIS, or project management are desirable but not required.

TOOLS AND EQUIPMENT USED

  • Office equipment: Desktop computer, printer, scanner, telephone, mobile devices
  • Software: Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook), Adobe Acrobat, GIS software, Laserfiche, asset management or permitting platforms.
  • Field tools: Tape measure, digital camera, tablet or GPS unit, safety equipment (e.g., vest, hard hat)
  • Vehicles: City vehicle for field site visits, inspections, and project coordination

PHYSICAL, MENTAL AND EMOTIONAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee must be physically able to sit for extended periods of time at a desk writing, talking on the phone, checking emails, or inputting data on a computer in a climate-controlled office under artificial lighting, and attending both on and off-site meetings.

The employee must occasionally walk over uneven terrain, stand for extended periods during inspections, and wear appropriate safety gear while visiting active or future project sites.

The employee must have the ability to develop and maintain cooperative working relationships; remain composed and respond appropriately to difficult situations; recognize emotionally charged issues or problems, cope effectively with various responses and apply sound judgment in problem solving.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee works in a typical office setting with constant temperatures. The employee occasionally works in outside weather conditions. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate.

SELECTION GUIDELINES

Formal application, rating of education and experience; oral interview and reference checks; job related tests as well as a polygraph examination may be required.

The duties listed above are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or a logical assignment to the position.

The job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and employee and is subject to change by the employer as the needs of the employer and requirements of the job change.

title: Maintenance Administrator
description:
Reporting to the Head of Operations, the Maintenance Administrator is primarily responsible for working alongside all functions across our ROI business, ensuring to deliver on high levels of customer service. The role involves working closely with fleet maintenance, supporting vehicle testing, vehicle road taxing and all other administrative duties surrounding vehicle maintenance. These tasks include, but are not limited to supporting system updates, generating reports, processing data, data uploads, problem solving, assisting with customer enquiries and issue resolution.

Within this role, you will provide high quality and administrative support, working collaboratively with our fleet maintenance team, including our office in NI. There is a key focus on product knowledge, customer service excellence and operational efficiency.

Key Duties

  • Work collaboratively with all teams to support the business and our customers

  • Demonstrate competency in the use of computers and out systems with a familiarity with Microsoft Outlook and an ability to become familiar with and learn how to use and navigate all RVS systems

Other Operational Duties

  • Develop and maintain current knowledge and understanding of all products and services provided by the company and maintaining, at all times, a professional and ethical relationship with customers when representing the company
  • Review and report any feedback that may impact on efficiencies for tasks within the Customer Operations role and help to develop strategies / process improvements to address concerns
  • Highlight and help to implement any change initiatives / projects within the ROI office
  • Any other duties that may be provided by management from time to time
  • Office administration and Customer Service experience an advantage
  • Customer driven with strong communication and interpersonal skills in order to build and maintain relationships
  • Team player, actively participating in shared objectives and has enthusiasm and commitment to work towards team goals
  • Ability to think and take initiative, identify & implement efficiencies and the confidence to make appropriate decisions when required
  • Good time management skills, managing fluctuating workloads & prioritisation of daily tasks
  • Ability to see issues through to completion and work to deadlines
  • Adopt a professional approach, demonstrating high standards of performance, constantly striving to improve efficiencies, achieving business objectives.
  • Must be flexible and able to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Expert in Microsoft Office, outlook, word and excel

title: AI Technical Lead, Amazon Bedrock
company: NTT DATA, Europe & LATAM, Branch in USA, Inc.
description:
Location: 100% remote, seeking candidates located in LATAM.

Contract Length: 1 year, with potential for extension.

Contract Rate: $25-30 per hour in USD. Final rate will be determined based on relevant experience and overall fit for the position.

NTT DATA is seeking a AI Technical Lead, Amazon Bedrock to design and implement AI-agent capabilities for Customer Service and Contact Center use cases as part of a broader Amazon Connect transformation program. This hands-on technical leadership role will span Generative AI architecture, agentic workflows, RAG, prompt and context engineering, model evaluation, guardrails, and enterprise integrations. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering with practical LLM expertise, can determine when deterministic software, retrieval, workflows, or LLM reasoning are most appropriate, and can take solutions from prototype through safe, production-ready deployment.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Generative AI and AI-agent solutions for Customer Service and Contact Center scenarios.
  • Design prompts, system instructions, context strategies, tool-calling patterns, and agent workflows.
  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using enterprise knowledge sources.
  • Integrate AI agents with APIs, databases, business applications, knowledge repositories, and external tools.
  • Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models for different use cases, balancing quality, latency, cost, and operational constraints.
  • Design mechanisms to improve grounding, reduce hallucinations, and manage unsupported or out-of-scope requests.
  • Implement guardrails, content controls, PII protection, and safety mechanisms appropriate for enterprise use.
  • Design conversational context, session state, memory, fallback, and human-escalation patterns.
  • Define observability, tracing, quality metrics, and operational monitoring for AI-agent behavior.
  • Optimize prompts, retrieval strategies, model configuration, token consumption, latency, and cost.
  • Work with AI Output Testing Engineers to create evaluation datasets, regression suites, and release quality thresholds.
  • Support AI governance and Responsible AI requirements by translating policy expectations into technical controls.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, and production support.

Required Experience:

  • 10+ year of relevant technical experience including delivering Generative AI / LLM-based applications in enterprise environments.
  • 2+ years of experience with Amazon Bedrock
  • Strong software engineering experience, preferably using Python and/or TypeScript.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, semantic search, and tool/function calling.
  • Experience designing or implementing AI agents and multi-step agentic workflows.
  • Experience integrating LLM solutions with REST APIs, enterprise applications, databases, and knowledge sources.
  • Strong understanding of hallucination mitigation, grounding, prompt injection, jailbreak prevention, content filtering, and context-window management.
  • Experience evaluating model and agent outputs using automated and human evaluation approaches.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and production software delivery practices.
  • Ability to communicate complex AI concepts clearly to architects, developers, product teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Previous experience integrating Generative AI capabilities with Amazon Connect or other enterprise Contact Center platforms.
  • Experience with Amazon Q in Connect, agent-assist, knowledge-assistance, or customer-support AI use cases.
  • Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks.

Education & Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

Required Equipment: This role requires the use of a personal laptop. Candidates must be comfortable with company security software and device management tools being installed on their laptop as part of the onboarding process and for the duration of the engagement.

title: Chemical Engineer
description:
For more than three decades, Design West Technologies Inc. has served as a trusted partner to the Department of War (DoW), delivering mission-critical design engineering and rugged manufacturing solutions that protect our nation's warfighters. As we enter our next chapter, we are blending our deep-rooted defense heritage with a start-up culture designed to take advantage of the current DoW landscape. Operating out of our facility in Tustin, CA, we are seeking an experienced, forward-thinking Chemical Engineer to support for our R&D activities for sensor manufacturing, optimization, prototype delivery, and new sensor development. This role will play a key part in fabricating sensors, prepare and optimize formulations, characterize sensor performance, and conduct simulant and TIC testing.

POSITION SUMMARY

As a Chemical Engineer, you will be a key partner in supporting our R&D activities and collaborating closely with electrical and mechanical engineering teams and, as applicable, develop aerosol collectors. You will be supporting the preparation of technical deliverables and materials for USG test events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Support R&D activities related to sensor manufacturing, optimization, prototype development, delivery.
  • Fabricate and assemble sensors and prepare, optimize, and document sensor formulations.
  • Characterize sensor performance and conduct simulant and TIC testing to evaluate sensor response and functionality.
  • Develop and optimize sensor manufacturing and testing processes to improve performance, consistently, and reliability.
  • Collaborate with EE and ME teams to support sensor integration, testing, troubleshooting, and prototype development.
  • Support the development and optimization of aerosol collection systems for sensor applications.
  • Prepare technical documentations, test plans, data summaries, and other deliverables supporting USG test events.
  • Troubleshoot sensor and process issues and implement improvements based on test results and experimental findings.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Material Science, or a related discipline; a Master's degree is highly preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in Chemical Engineering in aerospace, defense or highly regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Strong knowledge of chemical formulation preparation and use of chemical and engineering tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem solving, and technical writing skills.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, test data, and technical documentations.
  • Experience working under AS9100, ISO 9001, or other quality-management systems.
  • Familiarity with government technical data, configuration management and formal engineering documentations.
  • Experience with chemical processing, energetic materials, polymers, coatings, composites, or advanced materials, depending on program requirements.

title: Analytics Solutions Analyst
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Analytics Solutions Analyst connects business strategy, analytics delivery, and data product enablement. This role combines modern business analysis, hands-on analytics development, and solution ownership to deliver trusted, actionable insights that support better decisions and measurable business outcomes.

You will partner with business leaders, Data Science Engineers, Data Engineers, and technology teams to identify high-value opportunities, shape analytics solutions, and develop minimum viable products (MVPs) or proofs of concept (POCs) that quickly validate business needs, solution feasibility, and expected value. You will use stakeholder feedback and analytical evidence to refine successful concepts into scalable, trusted analytics solutions that strengthen data adoption and enable AI-powered experiences. The role prioritizes solution ownership, KPI design, self-service enablement, and analytical problem solving, while using AI to streamline routine documentation and administrative work.

WHAT WILL YOU DO

Business Analysis & Stakeholder Consulting Using AI Coworkers and Agents

  • Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand objectives, challenges, opportunities, and success measures.
  • Use AI-powered coworker tools, copilots, and agents to summarize stakeholder input, identify themes and gaps, prepare discovery questions, and accelerate follow-up actions while applying human judgment and validating outputs.
  • Serve as a trusted analytics advisor and use AI-assisted research and analysis to strengthen conversations about KPIs, business processes, risks, and value realization.
  • Translate business needs into analytics solutions, data requirements, measurable outcomes, and product enhancements, using AI to improve requirement quality, traceability, and consistency.
  • Create lightweight, fit-for-purpose requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation with AI assistance, then review and refine the content with stakeholders.
  • Lead workshops, design reviews, solution demonstrations, and alignment sessions, using AI-generated summaries and action tracking to improve stakeholder support and decision follow-through.
  • Drive consensus around KPI definitions, reporting standards, and business metrics.

Analytics & Business Intelligence Development

  • Design and develop MVPs, POCs, Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, KPI frameworks, semantic models, and reusable business metrics.
  • Build scalable analytics assets that support enterprise reporting and self-service analytics.
  • Create interactive and executive-ready visualizations that communicate trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.
  • Develop DAX calculations, Power Query transformations, KPI logic, and business-ready semantic models.
  • Perform exploratory analysis using SQL, Power BI, Excel, and enterprise analytics platforms to identify patterns, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear business recommendations and enable AI-powered, natural-language analytics experiences.

Data Product & Solution Ownership

  • Own assigned analytics products, dashboards, scorecards, and reporting solutions throughout their lifecycle.
  • Monitor alignment to business objectives, user adoption, stakeholder feedback, and value realization.
  • Define trusted KPI definitions and standardized calculations that support a single source of truth.
  • Prioritize enhancements based on business value, impact, adoption, and strategic alignment.
  • Contribute to analytics roadmaps and data product strategy in partnership with engineering and product teams.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, analytics modernization, process optimization, and faster decision making.

Testing, Governance & AI Enablement

  • Validate data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and integrity across reporting environments.
  • Support testing, reconciliation, root cause analysis, and issue resolution for analytics solutions and KPI calculations.
  • Promote reporting standards, metric governance, trusted analytics, and responsible use of enterprise data.
  • Maintain business KPI documentation and solution knowledge assets.
  • Use Microsoft Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, and/or other enterprise AI tools to accelerate analysis and reporting development.
  • Apply prompt engineering fundamentals, support AI-ready semantic models, evaluate AI-generated insights, and champion responsible AI adoption.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in business analysis, business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or a related data role.
  • Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports, dashboards, and KPI scorecards, including DAX and Power Query.
  • Experience writing SQL queries for data analysis, testing, and validation.
  • Ability to gather business needs and translate them into practical analytics solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience analyzing business processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and supporting Agile delivery and UAT.
  • Advanced English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or equivalent analytics platforms.
  • Experience with semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and enterprise analytics ecosystems.
  • Experience defining enterprise KPIs, performance scorecards, and self-service analytics programs.
  • Experience using Power BI Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI-enabled platforms.
  • Familiarity with data product management practices and Azure DevOps.
  • Exposure to Python, R, statistics, AI agents, MCP/API integrations, conversational analytics, or natural-language analytics design.

title: Operations Lead I (Grave Shift)

title: Educational Leader
description:
The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced Educational Leader who is serious about curriculum quality and passionate about building the capability of the educators around them. This isn’t a role for someone who wants to lead from a desk — you’ll be hands-on with programming, embedded in the team, and driving real change in practice.

You’ll join a purpose-built centre with thoughtfully designed indoor and outdoor spaces, a holistic program philosophy, and a leadership team that genuinely invests in their EL. You’ll have dedicated non-contact time built into your week — protected time to plan, reflect, and lead.

Our Educational Leader time is structured around a clear rule of thumb: one hour of base EL time per week, plus one additional hour per room in the service. In a 5-room service, that’s 6 hours of protected non-contact time every week.

We are currently seeking Educational Leaders to work permanent full time hours.

What You’ll Actually Do:

  • Drive curriculum through Teach a Rainbow — lead the ongoing implementation and development of our Teach a Rainbow programming framework, ensuring it is embedded with fidelity and creativity across all rooms.
  • Mentor and build capability — provide regular, constructive feedback to educators that builds their confidence, practice and professional identity.
  • Lead EYLF-aligned programming — develop and evaluate play-based programs that reflect current early childhood research and each child’s unique learning journey.
  • Champion holistic learning — weave together diverse experiences across health and fitness, culture, music, language, cooking and outdoor education.
  • Partner with families — collaborate with families to enrich and extend each child’s learning journey.
  • Support regulatory compliance — maintain accurate documentation and quality practices aligned with the National Quality Framework.

Perks & Benefits:

  • Educational Leader Allowance — on top of your hourly rate.
  • Birthday Leave — a paid day off to celebrate you (permanent team members).
  • Childcare Gap Fee Discounts — exclusive for permanent team members.
  • Flare Benefits – Unlock everyday savings, exclusive perks and benefits for real life
  • Referral Bonus Scheme — earn bonuses for helping grow our amazing team.
  • Uniform Allowance — full set on commencement plus annual top-ups.
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and extensive wellbeing resources— through our trusted provider Sonder.
  • Excellence Awards — peer recognition for exceptional contributions.
  • Onsite Flu Vaccinations.
  • Professional Development & Training — ongoing growth opportunities across the Edge network.

Please read before applying

1. This role is NOT eligible for employer-sponsored visas (visa sponsorship). You must already hold the right to work in Australia.

2. On this occasion, we are unable to accept applicants working towards their Diploma qualification, or applicants whose only qualification is a Graduate Diploma or Masters of Teaching without the required experience (see below).

3. Our centres operate extended hours. Whilst we do our best to be flexible, candidates must be available to work opening shifts, closing shifts, or both. We are unable to accommodate school-hours-only availability.

Essential Requirements:

Qualifications

  • Completed Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Care
    OR Bachelor of Early Childhood Education (or equivalent recognised qualification)

Experience

  • Proven experience in curriculum development and programming (Teach a Rainbow experience highly regarded)
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing educators in an early childhood setting
  • Working knowledge of the EYLF and National Quality Framework

Certificates & Checks

  • Working with Children Check, mandatory
  • National Child Safety Training (GECCKO), mandatory
    • Foundations & Advanced
  • RRHAN Fundamentals & Masterclass (SA), mandatory
  • Training to respond to child abuse and neglect (ACT)
  • First Aid & CPR Certificate/s
  • Asthma Management Certificate
  • Anaphylaxis Certificate

Ready to lead with purpose? Apply today.

Edge Early Learning is an equal opportunity employer that understands the importance of creating a diverse and inclusive work environment for our educators and families. We encourage applications from people from all ages, nationalities, abilities and cultures - including Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islanders people. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a barrier-free recruitment process.
